tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las:sngon 'gro zab lam sgo 'byed bzhugs so:dhī/:'chi med rtsa gsum lha la 'dud:ma 'ongs 'od gsal snying po'i do
༄༅/ /rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las:sngon 'gro zab lam sgo 'byed bzhugs so:dhī/:'chi med rtsa gsum lha la 'dud:ma 'ongs 'od gsal snying po'i do

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: sngon 'gro zab lam sgo 'byed bzhugs so: dhī/:

'chi med rtsa gsum lha la 'dud: ma 'ongs 'od gsal snying po'i don: mngon du spyod pa'i skal ldan rnams: zab mo'i lam gyi snod rung phyir: blo sbyang rim pa 'di ltar bya: sa ma ya: shin tu dben zhing yid mthun gnas: nges 'byung nyams rtogs 'phel ba'i sar: bde ba'i stan la mnyam bzhag nas: bcos min mos gus drag po'i ngang : e ma ho: skyabs gnas kun 'dus khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon: snying dbus 'od gsal dbu ma'i pho brang nas: mdun gyi nam mkhar yid 'phrog mchod sprin dbus: mngon sum gshegs nas bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs: dal brgyad 'byor bcus brgyan pa'i mi lus 'di: dpe grangs rgyu dang ngo bos rnyed dka'i zhing : don chen sgrub pa'i mchog tu nges mthong nas: rtse gcig snying po len par byin gyis rlobs: phyi nang snod bcud dgra gnyen bar ma sogs: gang la bsams kyang mi rtag 'jig pa'i phyir: longs med 'chi ba dran pa'i brtson 'grus kyis: tshe 'di'i mngon zhen ldog par byin gyis rlobs: 'chi tshe dkar nag las kyi gzhan dbang gis: khams gsum rigs drug mtho dman sna tshogs su: bde sdug 'bras bu mi bslu smin pa'i phyir: blang dor tshul bzhin nus par byin gyis rlobs: dmyal ba tsha grang yi dwags bkres skom dang : dud 'gro bkol spyod sdug bsngal mtha' yas shing : mtho ris na yang bde ba'i skabs med pas: nges 'byung drag po skye bar byin gyis rlobs: de las skyob pa'i ded dpon gcig gyur pa: mtshan ldan bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog: mnyes pa gsum gyi bya bas legs bsten nas: thos bsam sgom la brtson par byin gyis rlobs: byin gyis rlobs shig drin can bla ma rje: dngos grub stsol cig 'chi med thod phreng rtsal: bar chad kun sol mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs: snying nas dran no thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs: zhes brjod nges 'byung drag po bsgom:

de nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni: mdun mkhar skyabs yul gsal btab nas: na mo: bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus kun: deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar: dkon mchog rtsa gsum sku gsum rgya mtsho la: mi phyed gus pa chen pos skyabs su mchi: yang yang brjod rjes rang la bstim: gnas lugs brjod bral ngang du bzhag: de nas smon 'jug sems bskyed ni: ho: mar gyur khams gsum rigs drug sems can kun: sdug bsngal srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral bya'i phyir: tshad med byams dang snying rje chen po'i blos: smon 'jug don dam sems mchog bskyed par bgyi: 'gal rkyen sdig ltung sbyang ba'i phyir: rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni: ā: bdag nyid tha mal gnas pa'i spy-i gtsug tu: bde stong chu skyes zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus: zung 'jug rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje sems: dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril bsnams: longs spyod rdzogs sku mtshan dpe'i gzi byin 'bar: yum mchog dga' bzhi'i bde ster snyems ma dkar: gri gug thod 'dzin yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: gnyis ka dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan: dam tshig ye shes dbyer med chen po yi: thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ mthar sngags kyis bskor: rtse gcig gus pas snying nas gsol btab cing : bzlas pas rgyud bskul 'dud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs: spy-i bo nas zhugs lus nang gang ba yis: sgrib bzhi dag cing dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob: sku bzhi mngon gyur blo bral gnyug ma'i ngang : don dam rig stong zung 'jug rdo rje sems: gdod nas 'du 'bral med pa'i rang zhal blta: oṃ badzra sa twa: sogs nas sa twa āḥ zhes dang : oṃ badzra sā twa hūm̐: zhes brjod sgrib gnyis rgyur bcas pa: stobs bzhi'i gnad dang ldan pa yi: bden gnyis zung 'jug rnal 'byor gyis: sbyangs pas gnas lugs mngon du 'gyur: mthun rkyen tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs phyir:

sku gsum mchod sprin maṇḍal 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐: rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i zhing kun yongs khyab pa'i: srid zhi'i 'byor tshogs dpag med maṇḍal 'di: bla ma rtsa gsum sprul sku'i zhing du 'bul: bzhes nas snang stong zung 'jug dngos grub stsol: phung khams skye mched yongs grub rdo rje'i grong : tshogs brgyad gdod nas dag pa'i maṇḍal 'di: bla ma rtsa gsum longs sku'i zhing du 'bul: bzhes nas bde stong zung 'jug dngos grub stsol: ka dag chos dbyings gzhon nu bum sku'i sbubs: lhun grub 'od gsal snang bzhi'i maṇḍal 'di: bla ma rtsa gsum chos sku'i zhing du 'bul: bzhes nas rig stong zung 'jug dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sarba maṇḍā la pū dza hoḥ de nas mos gus shugs drag pos: byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom: dbang bzhi blangs shing thugs yid bsre: mnyam gzhag blo bral gnyug ma'i ngang : rjes thob lam khyer gsum la 'bad: 'di nyid kho na nyams blangs kyang : tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub thob: de phyir snying las gces par zungs: sa ma ya: de ltar bcos min nges 'byung gis: skyabs song byang chub sems gnyis bsgom: sgrib sbyong tshogs bsags byin rlabs kyi: lam 'di sngon 'gro'i rim pa ste: ma 'ongs padma'i rig pa 'dzin: 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje'i don: klong lnga dbyings kyi thig ler rgya: 'brel tshad don dang ldan par shog: sa ya ma: rgya rgya rgya: guhya: dha thim: gar dbang 'od gsal gling pas zab mo dgongs pa'i gter las byung ba'o: ༈ rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: gsol 'debs byin rlabs myur lam bzhugs: dhī/: 'chi med rtsa gsum lha la 'dud: bdag nyid padma thod phreng rtsal: skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i skur: mi 'bral spy-i bo'i gtsug tu bsgom: snying nas gsol ba 'di ltar thob: oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos kun snying po sprol bral kun tu bzang :

bde stong sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rdo rje sems: sprul pa'i rnam rol 'chi med thod phreng rtsal: gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol: gdod ma'i mgon po 'od snang tshe mtha' yas: stong nyid snying rje'i skur bzhengs spyan ras gzigs: dbyer med grub pa'i slob dpon mtsho skyes rjer: gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol: dga' rab 'jam dpal shrī sing ha dang : dzñā na sū tra dri med bshes gnyen gyi: gdams pa'i bka' babs padma saṃ bha la: gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol: rig 'dzin bla ma kun 'dus padma 'byung : yi dam zhi khro thugs kyi klong na rdzogs: rab 'byams mkha' 'gro'i ming po dpa' bo cher: gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol: cir snang ye shes lha yi phyag rgyar dag: sgrar grags mi shigs rdo rje'i sngags su rdzogs: rtog tshogs dbyings rig dbyer med thig ler smin: snang srid gzhir bzhengs chen por byin phob cig: lus la snang stong sku yi byin gyis rlobs: ngag la grags stong gsung gi byin gyis rlobs: yid la rig stong thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs: lus ngag yid la rdo rje'i dbang bzhi skur: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char ltar phob: mthong thos dran reg smin cing grol ba dang : 'chi med sku gsum 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa ma ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bcos min mos gus drag po yis: gsol gdab dbang dang dngos grub blang : brjod med rig pa zang thal ngang : skye 'chi bar do lam du khyer: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: guhya: dha thim: gar dbang 'od gsal gling pas zab mo dgongs pa'i gter las phyung ba'o: ༈ rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las/ brgyud 'debs byin rlabs sprin phung bzhugs/

༈ ka dag gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang*/ /lhun grub mtshan dper shar ba'i rigs mchog lnga/ /zung 'jug sprul pa'i gar mkhan dga' rab rjer/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos stsol/ /chos zad 'bras bu mngon gyur mañdzu shrī/ /snang gzhi mthar phyin dpal gyi seng ge'i zhabs/ /grub pa'i rig 'dzin dzñā na sū tra la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /'ja' lus 'pho chen skur bzhengs bi ma la/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa 'chi med thod phreng rtsal/ /mkha' spyod ḍā ki'i gtso mo mtsho rgyal rjer/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /thugs sras gdams pa'i btsud 'dzin rje 'bangs grogs/ /nges par thams cad mkhyen dngos klong chen pa/ /smin grol mchog rtsol rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'chi ba mi rtag dang*/ /las 'bras bslu med don la legs bsams nas/ /nges 'byung drag po skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mtshan nyid kun ldan theg mchog bshes gnyen las/ /zab mo'i don la thos bsam mthar phyin nas/ /dben zhing nyams dga' zhi ba'i sman ljongs su/ /rtse gcig sgrub la gzhol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bslu med bla ma mchog gsum gtsug tu bsnyen/ /smon 'jug byang chub sems gnyis rab bskyed nas/ /mtha' brgyad spros bral 'od gsal dbu ma'i don/ /mngon sum rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /tshogs gnyis bsags shing sgrib gnyis sbyangs pa'i mthus/ /zab mo'i lam gyi snod du 'gyur ba dang*/ /khyad par mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ /bsnyen sgrub bzhi ldan bskyed rim pha rol son/ /rlung dang gtum mos 'bar 'dzag dbu mar thim/ /phyag rgya la brten dpe yi ye shes dang*/ /don gyi lhan skyes mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/

/gzhi dbyings khregs chod gnas lugs mngon gyur cig /gzhi snang lhun grub snang bzhi'i nyams len la/ /brten nas nang gsal khyad chos drug ldan klong*/ /mchog gi dngos grub brnyes par byin gyis rlobs/ /gal te tshe 'dir grub mtha' ma snyogs na/ /'chi bar skye ba'i srid pa rnam gsum la/ /sku gsum 'bras bu mngon du byas nas kyang*/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'ang gar dbang 'od gsal gling pas so/ ༈ /rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: phyi sgrub sgyu 'phrul drwa ba bzhugs: dhī/: rtsa gsum kun 'dus padmar 'dud: bder gshegs yongs rdzogs thod phreng rtsal: bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: shin tu dben zhing yid mthun pa'i: bkra shis byin chags gnas mchog tu: dkyil 'khor dmar zlum bkod legs steng : bhandha dum bu gcig pa'i nang : sel med dam rdzas bdud rtsis bkang : kha gcod me long g.ya' bral ngos: padma thod phreng yab yum sku: man shel snang bar 'char du gzhug: de steng dar dmar lding gur phub: phyi nang mchod pas mtha' bskor te: sbyor dngos rjes kyis nyams su blang : sa ma ya: sngon 'gro'i dang po skyabs sems ni: mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa gsum rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol mo mkha' khyab kyi 'khor lor sad par gyur: na mo: bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus kun: deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar: rab 'byams rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lhar: mi phyed gus pa chen pos skyabs su mchi: hoḥ mar gyur khams gsum rigs drug sems can kun: rnam grol sku bzhi'i go 'phang la 'god phyir: smon dang 'jug pa'i byang chub sems bskyed nas: padma thod phreng lha tshogs bsgrub par bgyi: lan gsum gnyis pa tshogs bsags ni: hoḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba sras bcas la: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo:

phyi nang gsang gsum kun bzang mchod sprin 'bul: nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib gnyis mthol zhing bshags: byang chub spyod pa rgya mtshor rjes yi rangs: theg mchog chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par bzhugs gsol 'debs: 'dis mtshon dge tshogs chos dbyings snying por bsngo: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho: tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur: gsum pa bgegs gtor sbyin pa ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang*/ stong pa'i ngang las snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du kham̐ las gtor ma 'dod rgu'i longs spyod so so'i yid dang mthun la zad mi shes pa'i gter du gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ gsum gyis brlab: sarba bighnān ā karṣa ya dzaḥ sa dgugs: sarba bighnān maḥsarba sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis bsngos la: hūm̐ hrī: yongs grub spros pa bral ba'i ye shes las: kun brtag glo bur 'khrul pa'i gdon bgegs kun: gzhan dbang dag pa rab 'byams 'dod yon gter: 'di nyid longs la rgya mtsho'i pha mthar dengs: hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis mtshon chas gzir: bzhi pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ steng 'og phyogs mtshams mtshon cha'i gur khang dang : ye shes lnga ldan me dpung 'khrigs pa'i klong : rdo rje khro bo 'chol ba'i tshogs rnams kyis: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bgegs tshogs mtshams gcad gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: lnga pa brda yi sgo dbye zhing : phyag 'tshal nongs bshags dam bca' bzungs: hūm̐ hrī: bde gshegs yongs 'dus padma thod phreng rtsal: gdod nas 'du 'bral med par ro gcig phyir: gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i mtshan ma las 'das pa'i: gnyis med ye shes brda sgo dbye bar 'tshal: bhrūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭa: hūm̐ hrī: sems kyi chos nyid 'od gsal rdzogs pa che: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i rnam rol las: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'ja' ltar shar: mi phyed gus pa'i brda yis phyag 'tshal lo:

a ti pū ho: na ma dhī: hūm̐ hrī: rig 'dus rtsa gsum lha tshogs thugs rje'i bdag: rang rig byang chub sems su lhun rdzogs kyang : rang ngo ma mthong gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pas bsgribs: gnyis med chos sku'i klong du mthol zhing bshags: badzra sa ma ya shuddhe ā: hūm̐ hrī: 'od gsal snang ba rnam bzhi'i gseng lam du: dbyings rig zung 'jug sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lha: sku dang ye shes dbyer med ma gyur bar: rdo rje'i dam tshig mi gtong bzung bar bgyi: badzra dzñā na sa ma ya hūm̐: drug pa ye shes byin 'bebs ni: hūm̐ hrī: 'og min bde chen padma drwa ba'i zhing : rnga yab dpal ri sprul pa'i gzhal yas nas: 'chi med rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis: gnas 'dir byin phob dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sarba dharma pā la dzñā na badzra sa ma ya ā be sha ya ā āḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐:

bdun pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bdag nyid lhar gsal thugs ka'i sa bon las: 'phros pa'i 'od kyis mchod rdzas bzung 'dzin sbyangs: snang srid gzhir bzhengs kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin: dpag yas nam mkha' mdzod kyi gter du gyur: oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas shabta 'i bar dang ru pa shapda gandhe rā sa sparṣe ma ha pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta ga ṇa tsakra sarba pū dza ā:hūm̐: lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab: sa ma ya: dngos gzhi'i dang po bskyed rim ni: hūm̐: ka dag de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes las: lhun grub kun snang snying rje'i rang rtsal ni: zung 'jug rgyu yi ting 'dzin hūm̐ mthing ga: de las 'od 'phros brtan g.yo'i dngos po kun: 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi dbyings su thim: skad cig dran rdzogs phyi snod padma 'od: shin tu nyams dga' ngo mtshar bkod pas mdzes: blta na lhun sdug 'ja' zer 'khrigs pa'i klong : dpa' bo ḍā ki dgyes pa'i glu gar bsgyur: me tog char 'bebs rol mo sna tshogs sgrogs: yid 'phrog mchod sprin rgya mtshos phyogs kun khyab: de dbus thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs pa'i: lte bar rin chen padma nyi zla'i steng : rdo rje hūm̐ yig mnyam sbyor 'phro 'du las: bdag nyid lhun grub rig 'dzin thod phreng rtsal: che ba'i che mchog chos sku gsang ba 'dus: mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril bsnams: khro chags sgeg pa'i nyams ldan spyan gsum 'bar: gcer bu dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan: thabs shes zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar gyis rol: yum mchog dga' bzhi'i bde ster mandā ra: dmar mo gri gug thod 'dzin yab la 'khril: rin chen rus rgyan dar sna'i cod pan 'phur: yid 'ong bcu drug bde ba'i lang tshos sgeg: ral pa'i skra gseb kun bzang yab yum la: dpal chen grub pa'i slob dpon brgyad la sogs:

rnal 'byor gsum gyi lam mchog gsal mdzad pa'i: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma sprin ltar gtibs: bde chen 'khor lo 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: longs spyod 'khor lor dbang chen rta mchog dpal: chos kyi 'khor lor yang dag he ru ka: sprul pa'i 'khor lor che mchog bdud rtsi 'khyil: gsang ba'i 'khor lor badzra ku mā ra: rdo rje nor bur bla med khrag 'thung dbang : brla g.yas dregs 'dul g.yon par stobs ldan rnams: so so'i sprul dang yang sprul bcas pa yi: ye shes dgu rdzogs khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor lha: bdun brgya nyer lnga bsam yas lhun grub tshogs: snang stong 'dzin bral 'ja' tshon lta bur shar: dza lan dhā ra la sogs nyer bzhi'i yul: rtsa khams sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo'i bdag: dkar dmar thig le gnas su dag pa'i gzugs: bde stong dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshom bur bzhugs: phyi rol phyogs bzhi'i padma'i snying po ru: longs sku thod phreng rigs bzhi yab yum dang : phyogs mtshams rin chen zur brgyad 'od lnga'i klong : sprul pa'i rig 'dzin mtshan brgyad zhi dang khro: gang 'dus sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol mor gsal: sgo bzhir pad nyi ru tra bsnol ba'i steng : dbang chen rigs bzhi dkar ser dmar ljang mdog: khro bo'i chas rdzogs ye shes me dpung klong : gri gug thod 'dzin rang 'od yum dang 'khril: gzhan yang rtsa gsum chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dpag yas snod bcud khyab par gsal ba yi: sku la gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lhas: rgyas btab gnas gsum rdo rje gsum gyi dngos: oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing mtshan pa las: 'od 'phros ye shes lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: gnyis pa ye shes spyan 'dren ni: thod rnga 'khrol zhing gdung ba'i blos: hūm̐ hrī: yul gyi ming ni lho nub rnga yab gling : sprul pa'i zhing mchog padma drwa ba nas: bde gshegs kun 'dus 'chi med thod phreng rtsal: mos pa'i gnas 'dir gdung bas spyan 'dren na:

rab 'byams rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas: thugs rjes byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs nas kyang : rnal 'byor sgo gsum rdo rje'i dbang bskur la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī badzra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: zhes bskul lho nub nam mkha' nas: sprin phung lta bur byon par bsam: gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: dam tshig sems dpa' snang stong lha yi sku: dag pa rab 'byams rdo rje'i 'og min cher: chos kyi dbyings nas spyan drangs ye shes pa: zung 'jug dgyes pa chen por bzhugs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho: badzra sa ma ya dzñā na tiṣṭha lhan: bzhi pa gus phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: bla ma yi dam ḍā ki'i lha tshogs rnams: gdod nas gnyis med mnyam par ro gcig kyang : glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma sbyang pa'i slad: sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū hoḥ pra tī tstsha hoḥ lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba la: phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: lhar snang phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nyid las: dam tshig phyag rgya brda dang gar gyi tshogs: chos dang las kyi phyag rgyar rab sbyar nas: 'chi med rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod: ma hā tsa turmu dra pū dza hoḥ ye shes glu yi mchod pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: srog rtsol rlung gi rgyu ba ji snyed kun: 'od gsal dbu ma'i dbyings su thim pa las: mi shigs rdo rje nā da'i glu dbyangs kyis: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: ma hā dzñā na te te hūm̐: te na te te hūm̐: thun mong phyi mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i zhing kun yongs khyab pa'i: srid zhi'i 'byor tshogs dpag med mchod sprin rnams: rigs 'dus rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ

nas shapda pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐: rang byung nang mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: yul dang dbang po gnas su dag pa las: gang shar bde stong rol mor 'char ba'i dpyid: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i mchod sprin gyis: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra rū pa shapda gandhe rā sa sparṣe pra titstsha ā hūm̐: gsang ba kun bzang mchod sprin ni: hūm̐ hrī: snang srid dag pa chos sku'i grong khyer du: ting 'dzin kun tu bzang po'i 'dod yon sprin: bla med mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po yis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rtag tu mnyes gyur cig: nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel: sbyor ba sman gyi mchod pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: thabs shes rgyu gnyis rkyen bzhi sbyar ba'i bcud: rigs lnga ye shes lnga rdzogs sgrub pa'i rdzas: zag med rdo rje btung ba'i dam tshig mchog: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sa pa ri bā ra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: brgyud mchod ni: snang ba mtha' yas 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*/ /mtsho skyes yab yum chos rgyal khri lde'i zhabs/ /'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /rta mchog rol pa rdo rje phag mo sogs/ /sgrub chen sde brgyad zhi dang khro bo'i lha/ /padma drag po yi dam dgongs 'dus kyis/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /gnas yul dur khrod dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /rgyud gsum dam can rgya mtsho gter gyi bdag /dkar po'i phyogs skyong rdo rje tha tshig can/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /rjes 'brel dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: 'chi med ye shes bdud rtsi'i sprin: rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo nyid: thabs shes mtheb srin phyag rgya yis:

dngos grub rnam gnyis thob phyir myang : oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hoḥ sgrol ba raktas mchod pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: bdag med rdo rje khros pa'i he ru kas: gzung 'dzin 'byung po dbyings su bsgral ba'i khrag: chags bral so sor rtog pa'i mchod sprin gyis: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: ma hā rakta khā hī: zung 'jug gtor mas mchod pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: e dbyings stong nyid phyag rgya'i bhandha ru: wam̐ yig bde chen rdo rje'i gtor mar shar: zung 'jug bcu drug dga' ba'i mchod pa'i sprin: 'chi med rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: dza gad bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: bde chen rdo rjai sems dpa'i thig le ni: byang chub sems kyi rol par 'char ba'i dpyid: zag med dza gad phud kyi mchod pa yis: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: ma hā dza gad pū dza ho: mthar thug don gyi mchod pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: dbyings rig zung 'jug chos nyid mngon sum klong : nyams snang gong 'phel la sogs mchod pa'i sprin: rig pa tshad phebs don gyi lha la 'bul: chos zad blo 'das mchog gi dngos grub stsol: ma hā dzña na dharma dhā tu sa ma ya ho: drug pa rdo rje'i glu yis bstod: hūm̐ hrī: bde gshegs kun 'dus padma saṃ bha ba: chos phung rgya mtsho gsung gi klong nas shar: rab 'byams rgyal sras yongs kyi 'khor los bsgyur: mchog gsum dbyer med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: ngo bo ka dag chos sku snang mtha' yas: rang bzhin lhun grub 'od gsal snying rje'i gter: thugs rje zung 'jug 'chi med thod phreng rtsal: sku gsum kun 'dus khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: lhun grub rig 'dzin bla ma'i dkyil 'khor gtso: ye shes dgu rdzogs yi dam zhi khro'i dngos: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rje sangs rgyas padma skyes: rtsa gsum dbyer med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod:

gzhan yang snang stong sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las: gang 'dul zhi dang khro bo'i rnam rol gyis: byin rlabs mchog stsol dngos grub char 'bebs pa'i: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus kun la bstod: bdun pa bsnyen pa bya ba ni: snying dbus ye shes sems dpa' yi: thugs kar padma nyi zla'i steng : rdo rje'i rtse lnga'i lte bar hūm̐: mthar skor sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor: de las 'od 'phros rgyal ba kun: padma thod phreng rnam rol tu: sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgyar byon: bdag nyid la thim byin rlabs gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: thun mtshams tshigs bdun gsol 'debs kyis: gsang gsum byin rlabs yang yang bsdu: 'di nyid phyogs dus bde gshegs kyi: gsung gi gsang ba kun gyi bcud: rtag tu g.yel med nyams blangs pas: tshe 'dir mchog gi btsan sa zin: 'bum phrag bcu gnyis bzlas gyur kyang : rig 'dzin ḍā ki sprin bzhin 'du: gnas skabs phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub: tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag: rnga yab padma 'od du 'gro: zung 'jug 'chi med rdo rje'i skur: dbugs 'byin 'di la the tshom med: sa ma ya: khyad par nang ltar sgrub pa ni: thugs srog las byung yi ge'i sprin: yab yum gnas bzhi'i padmor son: bde stong dga' bzhi dbyer med pa'i: rnam kun mchog ldan rang zhal blta: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī hrīḥbadzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal de ba ḍā ki nī badzra sa ma ya dzaḥsarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ slar yang 'od zer 'phro 'du yis: gang 'dul phrin las lhun grub gyis grub: 'gro kun chos nyid gcig gi ngang : sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dbang thob gyur: shantiṃ puṣting wa shang mā ra ya phaṭa: snod bcud dkyil 'khor 'khor lor shar: srog rtsol rdo rje'i sngags su rdzogs: dran rtog rang grol gnyug ma'i ngang : gzhom med hūm̐ lnga'i snang glu len: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: kun rdzob yul snang sgyu ma'i gzugs:

don dam stong chen 'od gsal ngang : thim pas mtha' bral zung 'jug gi: mi slob ye shes sku nyid 'grub: sa ma ya: rjes kyi rim par dang po ni: mchod cing bstod la dngos grub blangs: hūm̐ hrī: sku gsum bde chen rdo rje'i pho brang nas: bde gshegs kun 'dus 'chi med thod phreng rtsal: deng 'dir bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la: mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la babs: gnas skabs grub pa brgyad dang phrin las bzhi: dbang bcu'i yon tan lhun gyis grub pa dang : mthar thug rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i gseng lam las: sku dang ye shes phrin las dbang 'byor stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī kā ya wā ka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la ho: gnyis pa nongs pa bshags pa ni: hūm̐: gzod nas rnam par dag pa'i gshis lugs la: glo bur 'khrul pa'i bshags bya ma mchis kyang : kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu'i snang cha ru: nyes pa gang mchis snying nas bzod par gsol: yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod: gsum pa rtag mthar sbyang ba ni: hoḥ snang stong sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i ye shes lha: zung 'jug mtshan ma med pa'i dbyings su gshegs: rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dam tshig pa: 'od gsal smon pa med pa'i klong du thim: ā ā ā: bzhi pa chad mtha' bsal ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: slar yang snang ba'i rang bzhin gnas gsum lha: sgrar grags rlung gi 'khor lo yi ge'i sprin: rtog pa rtog med rang grol gnyug ma'i ngang : dus gsum dus med chen por rtag tu spyod: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: lnga pa dge tshogs bsngo ba ni: hrī: 'chi med padma drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor du: bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug dge tshogs ci mchis pa: 'gro kun bla med go 'phang thob bya'i phyir: spros bral chos sku'i dbyings su bsngo bar bgyi: drug pa smon lam gdab pa ni: hoḥ phung khams 'ja' lus rdo rje'i skur smin shing : srog rtsol 'od gsal dbu ma'i klong du rdzogs:

rig stong brjod bral gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings su: rab 'byams rtsa gsum go 'phang mngon gyur shog: bdun pa shis pa brjod pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: spangs rtogs phrin las mthar phyin rdzogs sangs rgyas: des gsung zhi bsil bdud rtsi dam pa'i chos: tshogs kyi mchog gyur 'phags pa'i dge 'dun te: bla med dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog: byin rlabs mchog stsol rtsa brgyud bla ma dang : dngos grub char 'bebs yi dam zhi dang khro: phrin las lhun grub mkha' 'gro chos skyong ste: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha yi bkra shis shog: thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang snang mtha' yas: kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan rdo rje sems: gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rnam rol can: sku gsum padma thod phreng bkra shis shog: thun mong phrin las ma lus lhun gyis grub: sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor shar: bde stong zung 'jug 'od gsal chos sku'i klong : mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i bkra shis shog:

gzhan yang shis brjod smon lam rigs: rgya cher btags pas mtshams sbyor bya: sa ma ya: de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis: rtsa gsum 'chi med thod phreng rtsal: bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i lam gyi rim: shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug 'di: 'das dus bkra shis brag gi phug: mā ra tī ka'i tshogs khang du: rig sngags grub pa'i rnal 'byor dang : dpa' bo ḍā ki'i don du bstan: da lta las can dag pa'i 'khor: mnga' bdag rje 'bangs grogs bcas la: smin cing grol ba'i sgo 'phar dbye: ma 'ongs lnga brgya'i tha ma ru: zab mo'i lam rnams 'chal 'gyur zhing : nges don rtog ge'i tshig la re: blo yis mtshon pa'i stong lta yis: bden gnyis rgyu 'bras khyad du gsad: bod khams sdug bsngal gsum gyis mnar: de yi tshe na bdag nyid dang : 'jam dpal chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis: byin gyis brlabs pa'i snying gi bu: 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje'i don: rig pa dbyings kyi sgrom bur sbas: nam zhig rten 'brel dus babs tshe: yang gsang snying gi thig le'i skor: skal bar ldan pa'i tshogs rnams la: rgya cher bshad dang sgrub pa'i mthus: gangs can skye 'gro bde bas 'tsho: 'brel tshad gtan bde'i sa la bkod: khyad par yar mar tshes bcu'i dus: 'di nyid tshogs su sgrub pa na: dngos nyams rmi lam ma nges par: bdag gis nges par byin rlabs shing : 'phos tshe zangs mdog dpal gyi rir: rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshom bur sbyor: de phyir snying gi dbus su zungs: rgya rgya rgya: dha thim: zhes pa'ang rig 'dzin grub thob yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba 'jigs bral gyi slob dpon chen po 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje dgung grangs bcu drug par: rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi byin rlabs la brten nas dgongs pa'i gter du brdol ba ring du gsang ba'i rgyas btab par mdzad nas/ dgung lo lnga bcur phebs pa skyes bdag lcags lug cho 'phrul zla ba'i dkar phyogs 'grub pa'i sbyor ba dang ldan pa'i dus tshes shin tu dge bar/

kho bo skal ldan padma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyis gus pa chen pos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor gtan la phab cing rjes su gnang ba 'gro kun rtsa gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbugs dbyung ba'i rgyur gyur cig /kha skong phran tshegs rnam kyang bka' bzhin dkyus su bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel/ ༈ /phyi sgrub sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las: phrin las 'chi med srog sgrub bzhugs: hrī: 'chi med rig 'dzin padmar 'dud: gzhir gnas zung 'jug thig le gsum: lam dus bde stong ting 'dzin gyi: srid zhi'i dwangs mar sgrub pa las: 'bras bu 'chi med srog 'grub 'gyur: sa ma ya: bder gshegs yongs 'dus thod phreng rtsal: dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rab 'byams kyi: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bskyed rim dang : khyad par las la sbyor ba ni: hrī: snang ba 'chi med thod phreng rtsal: stong pa mandā ra ba yum: zung 'jug rtsa gsum tshe yi lha: rdo rje phung po'i grong du rdzogs: bde stong rol pa'i 'od zer gyis: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams khyab: bla tshe chad nyams yar ba dang : brtan g.yo srid zhi'i tshe bcud bsdus: thabs mchog bde chen byang chub sems: shes rab stong nyid tsaṇḍa lī: mnyam sbyor snying dbus thig ler thim: sgo gsum 'chi med srog 'grub gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi ā yuu ṣe hūm̐ nṛ dza: zhes bzlas srog stsol dbu mar bstim: gzhom med hrīḥyi sgra sgrogs bsam: 'bar 'dzag dga' bzhi'i ye shes bskyed: dbyings rig zung 'jug ngang du bzhag: srog gi snying po hrīḥyig ni: dus gsum dus med gcig tu bzla: 'chi med gnyug ma'i ye shes kyis: padma thod phreng tshe 'dir 'grub: sa ma ya: skabs su thugs dam bskul ba ni: rtse gcig mos gus drag po bskyed: hrī: 'og min bde chen rdo rje'i zhing khams nas: tshe dpag med mgon lha mo tsaṇḍa lī: dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa'i klong nas bzhengs:

ngo bo 'od gsal chos sku'i tshe bcud khug: hrī: lnga ldan 'ja' zer thig le'i dkyil 'khor nas: spyan ras gzigs dbang gsang ba ye shes yum: bde stong 'du 'bral med pa'i klong nas bzhengs: rang bzhin kha sbyor longs sku'i tshe bcud khug: hrī: bkra shis brag phug mā ra tī ka nas: mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chi med mandā ra: thabs shes 'du 'bral med pa'i klong nas bzhengs: thugs rje 'gro 'dul sprul sku'i tshe bcud khug: hrī: rang snang rnam dag zangs mdog dpal ri nas: padma thod phreng bde chen mtsho rgyal yum: snang stong 'du 'bral med pa'i klong nas bzhengs: 'khor 'das brtan dang g.yauo ba'i tshe bcud khug: hrī: 'chi med sku gsum kun 'dus tshe yi lha: o rgyan chen po padma thod phreng rtsal: rab 'byams rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas: sngon gyi thugs dam rjes su dgongs nas kyang : 'dir spyon sgrub pa'i rdzas la byin chen phob: lus ngag yid la rdo rje'i dbang bzhi skur: phung khams mi shigs dwangs ma gsum ldan klong : 'chi med 'ja' lus tshe yi dngos grub stsaul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi ā yuu ṣe hūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ kā ya wā ka tsitta ā yurdzñā na sarba siddhi pha la hoḥ zhes bskul ye shes lha tshogs kyi: thugs rje'i 'od zer dpag med 'phros: 'gro kun dus min 'chi ba bsal: snod bcud dkyil 'khor 'khor lor bsgyur: srid zhi'i tshe dang ye shes bkug: bdag dang sgrub pa'i rdzas la thim: phung khams dwangs ma'i srog 'grub cing : 'chi med bdud rtsir 'khyil par bsam: snod bcud dkyil 'khor 'khor lor sba: rtsa rlung thig le dbu mar sba: snang ba stong pa'i dbyings su sba: stong pa rig pa'i snying por sba: sba bzhi'i gnad la sus goms pa: bar chad bgegs kyis glags mi rnyed: dus min 'chi dang bdud bzhi 'joms: tshe dbang rig 'dzin mngon du 'gyur: sa ma ya: bde gshegs kun 'dus thod phreng lha'i:

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i ting 'dzin gyi: phrin las 'chi med srog sgrub 'di: snying gi bu la gtad do rgya: rgya rgya rgya: dha thim: ༈ /lo rgyus zab don gsal byed/ dbang bzhi ye shes snang ba/ man ngag rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ phyi sgrub rtsa gsum 'dus pa/ nang sgrub 'jig rten dbang phyug /gsang sgrub padma gar dbang*/ 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sgrub pa/ yang gsang padma drag po/ phrin las yid bzhin nor bu/ tshe sgrub 'chi med snying po/ phur pa ye shes snying po/ yang dag bde chen snying po/ gsol 'debs byin rlabs char 'bebs byin 'bebs ye shes char 'bebs/ skong bshags phrin las char 'bebs so/ ༈ /rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: yan lag tshogs kyi 'khor lo bzhugs: dhī/: rtsa gsum kun 'dus padmar 'dud: bsod nams ye shes rnal 'byor gyis: sgrib gnyis 'ching ba gcod byed pa: yan lag tshogs kyi 'khor lo ni: dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas mchog tu: yar mar tshes bcu'i dus sogs dang : smin graul gdams pa sbyin pa'i tshe: dpa' bo ḍā ki mnyes byed phyir: thabs shes 'du bar 'os pa'i rdzas: rnam dag mchod pas mdun bdar te: dang po byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: bdag nyid lhar gsal thugs nas ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: 'phros pas tshogs kyi nyes skyon bsregs gtor bkrus: phyi snod klong lnga dbyings kyi ka pa lar: nang bcud 'bru gsum ye shes bdud rtsir 'khyil: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐ hrī: 'og min chos dbyings spros bral pho brang dang : lhun grub nges pa lnga ldan longs sku'i zhing : 'chi med bde chen padma drwa ba sogs: sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor gnas yul dur khrod nas: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang : rtsa gsum kun 'dus o rgyan thod phreng rtsal: rig 'dzin ḍā ki rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:

lhun grub tshogs khang rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing : thabs shes 'dod yon mchog gi dam tshig rdzas: snang ba lha la grags pa sngags kyi sgra: dran rtog ka dag chen por byin phob cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru de ba ḍā ki ni sarba dharma pā la badzra sa ma ya ā be sha ya ā' ā: gsum pa phyi yi mchod pa la: dang po tshogs phud 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: bder gshegs rgyal ba sras bcas dam tshig mchog: sha lnga bdud rtsi rigs lnga ye shes lnga: 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam mang mchod sprin gyis: bde stong zung 'jug chen por mnyes gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sarba dharma pā la ma hā a mṛ ta ga ṇa tsa kra pū dza khā hiḥ bar pa nyams chag bshags pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: thog med dus nas da lta yan chad du: bcas dang rang bzhin nyams pa'i sdig ltung gis: rtsa gsum srung ma'i thugs dang 'gal ba kun: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: yi ge brgya pa brjod: tha ma sbyor sgrol mchod pas bskang : hūm̐ hrī: bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dgra bgegs 'byung po kun: bdag med rdo rje khro bo'i tshogs rnams kyis: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥchos kyi dbyings su bsgral: phung khams zag med tshogs kyi 'khor lor rol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba sha trūn mā ra ya ga ṇa tsakra pū dza hoḥ nang ltar phung khams skye mched kyi: yongs grub dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod: hoḥ gdod nas dag mnyam dbyer med rtogs pa'i rdzas: thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug 'dod yon mchog: lhun grub rdo rje phung po'i dkyil 'khor gyi: rang byung gnyug ma'i lha tshogs mchod phyir bzhes: oṃ āḥhūm̐: rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan grong khyer du: lhan skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor lha: bza' bca' btung ba'i rdo rje'i dam tshig gis: bde stong dga' bzhi'i 'du ba rgyas phyir rol: a la la ho: gsang ba 'bar dang 'dzag pa yis: snyoms 'jug zag med bdud rtsi spel:

bzhi pa lhag ma bsngo ba ni: a kā ra ོsa brlab: phaiṃ gyi sgras: lhag sdud tshogs rnams spyan drangs te: hūm̐ hrī: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba yi: ye shes las grub dpal gyi lhag sdud kun: longs spyod tshogs gyi pham phabs 'di longs la: rnam bzhi'i phrin las lhun gyis grub par mdzod: ma ma ḍā ki nī kiṅka ra utstshiṣta ba liṃ tā khā hi: lnga pa smon lam gdab pa ni: hoḥ snang srid dag pa rab 'byams rdo rje'i grong : tshogs gnyis zung 'jug 'khor lo bskor ba'i mthus: 'gro kun phyi nang gzhan gsum dbyer med pa: 'chi med padma thod phreng 'grub par shog: drug pa thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: lho nub rnga yab zangs mdog dpal gyi ri: sku gsum dbyer med sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: bde gshegs yongs 'dus padma thod phreng rtsal: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa'i thugs dam bskul: hrī: gdod nas dag pa chos sku'i pho brang nas: rab 'byams rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'gro kun sdug bsngal tshor bas nyam thag tshe: thugs dam bskul lo thugs rje dus 'dir skyed: gnas skabs zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po yi: gang 'dul phrin las lhun gyis grub pa dang : mthar thug sku bzhi dbyer med thig le'i klong : khams gsum 'gro kun sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: bdun pa chad tho bsgrag pa ni: hūm̐ bhyoḥ sngon tshe kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po yis: dam la bzhag pa'i rig rtsal dregs tshogs kun: zung 'jug rdo rje'i gtor ma 'di longs la: snang bzhi zad sar skyel ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bhyoḥ de 'og mtsho skyes thod phreng yab yum gyis: dam la bzhag pa'i bde stong dregs tshogs kun: lhan skyes nye rgyu'i gtor ma 'di longs la: 'chi med 'od skur 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bhyoḥ tha ma dbang drag padma he ru kas: dam la bzhag pa'i rgyud gsum dregs tshogs kun: tha tshig gnyan po'i gtor ma 'di longs la:

gang 'dul phrin las yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥshrī ma hā kā la rā hu la e ka dza ṭi a ya ma du ru tsa sha na ba liṃ ta bhuñdza kha kha khā hi khā hi: badzra sa ma ya ho: brgyad pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐ bhyo: bod khams skyong ba'i ma mo brtan ma'i tshogs: 'dir gshegs bshal chu'i bdud rtsi 'di gsol la: 'chi med padma thod phreng bka' bzhin tu: gangs can bstan dang 'gro la phan bde spel: gnyug gnas glo bur lhags pa'i 'byung po kun: drag shul rdo rje'i rol pas tshar bcad nas: bod khams skye dgu'i tshogs rnams bde ba dang : rgyal bstan phyogs bcur dar ba'i phrin las mdzod: ma ma ḍā ki nī hrīṃ hrīṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: dgu pa mnan pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ bhyo: rnam thar gsum ldan rdo rje btsun mo'i klong : gnyis 'dzin log 'dren dam sri 'byung po'i tshogs: mnan no snying rje khros pa'i bro brdungs pas: byang chub bar du ldang bar ma gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ st+waṃ bha ya nanaḥ gnas skabs sgrib gnyis kun byang zhing : ci 'dod phrin las yid bzhin 'grub: mthar thug rig 'dzin mchog brnyes slad: tshogs gnyis lam 'di gces par zungs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dha thim: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: skong bshags 'od gsal thol glu bzhugs: dhī/: 'chi med rtsa gsum lha la 'dud: de nyid bsnyen cing sgrub pa dang : tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i 'du ba'i tshe: bskang zhing bshags pa'i rim pa la: dang po byin gyis brlab pa ni: āḥ kun brtags snang ba dbyings su thim pa'i rtsal: gzhan dbang dag pa rab 'byams mchod sprin che: yongs grub ye shes mchog gis byin brlabs pas: mi zad nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lo gyur: nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas brlab: gnyis pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐ hrī: gdod nas spros bral 'od gsal gnyug ma'i gshis: gzhi dbyings khyad chos drug ldan ye shes las:

gzhi snang lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing : 'og min gsang chen rdo rje'i pho brang che: sprul pa'i grong khyer me ri 'bar ba dang : mngon par dga' dang dpal ldan padma brtsegs: las rab yongs su rdzogs pa'i zhing khams sogs: phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs rgyal ba sras bcas dang : phyi ltar gdod nas grub pa'i nyer bzhi'i yul: nang ltar lhun grub rdo rje phung po'i grong : gsang ba rlung sems dbu mar thim pa'i rtsal: bde stong zung du 'jug pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i lha: gnas gsum dpa' bo ḍā ki rgya mtsho dang : ye shes las grub chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs: thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chag bshags pa'i phyir: rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis spyan 'dren na: don dam 'gro 'ong mtshan ma las 'das kyang : kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu'i snang cha ru: tshad med thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs: gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sarba dharma pā la badzra sa ma ya dza dza: dam tshig ye shes gnyis med dgyes par bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: phyi nang gsang gsum kun bzang mchod sprin 'bul: nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib kun mthol zhing bshags: byang chub spyod pa rgya mtshor rjes yi rangs: theg mchog chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par bzhugs gsol 'debs: 'dis mtshon dge tshogs chos dbyings snying por bsngo: kun kyang rnam kun mchog ldan thob par shog:

gsum pa thugs dam bskang ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: 'chi med thog ma'i mgon po snang mtha' yas: bde stong snying rje'i skur bzhengs spyan ras gzigs: srid zhir mi gnas sangs rgyas padma skyes: sku gsum dbyer med bla ma'i thugs dam bskang : ye shes klong dgu'i rang gzugs he ru ka: gang 'dul sprul pa'i rnam rol mtshan mchog brgyad: yi dam yongs 'dus padma drag po rtsal: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i ngo bor thugs dam bskang : rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje btsun mo'i dbyings: gnas 'dir bcu drug bde ster mandā ra: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rje ye shes mtsho rgyal sogs: gnas gsum ḍā ki rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang : zag med bde chen thig le rā hu la: shes rab stong chen dbyings phyug e ka dza: zung 'jug dbu mar shar ba'i ma ning nag: rgyud gsum dregs tshogs yongs kyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐ hrī: thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas mchod pa ni: yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon bdud rtsi'i mtsho: dri med gaṅga'i rgyun gyi zhabs bsil sgreng : chu skyes thang skyes me tog sna tshogs tshal: lhan skyes sbyar ba'i bdug pa'i sprin phung 'thul: nyi zla nor bu sgron me'i snang gsal 'bar: reg pas bde ba ster ba'i dri chab rgyun: yid 'phrog 'chi med grub pa'i zhal zas dang : dbyangs bdun rdzogs pa'i rol mo'i bye brag sogs: phyi mchod 'dod yon rgya mtshos thugs dam bskang : phung khams dwangs mar shar ba'i phyag rgya'i gzugs: grags stong thabs shes ā li kā li'i sgra: rlung sems dbu mar 'ching ba'i lhan skyes dri: ham̐ yig ga bur bzhu ba'i bdud rtsi'i ro: a shad gtum mor 'bar ba'i reg bya dang : dga' mchog khyad par lhan skyes ye shes kyi: rnam 'gyur rdo rje'i rig ma bcu drug sogs: rang byung nang gi mchod pas thugs dam bskang : gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i mtshan ma las 'das pa'i: snang srid gzhir bzhengs ye shes kā pa lar:

bde stong dbyer med brtul zhugs grub pa'i dpyid: thabs shes dga' bzhis drangs pa'i a mṛ ta: rlung sems dbu mar 'ching ba'i dmar chen po: zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i ba liṃ ta: phung khams dwangs mar sgrub pa'i dam tshig rdzas: lhan skyes gsang ba'i mchod pas thugs dam bskang : gzhi dbyings rig stong phyag rgya'i padmo ru: gzhi snang ye shes rdo rjes mnyam sbyor bas: srid dang zhi ba'i chos khams ji snyed kun: 'od gsal rnam kun mchog ldan klong du bsgral: ka dag byar med gnyug ma rdo rje'i srog: lhun grub thig le chen por shar ba'i gzugs: blang dor spros pa'i pha rol nas brgal ba: bla med mchog gi mchod pas thugs dam bskang : chos nyid mngon sum mja' zer thig le'i sbubs: nyams snang gong 'phel sna tshogs mchod sprin ches: rig pa tshad phebs don gyi lha tshogs rnams: chos zad blo 'das chen por thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskang gyur las bzhi grub pa brgyad: rin 'dzin rnam bzhi'i go 'phang la brten nas : tshe gcig 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i grong : sku dang ye shes mchog gi dngos grub stsol: bzhi pa nyams chag bshags pa ni: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang : rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtshor bcas: kun nas mkhyen brtses bdag la dgongs su gsol: gsang chen rdo rje'i rig pa 'dzin pa yi: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'dus par bcas pa kun: bla med byang chub snying po bsgrub pa'i phyir: smon dang 'jug pa'i sems gnyis rab bskyed nas: so thar theg chen gsang sngags bslab pa rnams: srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ci nus su: tshul bzhin bsrung bar khas blangs dam bcas kyang : gzung 'dzin nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i gzhan dbang la: brten nas nyams shing chag par gyur pa kun: mi 'chab mi sbed gnong 'gyod drag po yis: snying nas so sor bshags cing sdom bgyid na:

tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol: don dam brjod bral gnyug ma'i gshis lugs la: bshags dang bshags par bya ba las 'das kyang : kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu'i snang cha ru: nyes pa gang mchis snying nas bzod par gsol: yi ge brgya pa lan gsum mthar: 'khor gsum spros bral ngang du bzhag: lnga pa smon lam gdab pa ni: hoḥ de ltar bskangs shing bshags pa'i byin rlabs kyis: bdag gzhan mkha' khyab 'gro ba ma lus kun: srid las nges 'byung byang chub sems bskyed nas: bla med theg chen mchog la 'jug par shog: de tshe dngos grub rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas mchog: rdo rje slob dpon byams pa'i bka' drin las: smin grol zab mo'i gdams pa'i bcud thob nas: gsang chen rdo rje'i rig pa 'dzin par shog: snang srid dag pa lha yi zhing dang skur: yongs shar bzlas pa sngags kyis rgyud bskul bas: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rab 'byams kyis: dgyes pa'i zhal bstan gsung gi dbugs dbyung shog: srog rtsol kha sbyor rlung gi rnal 'byor dang : 'bar 'dzag dbu mar thim pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: phung khams skye mched dwangs mar yongs shar cing : sa bcu dbu ma'i klong du rdzogs par shog: dngos dang yid las byung ba'i tsaṇḍa lī: snyoms 'jug gsang ba'i mchod pas mnyes byas mthus: lugs 'byung lugs ldog dga' bzhi'i ye shes kyis: lhan skyes bde stong dbyer med 'grub par shog: ka dag mngon sum rig pa'i ngang nyid las: lhun grub snang ba bzhi yi nyams len gyis: zag bcas 'khrul pa'i phung khams skye mched kun: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku ru gnas 'gyur shog: tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub ma thob na: 'chi ba chos sku bar do longs sku dang : skye srid sprul pa'i sku yi rnam rol gyis: rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog: gzhan yang bstan 'dzin skyes mchog dam pa rnams: zhabs pad brtan cing bshad sgrub bstan pa dar:

'gro kun mi mthun rgud pa kun zhi zhing : phan bde'i dpal 'byor rtag tu rgyas par shog: mdor na gnas skabs phrin las rnam bzhi dang : grub chen brgyad dang dbang bcu phyi nang gnyis: rnam smin tshe dbang 'od gsal phyag rgya che: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin mthar phyin shog: mthar thug sku dang ye shes dbyer med pa: 'chi med rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor mngon gyur nas: bum pa bzang dang dpag bsam nor bu ltar: gzhan don phrin las lhun gyis grub par shog: mchod bya mchod byed mchod yul ma lus kun: kun rdzob mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba ltar: snang yang gzung 'dzin spros pa las 'das pa'i: don dam rig stong rjen pa'i dbyings su a: zhes brjod rjes kyi bya ba rnams: sgrub pa'i phrin las gzhung bzhin bya: sa ma ya: de ltar rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor gyi: skong bshags 'od gsal thol glu 'di: ma 'ongs rdo rje'i rig 'dzin rnams: dngos grub rnam gnyis thob phyir bstan: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: guhya: brda thim: gar dbang 'od gsal gl̥ng pas zab mo dgongs pa'i gter mdzod las phyung ba'o/ shubhaṃ: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: thun mong smin byed ye shes thig le bzhugs: dhī/: 'chi med rtsa gsum lha la 'dud: thun mong phung po rnam pa lnga: ye shes rnam lnga'i thig le ru: smin byed rigs mchog rnam lnga yi: rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po bstan: sa ma ya: dad dang brtson 'grus ldan pa yi: slob ma khrus byas gral la 'khod: bgegs phral srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom: lo rgyus mtshams sbyar maṇḍal 'bul: chas su gzhug cing gsol gdab ni: sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bdag cag 'khor ba las bsgral phyir: dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug par 'tshal: lan gsum rjes su slob dpon gyis: gsang ba bla med dkyil 'khor 'dir: smin pa'i dbang mchog don gnyer na: dbang srog dam tshig rgya mtsho'i gnas:

srog la babs kyang srung nus sam: zhes dris de yi lan btab pa: lha dang dbyer med slob dpon gyi: bka' bzhin rjes su sgrub lags kyi: so thar byang sems rig 'dzin kyi: sdom pas bdag rgyud gtams par mdzod: zhes gsol gnang ba sbyin pa ni : dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kun: rdo rje'i lam mchog 'di la brten: de phyir gsang chen dkyil 'khor 'dir: bu khyod 'jug cing smin par bya: zhes brjod skyabs sems 'bogs pa ni: mdun mkhar rtsa gsum rab 'byams lha: mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i mdun: gus pa chen pos 'khod pa'i blos: tshig 'di dag gi bzung du gzhug: na mo: bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun: deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar: bla ma dkon mchog rgya mtsho la: mi phyed gus pas skyabs su mchi: mar gyur rigs drug sems can rnams: sdug bsngal mtsho las bsgral bya'i phyir: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs nas: don gnyis bsgrub par sems bskyed do: lan gsum bar du nan tan dang : bsags sbyong spel ba'i rnal 'byor bya: khyad par sdom pa bzung ba ni: hoḥ rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang : rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni: deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar: nges par 'byung bas rgyud bskul nas: phyi nang gsang ba bla med pa'i: mchog gsum skyabs kyi snying por bzung : lus ngag yid kyis gzhan rnams la: gnod pa'i bsam sbyor yongs spongs shing : byams dang snying rje chen po'i blos: pha rol phyin pa drug la sogs: phan bde'i spyod pa rlabs chen spyad: ma bsgral bsgral dang ma sgrol sgrol: dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing : thams cad srid zhi las 'das pa'i: bla med byang chub dam par 'god: bder gshegs rdo rje rin po che: padma las kyi sdom pa dang : yan lag dam tshig nyi shu lnga: rtsa ba sku gsung thugs la sogs: rdo rje 'chang gi rgyud sde las:

sngags kyi 'dul bar gang gsungs pa: srog gi phyir yang mi gtong na: gtso bos bdag la bka' drin mdzod: lan gsum bar du khas blangs shing : gsang sngags nang gi sems bskyed bya: phyi ltar 'jug phyir gsol ba gdab: hoḥ smon pa tshad med rnam bzhi'i dngos: dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo phye nas: gnyis med 'jug pa'i byang chub sems: ye shes lha tshogs bstan tu gsol: lan gsum rjes su slob dpon gyis: bde chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: dga' bzhi'i ye shes gzugs 'chang ba: gang 'dul phrin las sgo ba bzhis: skal bar ldan rnams gzhugs par 'tshal: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ pra be sha ya phaṭa: ces brjod las kyi rdo rje yis: dkyil 'khor nang du 'khrid par mos: sku gsung thugs kyi phyag byas nas: nang ltar 'jug pa'i dang po ni: dam la bzhag pa rnam bzhi sbyin: hoḥ deng khyod rang snang dkyil 'khor cher: mchog tu gsang bas rab zhugs na: ye shes dngos grub thob 'gyur gyi: gzhan du smras na de ltar min: badzra gu hya sa ma ya hoḥ gnyis med ye shes rdo rje sems: khyod kyi snying dbus yang dag zhugs: tshul min smras na nyams par 'gyur: de bas gsang chen thub par gyis: badzra sa twa dzñā na sa ma ya āḥ rdo rje'i dam tshig bdud rtsi'i chu: 'thungs shig 'thungs shig sems dpa' che: dam tshig 'das na sreg byed cing : bsrung na dngos grub rnam gnyis thob: badzra a mṛ ta u da ka sa ma ya hoḥ deng nas khyod kyi he ru ka: rdo rje slob dpon nga yin gyi: ji ltar bsgo ba'i tha tshig las: nam yang 'da' bar ma byed cig: badzra sa ma ya rakṣantu: ye shes dbang phyir gsol ba gdab: hoḥ ram 'byams rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyi: rdo rje ye shes bde ba che: deng 'dir bdag la dbab nas kyang : byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol: slob ma lus gnad drang por bsrang : dam tshig lhar bskyed ye shes dbab: byin chen 'bebs pa'i rtags byung na: tiṣṭha badzra sa brtan par bya:

de nas me tog dor ba ni: hoḥ rang snang rnam dag 'og min du: bde chen rdo rje'i maṇḍa lar: rig pa'i me tog 'di dor bas: lhag pa'i lha la 'bab par shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta maṇḍal la puṣpe pra tītstsha ho: khyod ni bla med byang chub kyi: ye shes dam pa'i snod yin phyir: rdo rje'i dam tshig 'di zungs la: rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub par gyis: pra ti gṛhṇa i maṃ sa twa ma hā bā la: zhes brjod lhag lha spy-i bor bstim: sgrib gnyis mig ras bsal ba ni: e ma ho gdod nas rnam dag pa'i: dri med 'od gsal rdo rje'i spyan: glo bur 'khrul pas bsgribs pa'i mun: ye shes thur mas dbye bar bya: dzñā na tsakṣu pra be sha ya phaṭa: ces brjod dkyil 'khor blta bar bskul: ltos shig skal ldan rigs kyi bu: da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed: rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor 'dir: rdo rje'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur: he badzra sarba ta thā ga ta maṇḍa la pa shya hoḥ zhes bskul dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni: hoḥ ka dag gting gsal chos kyi sku: spros pa bral ba'i ye shes las: lhun grub 'od lnga'i zhing khams su: longs spyod yongs rdzogs 'khor lor shar: zung 'jug sprul pa'i rnam rol ni: lhag pa gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor 'dir: sa bcu lam lnga'i yon tan kun: ma btsal lhun gyis grub pa yi: thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang : yid 'ong nyams dga'i gnas mchog tu: sku dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i: rab 'byams rtsa gsum lha yi tshogs: snang la rang bzhin ma grub par: gang 'dul tshul gyis bzhugs pa rnams: mngon sum lta bur mthong ba'i blos: gnyis su 'dzin pa'i rtog pa spangs: thams cad rang snang nyid yin phyir: gnyis med ye shes chen por sbyor: phyi ru mtshon byed dkyil dang 'khor: nang ltar rdo rje phung po'i grong : gzhan du bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug pa'i: zab mo'i lam mchog la brten nas: rang byung lhun grub lus kyi dkyil:

rdo rje'i 'og min chen po'i klong : rtsa dag snang stong sprul pa'i sku: rlung dag bde stong longs spyod rdzogs: thig le 'od gsal chos skur shar: bcings grol med par khyod kyis mthong : badzra dzñā na sa ma ya hoḥ zhes brjod phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi: dkyil 'khor rnam dbye rgyas par bshad: rdo rje slob ma rnams kyis kyang : de nyid mngon sum mthong ba'i blos: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta maṇḍal dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ādma ko3ham̐ḥ lhar snang zhen med nga rgyal bzung : dad dang spro ba mchog tu bskyed: sa ma ya: dngos gzhi'i phan nus zab gsum las: dang po'i ched du gsol gdab ni: sangs rgyas kun 'dus rdo rje 'dzin: bdag la brtse bas nyer dgongs nas: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol:

zhes pas gsol gdab slob dpon gyi: thugs nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis: gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha: nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs par: mchod cing bstod nas gsol gdab pas: kun kyang dbang gi bya ba la: dgongs pa mngon du gtad par mos: dbang rdzas slob mar bcas pa yang : so so'i rigs kyi lhar gsal zhing : mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba'i slad: shis pa brjod pa sngon 'gro bas: thog mar bum pa spyi bor bskur: hūm̐: zhe sdang rnam dag rdo rje'i rigs: mi bskyod chu yi dbang bskur bas: rnam shes phung po rang grol nas: me long ye shes mngon gyur shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rin chen dbu rgyan bcings: hūm̐: nga rgyal rnam dag rin chen rigs: rin 'byung dbu rgyan dbang bskur bas: tshor ba'i phung po rang grol nas: mnyam nyid ye shes mngon gyur shogs: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐: thabs kyi rdo rje lag g.yas sbyin: hūm̐: 'dod chags rnam dag padma'i rigs: mtha' yas rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas: 'du shes phung po rang grol nas: sor rtogs ye shes mngon gyur shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta padma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: shes rab dril bu g.yon du gtad: hūm̐: phrag dog rnam dag las kyi rigs: don grub dril bu'i dbang bskur bas: 'du byed phung po rang grol nas: bya grub ye shes mngon gyur shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta karma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ rdor dril lhan gcig spyi bor bzung : hūm̐: gti mug rnam dag bder gshegs rigs: snang mdzad ming gi dbang bskur bas: gzugs kyi phung po rang grol nas: chos dbyings ye shes mngon gyur shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta buddha a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes brjod rdo rje'i ming yang gdags: so so'i dag pa ngo sprad cing : shis pa brjod pas mnga' gsol bya: de nas nus pa'i dbang mchog gis: rdo rje slob dpon bdag po che'i: go 'phang dam par 'god pa'i slad:

dpal ldan rig kun khyab bdag ches: phan pa'i dbang bkur stsal lags na: da ni nus pa 'jug pa'i dbang : ma lus bdag la stsal du gsol: lan gsum gsol ba gdab nas kyang : slob ma seng ge'i khrid la bzhag: mchod sprin rgya mtshos mdun bdar nas: lag tu rdo rje dril bu gtad: oṃ āḥhūm̐: thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa'i: rdo rje dril bu 'di zungs la: ye shes phyag rgyar mnyam sbyor ba'i: bde ba che la rtag tu rol: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba dang : dbyer med rdo rje 'dzin khyod kyis: gang 'dul 'gro kun sgrol bar mdzod: oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐: zhes brjod rdo rje snying gar gsor: oṃ ma hā gaṇḍe ho: zhes brjod dril bu 'khrol zhing bsten: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu rā ga ṇa dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ādma ko3ham̐: zhes brjod thugs kar 'khyud rgya bya: slar yang glegs bam dung la sogs: mnga' dbul yo byad kun sbyin la: hūm̐ hrī: bde chen thabs mchog rdo rje sems dpa' dang : shes rab stong nyid dbyings phyug snyems ma yum: dbyer med mnyam sbyor rdo rje'i slob dpon dbang : deng 'dir skal ldan khyod la sbyin pa yis: zab gsang rdo rje rtse mo'i nye lam gyi: chos kyi 'khor lo rtag tu bskor nas kyang : sna tshogs thabs kyis gdul bya ma lus kun: bde chen thar pa'i klong du dbugs dbyungs shig: ces brjod shis pa'i me tog gtor: de nas zab mo'i dbang gsum po: ye shes dpal ster ji bzhin la: spros dang 'brel na dkyil 'khor ba: yongs su rdzogs pa'i lha dbang bskur: so so'i sngags kyi rjes gnang dang : 'od gsal ye shes don ngo sprad: lung bstan dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod bya: sa ma ya: bla med rdo rje theg pa yi: lam gyi rtsa ba smin byed de: phan dang nus pa la brten nas: zab mo'i ye shes mngon du 'gyur: rgya rgya rgya: dha thiṃ: dhī/:

rtsa gsum 'od gal snying tig las: dbang bzhi ye shes dpal ster bzhugs: dhī/: dpal ldan sangs rgyas padma skyes: sku gsum dbyer med chen por 'dud: rdo rje theg pa'i gsang lam gyi: snying po dbang bzhi'i rim pa ni: dben pa'i gnas su stegs bu'i khar: phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dang : mchod pa'i yo byad bzang du bsham: dbang thob dam tshig la gnas shing : man ngag don ldan slob dpon gyis: bdag mdun dbyer med bsnyen cing bsgrub: thog mar rang nyid 'jug pa'i rjes: dad dang dam tshig skal ldan pa'i: slob ma khrus byas gral la 'khod: lo rgyus chos bshad maṇḍal 'bul: gsol ba gdab cing sdom gsum sbyin: dbang don ye shes nan tan phab: brtan par byas nas bum dbang ni: hūm̐ hrī: snang stong bum pa'i dkyil 'khor du: rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs shar: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: phung khams lha skur smin par shog: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: gnyis pa gsang ba'i bdud rtsi sbyin: hūm̐ hrīḥ e wam̐ zung 'jug dkyil 'khor nas: zhu bdes drangs pa'i kuṇḍa lī: skal ldan khyod la sbyin pa yis: rlung sngags dbu mar thim par shog: wa ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ gsum pa shes rab phyag rgya gtad: hrīḥ phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du: bde stong ye shes nyams myong phyir: sna tshogs gzugs can 'di gtad pas: thig le chos skur grol bar shog: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: snyoms 'jug dbab bzlog dga' bzhi bskyed: bzhi pa rtags kyi brdas mtshon te: āḥ ka dag gzhi yi dkyil 'khor du: lhun grub lam gyi snang ba gsal: gnyis su med par dbang bskur bas: chos zad 'bras bu mngon gyur shog: dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ khyad par can gyi snod rung la: dbyings dang rig rtsal don ngo sprad: sgrub pa'i glegs bam spyi bor bzhag: brgyud gsum byin rlabs dbugs dbyung bya: rjes su dbang srog dam tshig gi: rnam dbye rgyas par bshad pa dang :

bsdus te khas blang 'dzin du gzhug: maṇḍal 'bul zhing dge ba bsngo: dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang : rdo rje'i sgra yis shis pa brjod: sa ma ya: 'di ni thog mar dkyil 'khor cher: zhugs te smin pa'i slob ma la: rdo rje'i ye shes ngo sprod phyir: sbyin gyi rnam pa kun tu min: rgya rgya rgya: dha thiṃ: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: gtor dbang byin rlabs dpal ster bzhugs: dhī/: mtsho skyes thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang bskur ni: gnas skabs 'gal rkyen sel ba dang : phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub cing : mthar thug rnga yab dpal gyi rir: dbugs 'byin mchog gi go 'phang sbyin: sa ma ya: rtsa ba'i dbang bzhi dang 'brel na: rjes su gzengs bstod tshul du ste: 'di nyid kho nas smin pa'i tshe: bdag mdun dbyer med bskyed bzlas dang : sngon 'gro spy-i bzhin sbyar ba'i rjes: gtor ma lha ru shes pa'i ngang : gnas lngar phyag mtshan rnam pa lnga: yig 'bru'i mtshan pa'i 'od zer gyis: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: byin rlabs dngos grub thob par bsam: hūm̐ hrī: sku gsum bla ma thod phreng rtsal: yi dam yongs rdzogs he ru ka: mkha' 'gro'i ming po dpa' bo che'i: gsang gsum byin rlabs khyod la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya wā ka tsittā gu ṇa karma ba liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: spro na so sor dbang bskur zhing : rjes kyi rim pa gzhung bzhin bya: rgya rgya rgya: dha thiṃ: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: byin rlabs brda yi dbang bzhi bzhugs: dhī/: 'chi med sku gsum lha la 'dud: byin rlabs brda yi dbang bskur ni: dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i yo byad bshams: bdag mdun dbyer med bskyed bzlas bya: khyad par byin chen nan tan dbab: dbang thob dam tshig la gnas pa'i: slob ma khrus byas mdun du 'khod: 'jug pa spy-i bzhin sbyar ba'i rjes: dngos gzhi bum pa'i dbang bskur ni:

hūm̐: snod bcud yongs rdzogs bum pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: bde stong zung 'jug bdud rtsis dbang bskur bas: phung khams skye mched sgrib gnyis rang sar grol: sna tshogs gzugs can bum dbang mngon du gyur: gang 'dul chos ston gsang dbang nus pa smin: 'khor 'das kun khyab shes rab ye shes ngang : snang stong zung 'jug don dam bde ba che: 'gro 'dul sprul sku'i dbang mchog thob par shog: rtsa sngags dang : nirma kā ya dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ bum chu 'thor 'thung snying gar reg: bde gsal mi rtog rang nyams bskyang : de nas byang sems bhan dha thogs: hūm̐: chos dbyings rang byung bhandha'i dkyil 'khor nas: rig pa byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur bas: 'gro 'ong rlung gi sgrib gnyis rang sar grol: bum dbang ngo bo mtshan dpe'i phung por 'bar: gsang dbang brda yis gdul bya'i dri ma sel: shes rab ye shes srid zhi mnyam nyid ngang : bde stong zung 'jug kha sbyor bdun ldan pa'i: longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dbang mchog thob par shog: rtsa sngags dang : saṃ bho kā ya dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ sngar bzhin brda dbang rdzogs par bya: g.ya' bral dwangs pa'i me long thogs: hūm̐: gzhi dbyings spros bral gdod ma'i dkyil 'khor nas: gzhi snang rig pa ye shes dbang bskur bas: gzung 'dzin rtog tshogs sgrib gnyis rang sar grol: bum dbang nang gsal rtag chad mtha' las 'das: gsang ba'i dam tshig skye med nā da'i dbyangs: shes rab ye shes bsam brjod bral ba'i ngang : rig stong zung 'jug shin ku zhi ba'i dbyings: 'od gsal chos sku'i dbang mchog thob par shog: rtsa sngags dang : dharma kā ya dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ gnas gsum reg cing don ngo sprad: bde skyong snod du gtor ma thogs: hūm̐: mnyam nyid dag pa gzhi yi dkyil 'khor nas: glo bur sgrib bral 'bras bu'i dbang bskur bas: gnyis su 'dzin pa'i rtog pa rang sar grol: bum dbang chos nyid 'pho med klong du smin:

gsang dbang grags stong rdo rje'i sngags su rdzogs: shes rab so sor rtog pa'i ye shes klong : thams cad ro mnyam don dam bde ba che: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dbang mchog thob par shog: rtsa sngags dang : badzra kā ya dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ spy-i bor bzhag cing dngos grub sbyin: snying gar reg la nyams myong skyong : gtso bo yab yum sku brnyan thogs: hūm̐: thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: bde stong sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dbang bskur bas: srid dang zhi ba'i rtog tshogs rang sar grol: bum dbang yon tan lhun rdzogs rdo rje'i sku: gsang dbang rig pa byin rlabs tshangs pa'i gsung : shes rab ye shes mkhyen cha 'gag med thugs: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs 'od gsal gnyug ma'i klong : mngon par byang chub dbang mchog thob par shog: rtsa sngags dang : bho dhi kā ya dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ gnas gsum reg cing don ngo sprad: rjes kyi rim pa spy-i ltar bya: sa ma ya: rab 'byams rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs kyi: sku dang ye shes dbyer med pa: rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa'i: byin rlabs brda yi dbang bzhi 'di: lus rgya'i nang gi mgo bo ste: dbang po'i dwangs ma mig dang mtshungs: de phyir tshe 'di kho na la: byang chub thob par 'dod pa yi: snod ldan slob ma ma gtogs pa: gzhan du spel na bka' chad 'byung : ces gsung snying po'i rnal 'byor rnams: 'dir zhugs 'di yi don la spyod: zla drug lo gsum bcu gnyis na: zag bcas rdo rje'i lus su grol: rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub: dbang bzhi'i ye shes sku lngar smin: rgya rgya rgya: brda thiṃ: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: lha dbang ye shes char 'bebs bzhugs: dhī/: rtsa gsum kun 'dus padmar 'dud: tha mal 'khrul pa'i rtog tshogs kun: ye shes lha yi dkyil 'khor du: mngon par byang chub dbang bskur bas: dngos grub rnam gnyis myur du 'grub:

sa ma ya: phyi ltar padma thod phreng rtsal: bde gshegs yongs 'dus ngo bo nyid: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang bskur slad: thog mar gsol ba gdab pa ni: e ma rigs kun khyab bdag mchog: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bdag cag smin cing grol ba'i phyir: ye shes lha yi dbang bskur stsol: lan gsum: de nas bdag mdun dbyer med pa'i: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs so so las: sprul pa'i rnam rol dpag med 'phros: slob mar thim nas byin rlabs bsam: hūm̐ hrīḥ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: rtsa gsum kun 'dus thod phreng rtsal: yab yum gnyis med dbang bskur bas: bder gshegs yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hrīḥ spros bral chos sku'i dkyil 'khor nas: rigs kyi bdag po che ba'i mchog: kun bzang yab yum dbang bskur bas: dbang bzhi'i ye shes smin par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dharma kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hrīḥ snang stong dbyer med dkyil 'khor nas: 'jam dpal grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin: mañdzu mi tras dbang bskur bas: rtsa khams lha skur smin par shog: oṃ ma hā gu ru shā ri rāṃ mañdzu shrī mi tra āḥhūm̐: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hrī: grags stong dbyer med dkyil 'khor nas: rta mchog grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin: nā ga rdzu nas dbang bskur bas: srog rtsol sngags su smin par shog: oṃ ma hā gu ru shā ri rām̐ nā gā rdzu nā ā hūm̐: ka ya= hrīḥ rig stong dbyer med dkyil 'khor nas: yang dag grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin: hūm̐ chen kā ras dbang bskur bas: rtog tshogs chos sku smin par shogs: oṃ ma hā gu ru shā ri rām̐ hūm̐ kā ra āḥhūm̐ḥ kā ya= hrīḥ yon tan sna tshogs dkyil 'khor nas: bdud rtsi grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin: bi ma mi tras dbang = dga' bzh-i'i ye shes mngon gyur shog:

oṃ ma hā gu ru shā ri rām̐ bi ma la mi tra āḥhūm̐: kā ya= hrīḥ phrin las rnam bzhi'i dkyil= phur pa grub pa'i rig pa = pra chen hastis dbang = khams gsum dbyings su sgrol bar shog: oṃ ma hā gu ru shā ri rām̐ pra bha hasti āḥhūm̐ḥ kā ya= hrīḥ klong lnga dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor= ma mo grub pa'i rig pa= dha na saṃ kṛs dbang= snang srid sems su rdzogs par shog: oṃ ma hā gu ru shā ri rām̐ dha na saṃ kṛ ta āḥhūm̐: kā ya= hrīḥ dregs pa zil gnon dkyil= mchod bstod grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin: rambu gu hyas dbang bskur bas: gzung 'dzin 'byung po 'dul bar shog: oṃ ma hā gu ru shā ri rām̐ rambu guhya āḥhūm̐: kā ya= hrīḥ mngon spyod dmod pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: drag sngags grub pa'i= shāntiṃ garbhas dbang = gnyis snang dgra bgegs tshar gcod shog: oṃ ma hā gu ru shā ri rām̐ shāntiṃ garbha āḥhūm̐: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ hūm̐: bde chen 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du: mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid: 'jam dpal sku yi dbang bskur bas: gshin rje yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ a kṛ ta ka ya mānta ka ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: longs spyod 'khor lo'i dkyil= sor rtog ye shes ngo bo= padma gsung gi dbang= rta mgrin yongs rdzogs dbang thob= oṃ padmanta kṛta badzra kro dha hya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a bhi= hūm̐: chos kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil= me long ye shes ngo bo= yang dag thugs kyi dbang= khrag 'thung yongs rdzogs dbang= oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor nas: chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid: bdud rtsi yon tan dbang bskur bas: che mchog yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: bde skyong 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du:

bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid: rdo rje gzhon nus dbang bskur bas: phur pa yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: rdo rje nor bu'i dkyil= klong gyur ye shes ngo bo= bla med khrag 'thung dbang= ma mo yongs rdzaugs dbang = oṃ gu ya dzñā na shrī he ru ka gu ya dzñā na kro dhi shwa ri st+waṃ ma ma yo gi nī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: kā ya a= hūm̐: bde chen thabs kyi dkyil= dbyings grol ye shes ngo bo= dregs pa kun 'dul dbang = mchod bstod yongs rdzogs dbang = oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣtān hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a bhi= hūm̐: stong nyid shes rab dkyil 'khor nas: mtha' grol ye shes ngo bo nyid: stobs ldan nag pos dbang bskur bas: drag sngags yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra sarba duṣtān hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: gnas yul nyer bzhi'i dkyil= byang chub sems kyi thig le'i gzugs: dpa' bo mkha' 'gros dbang bskur bas: bde stong ye shes mngon gyur shog: oṃ ma hā su kha sarba ḍā ka ḍā ki nī hūm̐: kā ya a bhi= hrīḥ rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: zhi ba'i phrin las sgrub mdzad pa: badzra thod phreng dbang bskur bas: nad gdon 'jigs brgyad zhi bar shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru badzra thod phreng rtsal sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: rin chen rigs kyi dkyil= rgyas pa'i phrin las sgrub mdzad pa: ratna thod phreng dbang bskur bas: tshe bsod ye shes rgyas par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal sarba siddhi= kā ya= hrīḥ padma'i rigs kyi dkyil= dbang gi phrin las sgrub mdzad pa: padma thod phreng dbang bskur bas: khams gsum dbang du 'du bar shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal sarba siddhi= kā ya= hrīḥ las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor nas:

drag po'i phrin las sgrub mdzad pa: karma thod phreng dbang bskur bas: dgra bgegs 'byung po tshar gcod shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru karma thod phreng rtsal sarba= kā ya= hrīḥ bde byed brtsegs pa'i dur khrod du: ma chags skyon bral dngos grub brnyes: padma 'byung gnas dbang bskur bas: bde chen ye shes sku 'grub shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru padma kā ra thod phreng rtsal sarba= kā ya= hrīḥ bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du: yon tan sna tshogs dngos grub brnyes: padma saṃ bhās dbang bskur bas: don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru padma saṃ bhā ba sarba siddhi hūm̐ḥ kā ya a bhi= hrīḥ rā ga rakta'i gnas mchog tu: thams cad mkhyen pa'i dngos= blo ldan mchog sreg dbang = ji lta ji snyed mngon gyur shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru pra dzñā dzñā na sarba siddhi hūm̐: kā ya a bhi= hrīḥ dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod du: khams gsum dbang bsdud dngos grub brnyes: padma rgyal pos dbang bskur bas: rlung sems dbu mar thim par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru padma rā dza sarba siddhi hūm̐: kā ya a= hrīḥ so sa gling gi dur khrod du: 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dngos grub brnyes: nyi ma 'od zer dbang bskur bas: gang 'dul thabs la mkhas par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru sūrya rasmi sarba siddhi hūm̐: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hrīḥ za hor rgyal po'i yul dbus su: bdud 'dul drag po'i dngos= shākya seng ges dbang = nyon mongs bdud bzhi 'dul bar shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru shākya siṃ ha sarba siddhi hūm̐: kā ya= hrīḥ ma ga dhā yi grong khyair du: mu stegs 'dul ba'i dngos grub= seng ge sgra sgrogs dbang bskur bas: 'jigs tshogs lta ba 'joms par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru siṃ ha gaṇḍe sarba siddhi hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a= hrīḥ

stag tshang seng ge bsam grub tu: dregs pa 'dul ba'i dngos grub brnyes: rdo rje gro lod dbang bskur bas: gzung 'dzin 'byung po tshar gcod shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru kro dha gro bo lota lo ka sarba siddhi hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a= hūm̐ hrīḥ tshad med bzhi ldan dkyil 'khor nas: dbang chen rigs bzhi yab yum gyis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra kro dha ha ya grī wa ra tsa hrī ya ha ri ni sa sarba siddhi hūm̐ pha¿ṭa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ:

sa ma ya: ༈ dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: nang sgrub padma'i drwa ba bzhugs: dhī/: 'phags mchog snying rje'i lha la 'dud: nang ltar longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: padma drwa ba'i sgrub pa ni: dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas nyid du: maṇḍal zlum po bkod legs steng : mtshan ldan bhandha'i snod mchog tu: gsang rdzas ril bus gtams pa yi: kha gcod me long g.ya' bral ngos: sindhū ra yis chag chag gdab: rtsa sngags yi ge'i dkyil 'khor bkod: de steng zur mang shel rdor bcas: mtha' bskor phyi nang mchod pa dang : tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i longs spyod bsham: gzhan du rdo rje lus kyi dkyil: rang byung lhun grub chen por brten: sngon dngos rjes kyis nyams su blang : sa ma ya: sngon 'gro'i dang po skyabs 'gro ni: hrīḥ bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus kun: sku gsum 'phags pa'i lha la skyabs su mchi: mtha' klas srid pa'i khams rnams bsgral ba'i phyir: padma drwa ba'i go 'phang bsgrub par bgyi: lan gsum gnyis pa mtshams gcod ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang nyid dbang chen thugs nas 'phros pa yi: rdo rje rin chen padma rgya gram dang : 'khor lo me phung khro bo'i gur khang gis: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bgegs tshogs mtshams bcad gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gsum pa ye shes byin 'bebs ni: hūm̐ hrī: 'og min bde chen chos sku'i pho brang dang : lhun grub ye shes rang snang 'od lnga'i zhing : gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: sku gsum 'phags pa'i lha tshogs byin phob cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī hrīḥ gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī lo ke shwa ra badzra dzñā na sarba sa ma ya a be sha ya ā āḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bzhi pa mchod rdzas brlab pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: yul dang dbang po 'brel ba'i sred len kun: bde stong zung 'jug chen por mnyam sbyor ba'i: rol rtsal 'gags med kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin: mtha' klas nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lor shar:

oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas shapda'i bar dang rū pa: shapda: gandhe rā sa: sparṣe ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta sarba pū dza sa ma ye āḥ hūm̐: lan gsum brjod pas byin rlabs bya: sa ma ya: dngos gzhi'i dang po bskyed rim ni: phyag rgya sku yi rnal 'byor te: dbyings dang rig pa dbyer med las: zung 'jug sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal: hrīḥ gzhi dbyings ka dag 'od gsal chos sku'i ngang : gzhi snang rig pa lhun grub longs sku'i sprin: zung 'jug sprul pa'i rgyu mchog hrīḥdamar po: de nyid yongs gyur skad cig dran rdzogs su: phyi snod dag pa rab 'byams rdo rje'i grong : rang snang rnam dag yid 'ong po tā la: zhing khams rgya mtsho'i bkod pas mdzes pa'i gzhir: mtshan nyid kun rdzogs ngo mtshar gzhal yas dbus: rang rig bde gshegs yongs 'dus snying rje'i lha: sku mdog dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas padma'i phreng ba thugs kar 'dren: g.yon pas mnyam bzhag bdud rtsi'i tshe bum bsnams: pang du gsang ba ye shes ḍā ki ma: utpal thod 'dzin yab kyi mgul nas 'khril: dbang mdog bcu drug bde ba'i lang tshos mdzes: gnyis ka dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan: khro 'dzum chags nyams mtshan dpe'i 'od phung 'bar: zhabs gnyis rdo rje padma'i skyil krung gis: thabs shes zung 'jug pad nyi zla steng rol: spy-i bor gtsug tor nor bu'i 'khor lo ru: chags bral so sor rtog pa'i ye shes rtsal: rigs kyi bdag po chos sku snang mtha' yas: dmar po mnyam bzhag bdud rtsi'i lhung bzed bsnams: de ltar gsal ba'i rdo rje lus kyi dkyil: rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan grong khyer du: bde stong dbyer med ye shes sgyu ma'i sku: dbang chen rig lnga yab yum 'khril sbyor rol: thugs kar rdo rje dbang chen thugs dbus su: yid chos rnam dag kun bzang yab yum la: sum cu rtsa bzhi zhi ba'i lha tshogs dang : de yi rang rtsal bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus:

khrag 'thung dpal chen khro bo'i tshom bur bzhugs: phyi rol gyes pa'i padma'i gdan steng du: yi ge drug pa'i sngags kyi rang sgra las: rigs drug don mdzad bcom ldan thub pa drug: sprul sku'i chas rdzogs mtshan dang dpe byad ldan: ge sar zil phod rab tu rgyas pa'i rtser: stong nyid snying rje'i rig gdangs 'gags med rtsal: dus gsum bskal bzang sems dpa' stong rtsa gnyis: 'gro 'dul thugs rje chen po'i rnam par bzhengs: sgo bzhir bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng : phrin las lhun grub ḍā ki sde bzhi dang : gzhan yang phyogs dus sras bcas rgyal ba'i tshogs: ma 'dres gsal rdzogs nyid dang 'od zer tshul: dwangs ba'i mkha' la shar ba'i 'ja' tshon ltar: snang stong dbyer med chen po'i gnas gsum du: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjes rgyas gdab cing : nam mkha'i khams gang gdan gsum tshang ba'i lhas: ye shes rnam lnga'i ngo bo dbang bskur gyur: thugs ka'i hūm̐ 'od lcags kyu yis: rtsa gsum chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs: thugs rje chen po'i rnam rol tu: mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsam: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min padmo bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'chi med 'od snang mtha' yas gshegs su gsol: snang stong sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gzhal yas nas: 'phags mchog snying rje'i bdag nyid gshegs su gsol: gnas yul dur khrod drag po'i pho brang nas: dbang chen rigs lnga yab yum gshegs su gsol: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i zhing khams rab 'byams nas: sras bcas rgyal ba rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol: don dam 'gro 'ong mtshan ma las 'das kyang : 'gags med thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs: sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gsum du dbang bskur la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub byin chen phob: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī lo ke shwa ri sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dza: hūm̐ hrīḥ gdod nas chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i dbyings: rang snang rnam dag don gyi 'og min du:

chos kyi dbyings nas spyan drangs ye shes pa: gnyis med rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: hūm̐ hrīḥ ngo bo 'od gsal chos sku'i snying po las: rang bzhin bde stong longs spyod rdzogs skur shar: thugs rje sprul pa'i gar gyis 'gro ba 'dul: sku gsum 'phags pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: a ti pū ho: pra tītstsha ho: oṃ āḥhūm̐: snod bcud rdo rje gzugs sgra dri ro reg: snang srid sbyor sgrol zung 'jug sman gtor raka: 'khor 'das dbyer med gdod ma'i mchod sprin gyis: dus gsum dus med chen por mnyes gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī hrīḥlo ke shwa ri sa pa ri wā ra rū pa shapta gandhe rā sa sparṣe ma hā a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta dharma dhā tu pū dza hoḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ snang stong gdan gsum yongs rdzogs rdo rje'i sku: grags stong thabs shes ā li kā li'i gsung : rig stong spros bral 'od gsal gnyug ma'i thugs: bde stong zung 'jug dkyil 'khor lha la bstod: thog ma'i mgon po chos sku snang mtha' yas: stong nyid snying rje'i skur bzhengs spyan ras gzigs: sprul pa'i rnam rol dbang chen rigs mchog lnga: sku gsum 'phags pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: don dam chos dbyings snying por ro gcig kyang : kun rdzob zhi dang khro bo'i rnam rol can: snod bcud dag pa rdo rje'i 'og min che: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus kun la bstod: gnyis pa bsnyen cing sgrub pa ni: bzlas pa gsung gi rnal 'byor te: snying dbus dbang chen yab yum gyi: thugs kar pad nyi zla ba'i steng : hrīḥmathar sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor: 'od kyi phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod: byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rnam par byon: spy-i bo nas zhugs gnas bzhir babs: sgrib bzhi sbyangs shing dbang bzhi thob: slar 'phros 'gro ba'i las nyon sbyangs: phyi nang dag pa rab 'byams zhing : cir snang thugs rje chen po'i sku:

sgrar grags rdo rje'i sngags kyi sgra: dran rtog don gyi 'phags pa'i zhal: padma drwa ba'i klong du rdzogs: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: grangs kyi bsnyen pa bdun 'bum ste: dus bsnyen de yi bzhi 'gyur ro: mtshan ma rtags kyi rim pa ni: dngos nyams rmi lam ma nges par: zhal mthong gsung thos gdams pa thob: rang rig ka dag don dang 'phrad: rtsol med snying rje shugs kyis 'byung : sa ma ya: khyad par nang ltar sgrub pa ni: thugs srog las byung hrīḥyig phreng : yum gyi zhal zhugs padma nas: rdo rje nor bu'i lam brgyud de: snying kha'i chu skyes la chags pas: rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i: zag med bde bas tshim par bsam: gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs la dmig nas: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bho dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: hrī badzra kro dha hya gṛ ba ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa tsitta hrīṃ hrīṃ dza dzaḥ bder gshegs yongs rdzogs srog snying ni: 'byung 'jug gnas pa'i rlung la sbyar: grags stong rdo rje'i sngags kyi sgra: dus gsum dus med gcig tu bzla: hrīḥhrī hrīḥ thun mtshams mchod bstod dngos grub blang : nongs pa bshags shing ye shes gshegs: dam tshig 'od gsal 'khor lor bsdu: rjes thob sgyu ma'i lha sku'i ngang : stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug pas: phyin drug dge chos rgya mtsho sdud: sa ma ya: gsum pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni: 'od gsal thugs kyi rnal 'byor ste: lus ngag yid gsum sngon sbyangs nas: sbyor ba bzhi ldan rlung g.yos pas: lte ba'i gtum mo spar ba'i mes: gnas lnga'i rta phag yab yum bskul: bde stong sbyor ba'i byang chub sems: dbab bzlog 'bebs bskyil ye shes bsgom: de las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis: phyi nang snod bcud rim gyis sbyangs: rig rtsal ka dag ngang du bzhag: rjes thob snang ba sgyu mar blta:

gegs sel rdo rje'i 'khrul 'khor dang : bogs 'don las kyi phyag rgya la: snyoms par 'jug pas bde chen bsgrub: mthar thug phyag rgya chen po'i ngang : rang babs ye shes rlung sbyor bya: de ltar rtag tu brtson pa yis: phung khams 'ja' lus dwangs mar shar: gal te brtson 'grus stobs zhan na: 'chi tshe rlung sems dbyer med pa: rigs bdag bla ma'i thugs kar 'pho: bar do'i snang ba ci shar yang : bden med sgyu ma'i lha skur blta: sa ma ya: de ltar rnal 'byor gsum ldan gyis: 'phags mchog padma drwa ba yis: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dbyings: sbyor byed zab gzang lam mchog 'di: da lta mnga' bdag yab sras la: rgyud lung man ngag snying por bshad: ma 'ongs lnga brgya'i 'gro ba'i don: 'od gsal gsang ba'i sgrom bur sbas: rgya rgya rgya: dha thim: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: gsang sgrub 'od gsal drwa ba bzhugs: dhī/: 'chi med 'od mtha' yas la 'dud: gsang ba dbyings rig dbyer med pa: 'od gsal drwa ba'i sgrub pa ni: gangs khrod ri rtse nags tshal sogs: shin tu dben zhing yid mthun par: kun rdzob maṇḍal zlum po'i steng : rdo rje sems pa'i me long ngogs: 'od snang mtha' yas gzugs sku dang : mtha' skor sman rag gtor tshogs bsham: don dam rdo rje lus kyi sbubs: 'ja' tshon thig le'i dkyil 'khor la: sgo yul rlung gi gnad gcun pas: snang ba rnam bzhi'i go 'phang bsgrub: sa ma ya: dngos gzhir rdo rje'i mtshan nyid la: lus gnad rdo rje'i chos bdun dang : khregs chod ka dag rig rtsal las: lhun grub bskyed rdzogs dbyer med par: 'jug pa'i dang po skyabs sems ni: hrīḥ ka dag so sor rtog pa'i ye shes sku: 'chi med thog ma'i mgon por skyabs su mchi: lhun grub 'od gsal snang bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du: khams gsum 'gro kun sgrol bar sems bskyed do: lan gsum gnyis pa mtshams gcod ni:
