hrīḥ snang srid thams cad dag pa chos sku'i zhing : sgrar grags gzhom med rdo rje'i sngags su rdzogs: dran rtog gdod nas rang grol gnyug ma'i ngang : tha mal rnam par rtog pa mtshams bcad do: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra dzñā na rakṣa bhrūm̐: gsum pa ye shes byin 'bebs ni: hrīḥ ngo bo nang gsal gzhon du bum sku'i klong : rang bzhin rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor rab 'byams shar: thugs rje gang 'dul sprul pa'i rnam rol gyis: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin phob ye shes skyed: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra dzñā na a be sha ya ā āḥ bzhi pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos can 'gags med 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i sprin: zung 'jug bde chen rdo rjer byin rlabs pas: mi zad mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por gyur: oṃ ru pa shapda gandhe rā' sa sparshe dharmā dhā tu sarba pū dza āḥhūm̐: lnga pa dam tshig bskyed pa ni: hrīḥ stong nyid dbyings las ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul: snod bcud rnam dag padmo bkod pa'i zhing : rin chen sna tshogs gcal du bkram pa'i gzhir: nor bu'i brag ri 'dod 'byung ljon shing dang : yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsi'i rdzing bus mdzes: chos nyid mngon sum 'ja' zer thig le'i klong : nyams snang gong 'phel sna tshogs mchod sprin dang : rig pa tshad phebs dpa' bo ḍā ki'i tshogs: chos zad blo 'das rdo rje'i glu gar bsgyur: gang shar snang grags rig pa'i rtog tshogs kun: gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa dag pa'i rang rtsal las: rdo rje'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sogs: bde stong rol mor 'char ba'i zhing mchog dbus: mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs sprul pa'i gzhal med khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi yis brgyan: phyi gsal gnang gsal ye shes 'od lnga'i klong : chags bral padma thabs shes nyi zla'i steng : skad cig dran rdzogs chu las nya 'phar ltar: rang rig bde chen skur bzhengs snang mtha' yas: dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag steng :

'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams: mtshan dpe'i dbal 'bar chos gos rnam gsum gsol: thabs shes zhabs gnyis rdau rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: hrīḥ de ltar gsal ba'i rang byung lus kyi dkyil: phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad kun: gdod nas dag pa 'od gsal rdo rje'i grong : gzhi lam 'bras gsum rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas dbus: thugs ka chos kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du: dbyings rig zung 'jug kun bzang yab yum dang : phung po 'byung ba rang grol rigs mchog lnga: dbang yul dag pa sems dpa' sems ma brgyad: nyon mongs 'dul mdzad bcom ldan thub pa drug: rtog tshogs 'joms byed sgo ba yab yum ste: bder gshegs zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi lha: bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis snang stong 'od phung 'bar: de yi rang rtsal bde chen 'khor lo ru: kun tu bzang po che mchog he ru ka: yab yum gnyis med dga' bzhi'i rnam rol las: rigs lnga gnas yul dag pa'i phra men dang : 'bar ba'i dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad sogs: spros bral chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang : gdug pa 'dul phyir khrag 'thung rol pa'i sku: lnga bcu rtsa brgyad khro bo'i tshom bur bzhugs: mgrin par sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: rig 'dzin dpa' bo ḍā ki rgya mtshor bcas: ma bskyed rang byung yongs grub phyag rgya'i lha: zab gsal gnyis med 'ja' mtshon lta bur shar: gzhan yang rtsa rlung thig le ye shes khams: rab 'byams rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i ngo bor bzhugs: gnas gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rgyas gdab cing : bde stong kha sbyor bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ba'i: 'od kyis ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs gyur:

drug pa ye shes spyan 'dren ni: phyag rgya rnam bzhis bcing ba ni: hrīḥ ngo bo 'od gsal chos sku'i pho brang nas: 'chi med thog ma'i mgon po gshegs su gsol: rang bzhin bde stong longs sku'i gzhal yas nas: rab 'byams zhi khro'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: thugs rje 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i zhing khams nas: rig 'dzin ḍā ki rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol: ka dag gnyug ma'i ngang du byin phob la: lhun grub snang ba bzhi yi dbang mchog skur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī hrīḥbo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: badzra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ bdun pa brda phyag 'tshal ba ni: hrīḥ gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i mtshan ma las 'das pa'i: rig stong sems kyi rdo rje 'od mtha' yas: gdod nas gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang nyid du: mngon sum rang zhal mjal ba'i phyag gis 'dud: a ti pū hoḥ na ma dhī: brgyad pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dbyings rig zung 'jug chos nyid mngon sum klong : nyams snang gong 'phel phyi nang mchod pa'i sprin: rig pa tshad phebs don gyi lha la 'bul: chos zad blo 'das mchog gi dngos grub stsol: rū pa shapda gandhe rā sa sparshe ma hā sarba dharmā dhā tu pū dza hoḥ dgu pa bstod cing smon lam gdab: hrīḥ so sor kun tu rtog pa'i rig mdangs rtsal: zung 'jug bde chen rdo rje'i skur bzhengs pa: tshe dang ye shes dpag med bcom ldan 'das: kun bzang snang mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal bstod: gdod nas dag pa chos sku'i rang bzhin las: rigs brgya rigs lnga gsang chen rigs gcig sogs: gang 'dul zhing dang khro bo'i rnam rol can: gdan gsum yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor lha la bstod: snod bcud padmo bkod pa'i sku dang zhing : sgra grags yi ge drug pa rdo rje'i sgra: dran rtog dbyings dang rig pa dbyer med ngang : 'chi med mgon po tshe 'dir 'grub gyur cig:

bcu pa bsnyen cing sgrub pa ni: snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo yi: kun bzang yab yum thugs ka ru: bde stong nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor dbus: zung 'jug thugs srog hrīḥyig mthar: sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor ba yi: 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas: tshur 'dus phyi nang snod bcud sbyangs: thams cad 'od gsal thig le'i klong : dbyings rig dbyer med ngang nas bzla: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ 'dir ni sras bcas rgyal kun gyi: so sor rtog pa'i snying po ste: gang gis thos pa tsam gyis kyang : sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs chen rdzogs: rtag tu nyams su sus blangs na: dbang po'i rim pa dang 'tshams par: 'di'am 'chi khar bar ma dor: 'od snang mtha' yas go 'phang 'grub: sa ma ya: gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs sgrub pa ni: gzhi dbyings 'chi med snang mtha' yas: gzhi snang zhi khro rab 'byams lha: zung 'jug rig 'dzin ḍā k-i'i tshogs: rdo rje phung po'i grong du rdzogs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrī bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: don dam rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni: 'jug gnas ldang ba'i rlung khams kun: gsang sngags yi ge gcig tu shar: kha sbyor bde chen rdo rje'i sbubs: 'gro 'ong med pa'i srog tu 'grub: hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ skye med ka dag gnyug ma'i ngang : 'gags med snang bzhi'i rtsal rdzogs pas: blo 'das don gyi chos sku'i zhal: khyad chos drug ldan klong du mjal: sa ma ya: de ltar shin tu rnal 'byor gyi: zab gsang rdo rje'i lam gyi bcud: 'od gsal drwa ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs: tshe gcig 'pho chen dwangs ma'i skur: 'grub byed man ngag snying tig 'di: 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdau rje'i don: chos dbyings thugs kyi gter du sbas: 'gro don 'khor ba dong sprugs shog: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: yang gsang bla ma drag po yi dam dgongs 'dus kyi sgrub pa bzhugs so:

dhī/: 'chi med rtsa gsum lha la 'dud: bde gshegs kun 'dus thod phreng rtsal: yang gsang drag por sgrub pa ni: dben pa'i gnas su stegs bu'i khar: bsnyen phur mtshan nyid ldan pa dang : sman rag gtor tshogs mchod pa bsham: de nas bde ba'i stan nyid la: lus gnad ldan pas legs 'dug ste: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: hūm̐: bder gshegs kun 'dus thod phreng rtsal: padma drag por skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun byang chub thob bya'i phyir: bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug phrin las bsgrub: gnyis pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: phyi snod rdo rje'i gur khang la: nang bcud las kyi khro bo'i sku: sgrar grags gzhom med hūm̐ gi sgra: dran rtog 'od gsal chen por gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gsum pa byin 'bebs mchod rdzas brlab: hūm̐: ka dag chos sku'i pho brang nas: lhun grub gang 'dul sgyu ma'i sku: padma drag po'i skur bzhengs la: gnas 'dir byin phob dbang mchog skur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru padma kro dha a be sha ya ā āḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnas yul dur khrod drag po'i zhing : rab 'jigs bkod pa yongs su rdzogs: phyi nang gsang mchod 'dod yon sprin: 'phel 'grib bral ba'i rgyan du gyur: oṃ sarba pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐: bzhi pa bskyed rim bsgom pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun: gdod nas spros bral de bzhin nyid: kun snang snying rje khros pa'i rtsal: rgyu yi ting 'dzin yi ge hūm̐: de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod: sde brgyad 'byung po brlag cing gzir: 'gro kun sgrib sbyangs snod dang bcud: 'og min padma brtsegs pa'i zhing : rab 'jigs dur khrod 'bar ba'i klong : drag po'i gzhal yas mtshan nyid rdzogs: de dbus rang rig hūm̐ dmar nag: yongs gyur skad cig dran rdzogs su: dregs pa pad nyi zla ba'i steng : dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i:

bde gshegs kun 'dus che ba'i mchog: 'jigs byed padma he ru ka: dmar smug zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: g.yas pas rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar: rtse las sprul pa'i lcags sdig 'phro: g.yon pas phur pa bgegs la gzir: dpal dang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs tshul gyis bzhugs: shes rab dbyings phyug khros pa'i yum: rdo rje dung khrag bsnams pas 'khril: gar dgu'i gzi byin mchog tu 'bar: bde chen 'khor lo'i gzhal yas dbus: kun bzang rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: rang 'od rig mar mnyam par sbyor: rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor: mgrin par 'ja' zer thig le'i klong : khrag 'thung padma badzra rtsal: mandā ra ba yum dang sbyor: 'khor du khrag 'thung gtso bos bskor: thugs kar che mchog he ru ka: mthing nag nyi shu rtsa gcig dbu: bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis phyag dang ldan: zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi lha: bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis phyag mtshan bsnams: yum mchog bco brgyad phyag ldan pa: dang po'i rdo rje dung khrag gis: bde chen yab kyi mgul nas 'khril: lhag ma gnas yul phra men bsnams: tshogs brgyad dag pa'i rtsa 'dabs su: dpal chen sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha: sprul dang yang sprul bcas pa bzhugs: lte bar las kyi phra men ma: ye shes ḍā ki sde lnga la: phyi nang gnas yul dur khrod kyi: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs: gsang gnas mthing nag e yi klong : chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud tshogs: gnyis med yongs rdzogs ma ning nag: phyag gnyis ru mtshon snying zhags bsnams: 'khor du rgyud gsum dregs pa'i sde: ma lus lus pa med pas bskor: gzhan yang ba spu'i bu ga nas: ye shes khyung gi tshwa tshwa 'phro: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum du: rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo nyid: oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing las: 'od zer dpag yas rab 'phros pas: ye shes lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: lnga pa ye shes spyan 'dren ni:

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: yul gyi ming ni rnga yab gling : gnas mchog zangs mdogs dpal gyi ri: dur khrod drag po'i gzhal yas nas: o rgyan padma thod phreng rtsal: khrag 'thung khro bo'i skur bzhengs shig: snyigs dus dam 'gong tshar gcod phyir: mos shing gdung bas spyan 'dren na: thugs rje'i dbang gis gshegs nas kyang : sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du sbyor: gzung 'dzin 'byung po dbyings su sgrol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru padma kro dha sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dza dza: drug pa bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni: hūm̐: gdod nas 'od gsal dbyings kyi lha: 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pa'i phyir: dam tshig ye shes dbyer med par: rang zhal mjal ba'i phyag gis 'dud: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho: na ma dhī: bdun pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dug gsum dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs: ye shes dbyings su bsgral ba las: byung ba'i 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i gter: kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru padma kro dha sa pa ri wā ra rū pa shapda gandhe rā sa sparshe sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta sta na gha na ma hā su kha sarba pū dza ho: brgyad pa rdo rje'i glu yis bstod: hūm̐: 'od gsal chos sku'i ngang nyid las: gar dgu'i rnam rol longs spyaud rdzogs: gdug pa 'dul mdzad sprul pa'i sku: bde gshegs yongs 'dus lha la bstod: dgu pa dzab kyi dgongs pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid drag po'i thugs ka ru: kun bzang che mchog he ru ka'i: thugs dbus padma nyi zla'i steng : rdo rje rtse dgu'i lte bar hūm̐: mtha' bskor sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor: de las 'bar ba'i 'od zer dang : las kyi khro bo'i tshogs spros pas: dus gsum rgyal ba mchod pas brnyes: khams gsum 'gro kun sgrib gnyis sbyangs: sde brgyad 'byung po brlag cing gzir: snang ba lha la grags pa sngags:

dran rtog ka dag gnyug ma'i ngang : rang graul mngon sum rig pa'i lha: padma drag po'i klong du rdzogs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru padma kro dha artsig nirtsig sarba siddhi hūm̐ pha¿ṭa: grangs kyi bsnyen pa bye ba ste: dus bsnyen de yi rig pas dpag: grub pa'i mtshan ma dngos nyams dang : rmi lam drag po'i zhal mthong zhing : gsung gis rjes su gnang ba thob: sde brgyad 'byung po 'dar zhing 'dud: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlob: mchog thun dngos grub dbang du 'gyur: sa ma ya: lus kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas: rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs bsgrub pa ni: slar yang thugs srog hūm̐ yig las: 'od zer sngags kyi tshul du 'phros: 'khor lo rnam lnga'i lha tshogs bskul: snyoms par zhugs pa'i reg bya yis: bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi rgyun: so so'i gnas bzhi'i padmor son: bde stong dga' bzhi'i dbang mchog thob: byang sems hūm̐ gi sprin 'phros pas: 'phags mchod 'gro kun sgrib gnyis sbyangs: gang 'dul phrin las lhun gyis grub: snang srid gzhir bzhengs he ru ka'i: dkyil 'khor gcig tu lhun rdzogs gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru ma hā kro dha padma kro dhī shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la rū pa karma ram̐ ram̐ dzwa la ram̐ sarba ḍā ki nī hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ pha¿ṭa: ces bzlas bde stong thig le'i sbubs: mngon sum rig pa'i don la blta: gzung 'dzin las 'das 'od gsal ngang : rtsa gsum lha tshogs rang la shar: sa ma ya: khyad par dus gsum dus med du: bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gnad kyi gzer: phrin las rnam bzhi myur 'grub pa'i: yang gsang hūm̐ gi bzlas pa ni: bdag nyid bder gshegs yongs rdzogs kyi: thugs las 'od 'phros hūm̐ du gyur: sku yi dbyibs brgyud zhal nas thon: snang srid snod bcud thams cad kun: hūm̐ yig til gong kha phyes ltar: mtha' klas sngags kyi rang sgra sgrogs:

de nyid yongs gyur skad cig gis: padma drag po rigs lnga'i skus: brtan g.yo'i dngos po thams cad kun: 'od zer rnam lnga'i 'phro 'du yis: nad gdon sgrib gnyis dbyings su zhi: tshe bsod dpal 'byor yon tan rgyas: khams gsum snod bcud dbang du 'dus: byad phur gdon bgegs brlag cing gzir: thams cad ka dag chen por shar: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mthar thug rim gyis hūm̐ la bsdu: de yang mi dmigs stong gsal ngang : rang rig ye grol gnyug ma'i gshis: bcas bcos spro bsdu med par bzhag: rnam par rtog pa gang skyes kyang : hūm̐ zhes thad kar gcod pa'i ngang : sngar bzhin 'od gsal sbubs su 'jug: bskyed pa de yin rdzogs pa'ang de: phrin las rnam bzhi de'i ngang 'grub: mthar thug padma 'od kyi zhing : dbugs 'byin 'di la the tshom med: sa ma ya: bde gshegs yongs 'dus thod phreng rtsal: padma drag por sgrub pa'i thabs: zab bcud snying por dril ba 'di: ma 'ongs lnga brgya'i tha ma ru: mtha' bzhi'i 'byung pos bod khams khengs: thams cad de la skyabs song bas: mi bzad sdug bsngal gsum gyis mnar: dkon mchog bstan pa'i lhags zhabs sdud: de yi tshe na bdag nyid kyis: byin rlabs sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa: zung 'jug sprul pa'i rdo rje'i don: klong gsal thugs kyi sgrom bur sbas: nam zhig rten 'brel dus babs tshe: bar chad bdud dpung 'dul bar shog: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: zhes pa'ang 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rjes rang lo bcu drug par rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi byin rlabs la brten nas zab mo dgongs pa'i gter las phyungs te gtan la phabs pa ring du gsang zhing dus su babs pa'i tshe rnam snang lo tsā ba chen po'i sgyu 'phrul rgyal bas lung bstan blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sder phul ba 'gro kun bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal te dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi dga' ston la longs su spyaud pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/maṅgalaṃ/ dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsol snying tig las: rig 'dzin rtsa rgyud ye shes drwa ba bzhugs: rgya gar skad du: shrī dzña na dzwa la tanta nā ma: bod skad du: dpal ye shes drwa ba'i rgyud ces bya ba: bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo: 'og min padma drwa ba ru: 'od snang mtha' yas ston pa yis: lag na chu skyes la sogs pa'i: 'khor la dus gsum dus med dus: rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig bstan tshe: padma'i spyan gyis slar gsol ba: e ma nges pa don gyi rgyud: snying por bsdu naji ltar lags: zhes gsol dpag med mgon po yis: chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: gzhi dbyings ka nas dag pa'i klong : gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa las 'das kyang : gzhi snang thugs rje'i 'char tshul la: gnyis 'dzin dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyams: de slad smin cing sbyang ba'i phyir: dbang bskur nges pa'i lam la 'jug: 'da' bar dka' ba'i sa ma ya: rtsa ba yan lag srog bzhin bsrung : chos sku skye med snang mtha' yas: longs sku 'phags mchog snying rje'i lha: sprul sku padma thod phreng rtsal: bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug tshul du bsgrub: bde stong 'od gsal dbyings rig don: thig le gcig gi sbubs su 'jug: gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis spyod: gzhi la lam gyis mtshams sbyar bas: 'bras bu sku bzhi dbyer med pa: ye shes phrin las bsam mi khyab: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rjer smin: de skad ston pa kun bzang gis: byung dang 'byung 'gyur snod ldan la: gsang ba'i snying po 'di gdams pas: thams cad ye shes gcig tu smin: sa ma ya: bskyed rdzogs gsum gyi tant+ra ni: 'bum phrag kun gyi yang snying mchog: 'phags mchog bde stong snying rje'i glus: padma thod phreng bdag la gdams:

rgya rgya rgya: dha thim: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: rtsa gsum sgrub thabs lung gi dum bu bzhugs: dhī/: 'phags mchog snying rje'i lha la 'dud: bkra shis rang byung brag gi phug: mā ra ti ka'i gzhal yas su: padma drwa ba yab yum gyis: o rgyan bdag la dbang bskur zhing : byin rlabs rdo rje'i tshig 'di bstan: sa ma ya: chos rnams kun gyi de nyid ni: bsam brjod las 'das gnyug ma'i dbyings: rig pa 'od gsal sbubs su 'jug: bcings grol med par ye sangs rgyas: snang ba 'chi med mtsho skyes lha: stong pa mandā ra ba yum: zung 'jug yi dam yongs 'dus pa: bla ma drag po'i sku ru 'grub: snang grags rig pa lha dang sngags: chos sku rtsa gsum 'dus par blta: bcos min mos shing gdung ba'i blos: gsol 'debs tshig 'di yang yang bzla: hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: padma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal de ba ḍā ki nī badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: 'dis ni snang srid sgyu mar 'char: rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobasaḥ mchog thun dngos grub dbang du 'du: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub: de phyir ma 'ongs skal ldan kun: snying por dril la nyams su longs: zhes gsungs thig le chen por gshegs: rgya rgya rgya: dha thim: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying thig las: man ngag 'ja' lus rdo rje'i tshig rkang bzhugs: dhī/: rtsa gsum kun 'dus thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: 'khor 'das chos kun gdod nas rnam dag kyang : gnyis 'dzin glo bur 'khrul pa sbyang ba'i phyir: thun mong khyad par bla med lam mchog 'di: rang byung mtsho skyes rdo rje bdag gis bstan:

sa ma ya: dbang thob dam tshig la gnas rnal 'byor pas: gangs khrod ri rtse mtsho gling nags tshal sogs: shin tu dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas mchog tu: gcig pur bde ba'i stan la bag phabs te: dal 'byor lus 'di yang yang rnyed dka' zhing : myur du mi rtag 'chi bas rgyud bskul nas: dkar nag las 'bras blang dor 'bad pa dang : 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dran pa'i nges 'byung bsgom: bdag gzhan byang chub bar du bslu med skyabs: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la skyabs su 'gro: tshad med byams dang snying rje chen po'i blos: smon 'jug don dam byang chub sems mchog bskyed: gsang chen rigs gcig bla ma rdor sems kyi: stobs bzhi'i rnal 'byor ldan pas sdig ltung bshags: kun rdzob don dam dbyer med chos sku'i dbyings: sku gsum mchod pa'i sprin gyi maṇḍal 'bul: khyad par byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni: bcos min mos gus drag pos gnad du bsnun: dbang bzhi blangs shing thugs yid gnyis med bsre: mngon sum lhug pa'i ye shes de ru 'char: ting 'dzin gsum gyis bskyed pa'i mngon byang gis: 'chi med padma thod phreng lha tshogs bsgom: skad cig bde stong zung 'jug sgyu ma'i skus: 'phags mchog snying rje chen po'i gzugs su sgrub: ma bskyed ye rdzogs chos sku'i ting 'dzin gyis: 'od snang mtha' yas dkyil 'khor rang la shar: thun gcig lha yi gsal snang tshad du 'don: thun gcig rang bzhin med pa'i rgya yis gdab: thun gcig zung 'jug dbyer med nga rgyal bsgom: thun gcig bskyed rdzogs ro mnyam dgongs pa'i ngang : sgrar bcas sgrar med bde chen rdo rjer bzlas: lus sbyong rnam pa nyi shu'i 'khrul 'khor dang : ngag sbyong 'bru gsum rdo rje'i bzlas pa ste: yid sbyong phyi nang gsang ba'i stong ra bsgom: srog rtsol kha sbyor rlung gi rnal 'byor dang : yas babs mas brtan 'bar 'dzag bde drod spel:

mthar thug rim bsdus 'od gsal ngang du bzhag: rjes thob nyin mtshan sgyu ma'i lha skur ldang : dngos yid phyag rgya'i lam gyis bogs 'byin bya: sgo gsum zhen log shin tu sbyangs pa la: sems bral rig stong rjen pa ngo sprad cing : bcas bcos spro bsdu bral ba'i mnyam bzhag ngang : rnal 'byor bzhi yis nyams len srang du gzhug: lhun grub sgo yul rlung rig gnad gcun pas: chos nyid mngon sum 'ja' zer thig le'i klong : nyams snang gong 'phel sprul sku'i tshom bur 'char: rig pa tshad phebs dag pa rab 'byams kyis: chos zad blo 'das go 'phang mngon du 'gyur: gal te tshe 'dir grub mtha' ma snyogs na: 'chi tshe rig stong 'od gsal sbubs su 'jug: rlung sems dbyer med hrīḥyi rnam par 'pho: bar do rnam gsum sku gsum lam du khyer: sa ma ya: thun mong grub pa brgyad dang phrin las bzhi: rnam smin tshe dbang phyag chen rig 'dzin thob: bde stong mdud grol blo bral gnyug ma'i klong : sku dang ye shes phrin las 'bras bu 'grub: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: thams cad lhun grub buddha thod phreng rtsal gyi sgos sgrub bzhugs: dhī/: rtsa gsum yongs 'dus lha la 'dud: phrin las thams cad lhun grub cing : mchog gi go 'phang thob 'dod na: buddha thod phreng bsgrub par bya: sa ma ya: de la sngon dngos rjes gsum las: sngon 'gro skyabs sems tshogs bsag dang : bgegs bskrad srung mtshams byin chen dbang : mchod pa byin rlabs tshul bzhin bya: sa ma ya: dngos gzhir dang po dam tshig pa'i: dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: de bzhin nyid dbyings dmigs med snying rje'i tshul: zung 'jug rgyu yi sa bon oṃ dkar gsal: de las 'od 'phros snod bcud dngos 'dzin sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las 'byung rim ri rab rtser: rdo rje'i srung 'khor me phung 'bar ba'i klong :

bhrūm̐ las rin chen gzhal med khang chen po: mtshan nyid kun rdzogs snang stong 'od 'bar dbus: sna tshogs padma 'dab bzhi'i lte ba ru: glang pos btegs pa'i rin chen mdzes khri dang : thabs shes zung 'jug nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng : oṃ yig yongs gyur buddha thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog dkar gsal zhi 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum gzi 'od 'bar: phyag g.yas 'khor lo dkar po thugs kar gtod: g.yon pas 'khor los yu ba byas pa yi: rigs kyi dril bu dkur bsten yum la 'khyud: rus pa'i phyag rgya drug gis rab tu spras: dar dang rin chen rgyan rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs: yum mchog 'khor lo dril bu bsnams pas 'khril: rig 'dzin bla ma bye ba'i sprin phung 'phro: 'dab bzhir dbang chen rta mchog rigs bzhi las: 'dir ye shes sems dpa' buddha rta mgrin dang : phyogs bzhir badzra rta mgrin sogs yin la: rig gzhan la des 'gre ste: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la ye shes sems dpal badzra rta mgrin: buddha rta mgrin shar 'dab la bkod dgos pa sogs shes par bya'o: rab 'byams yi dam zhi khro'i phyag rgya shar: sgo bzhir rig 'dzin dpa' bo yab yum la: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor: kun kyang spy-i mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjes rgyas gdab cing : ye shes dbang bskur rigs kyi cod pan 'chang : thugs ka'i 'od kyis lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: gnyis pa ye shes spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang rig lhun mnyam mtha' dbus med pa'i dkyil: ye shes bzhi 'phro 'khor lo'i tshul 'chang ba: bsam yas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i skur ston pa: rtsal snang dbyings nas rol zhing gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru de ba dhā ki nī sarba dzñā na maṇḍa la badzra sa ma ya dza: gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang snang dam tshig sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor du:

rig rtsal dbyings nas spyan drangs ye shes lha: chu la chu bzhag sgyu ma ji bzhin du: gnyis med brtan bzhugs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: badzra dzñā na sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: bzhi pa brda yi phyag 'tshal ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rig stong gdod nas skye med chos sku'i dbyings: ye shes rang rtsal gzugs sku'i rnam par shar: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs la: mi phyed gus pas brda yi phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra tī tstsha hāo: lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis mngon sprul pa'i: phyi nang gsang ba rmad byung mchod pa'i sprin: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul: bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub char ltar phob: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru de ba dhā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas rū pa shapda gandhe rā sa sparshe pra tī tstsha swā hā: ma hā su kha dzñā na pū dza ho: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta ga ṇa tsa kra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: drug pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: ma bcos spros bral chos sku'i ngang nyid las: longs spyod yongs rdzogs sprul pa'i sprin phung 'phro: thugs rjes 'gro 'dul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: gus pa bstod do mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bdun pa bzlas pa bya ba las: dang po bsnyen pa'i dgongs pa ni: thugs kar pad nyi dregs pa'i gdan gyi steng : ye shes sems dpa' buddha rta gdong zhal: dkar smug 'khor lo'i gri gug thod phrag 'chang : gar dgu'i gzi 'bar rang 'od yum dang sbyor: dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs zung dor stabs 'gying : de yi thugs dbus nyi zla kha sbyor sbubs: oṃ mthar sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis: 'phags pa mchod cing 'gro kun sgrib gnyis sbyangs: tshur 'dus rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi: byin rlabs dngos grub ye shes rang la thim: mchog thun phrin las lhun gyis grub par gyur:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru buddha thod phreng rtsal sarba siddhi hūm̐: 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas grub gnyis thob: de nas sgrub pa'i dgongs pa ni: slar yang thugs srog sgrub pa'i sngags kyi phreng : rang sgra sgrogs bzhin bskor las 'od zer 'phros: snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang lhar gyur cing : sgra grags sngags la dran rtog 'od gsal dbyings: snang srid gzhir bzhengs dag pa rab 'byams dang : ye shes chen po'i nus stobs rdzogs par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru buddha thod phreng rtsal badzra sa ma ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ ā: 'bum phrag bzlas pas dngos grub thob: tha mar las la sbyar ba ni: thugs srog sngag las 'od zer 'ja' tshon ltar: kha dog lnga ldan phyi nang kun tu 'phros: zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun lhun grub cing : mchog tu mi 'gyur ye shes rtsal rdzogs bsam: sgrub pa'i sngags kyis thog drangs nas: oṃ sarba karma dzñā na siddhi hūm̐: khri yis las kun lhun grub 'gyur: sa ma ya: gsum pa rjes kyi las rim la: tshogs kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskang : gtang rag mchod bstod dngos grub gsol: nongs pa bshags shing lhar snang bsdu: zung 'jug skur ldang bsngo smon dang : shis pa brjod pas mthar dbyung ngo : sa ma ya: khyad par mchog gi las sbyor ni: sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga: rtsa ba brgyad dang yan lag stong : ji ltar tshogs pa'-i bdud rtsi la: sel med a mṛ ta yis bran: mtshan ldan thod pa kha sbyor gzhug: drod 'bebs sbyor ba dang bcas mdun: sman rag gtor tshogs mchod rdzas dgram: phrin las gzhung bsrang sngon 'gro bas: bye brag ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud ni: āḥ stong gsal ngang las rlung me thod sgyed steng : chos kyi dbyings mnyam ye shes ka pā lar: bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zhu zhing khol ba'i dbus: bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal brtan las: ye shes dkyil 'khor gnyis pa mdun du spros:

me ri 'dabs 'byor tshul gyis bzhugs pa la: rang gi thugs nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis: thugs dam rgyud bskul lha tshogs snyoms par zhugs: bde ba'i sgra dang ye shes 'od snang gis: 'khor 'das bcud dang dwangs ma dge mtshan dang : khyad par rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi: bde chen ye shes bdud rtsi'i rnam par bsdus: rdzas la thim pas mthong tshor myong reg kun: rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzi byin 'bar: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī ā: mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: badzra a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrī ṭha: khri bzlas grol ba gzhi ldan gyi: dngos grub mchog gi rdzas su 'gyur: mthar ni lha rnams bcud la bstim: dngos grub blangs shing gzhan la'ang sbyin: rig 'dzin mchog dang skal mnyam pa'i: mchog thun grub pa rgyas par bsam: sa ma ya: de ltar bskyed bzlas zab mo'i don: nyams su len pa'i snod ldan phyir: rim pa dbang gi cho ga ni: dben pa'i gnas su maṇḍal dang : dbang rdzas mchod gtor tshogs mchod bsham: bdag mdun dbyer med bsgom bzlas dang : bum pa tshul bzhin bsgrubs nas kyang : tshogs mchod skong bshags sngon 'gro bas: snod ldan slob ma khrus nas dbyung : bgegs bsal srung ba'i 'khor los bcing : maṇḍal 'bul zhing gsol gdab bya: hoḥ dkyil 'khor gtso bo rigs kun bdag: thugs rje'i gter chen slob dpon gyis: lhun grub rigs gzhan la zhi mdzad rdo rje thod phreng sogs tshigs kha bsgyur ro/ mchan/ buddha thod phreng gi: smin grol dbang mchog stsal du gsol: zhes gsol rgyud sbyangs skyabs sems tshogs bsags sdom bzung*/ lhar bskyed la: ye shes dbab cing brtan par bya: de nas bum pa spyi bor bzhag: oṃ: bum pa bzang po yon tan kun gyi gter: lha tshogs 'od zhu bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis btams: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: buddha thod phreng sku yi dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru buddha thod phreng rtsal kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ:

sngags kyi phreng ba mgrin par bzhag bzlas lung spy-i ltar bya: āḥ sgra yi snying po bsnyen sgrub phrin las kyi: bzlas pa'i nus rdzogs sngags kyi phreng ba yis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: buddha thod phreng gsung gi dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru buddha thod phreng rtsal wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ me long gsal bstan ngo sprod gdab: hūm̐: stong gsal rang rig 'dus ma byas pa'i don: brda yi mtshon pa ye shes me long gis: skal ldan rigs kyi buu la dbang = buddha thod phreng thugs kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru buddha thod phreng rtsal tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dpal gyi gtor ma spy-i bor bzhag: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ gtor snod rang byung gzhal med khang chen po: gtor ma'i ngo bo lha dang gnyis su med: skal ldan rig kyi bu la dbang= buddha thod phreng ye shes dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī badzra gu ru buddha thod phreng rtsal kā ya wā ka tsitta dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī:

khyad par mtha' rtain a mṛ ta'i: bhandha kha sbyor spy-i gtsug bkod: hūm̐: bkra shis mtshan ldan rdo rje kā pa la: ye shes 'dud rtsi'i bcud kyis rab tu gtams: skal ldan rigs kyi buu la dbang : grol ba bzhi ldan phrin las mthar phyin shog: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: badzra a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrī ṭha: sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: rjes su shis par bya ba dang : dam tshig khas blang gtang rag gi: maṇḍal sogs spy-i ltar bya: gsang ba chen po'i snod du 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu hya: dha thim: gar dbang 'od gsal gling pas zab mo dgongs pa'i gter las phyung ba'o: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: zhi ba'i las mdzad rdo rje thod phreng rtsal gyi sgos sgrub bzhugs: dhī/: rtsa gsum yongs 'dus lha la 'dud: nad gdon 'jigs brgyad sdig ltung sogs: mi mthun 'gal rkyen zhi 'dod na: rdo rje thod phreng bsgrub par bya: sa ma ya: de la sngon dngos rjes gsum las: sngon 'gro las bdun tshul bzhin bya: dngos gzhir dang po dam tshig pa'i: dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: de bzhin nyid dbyings dmigs med snying rje'i rtsal: zung 'jug rgyu yi sa bon oṃ dkar gsal: de las 'od 'phros snod bcud dngos 'dzin sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las 'byung rim ri rab rtser: rdo rje'i srung 'khor me phung 'bar ba'i klong : bhrūm̐ las rin chen gzhal med khang chen po: mtshan nyid kun rdzogs snang stong 'od 'bar dbus: sna tshogs padma 'dab bzhi'i lte ba ru: seng ges btegs pa'i rin chen mdzes khri dang : thabs shes zung 'jug nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng : hūm̐ yig yongs gyur rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog mthing gsal zhi 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga thugs kar gtod: g.yon pas rdo rjes yu ba byas pa yi: rigs kyi dril bu dkur bsten yum la 'khyud: rus pa'i phyag rgya drug gis rab tu spras:

dar dang rin chen rgyan rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs: yum mchog rdo rje dril bu bsnams pa 'khril: rig 'dzin bla ma bye ba'i sprin phung 'phro: 'dab bzhir dbang chen rta mchog rigs bzhi las: rab 'byams yi dam zhi khro'i phyag rgya shar: sgo bzhir rig 'dzin dpa' bo yab yum la: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor: kun kyang spyi mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjes rgyas gdab cing : ye shes dbang bskur rig kyi cod pan 'chang : thugs ka'i 'od kyis lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: gnyis pa ye shes spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐ hrī: rang rig lhun mnyam mtha' dbus med pa'i dkyil: ye shes bzhi 'phro 'khor lo'i tshul 'chang ba: bsam yas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i skur ston pa: rtsal snang dbyings nas rol zhing gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru de ba dhā ki nī sarba dzñā na maṇḍal la badzra sa ya dza: gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: rang snang dam tshig sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor du: rig rtsal dbyings nas spyan drangs ye shes lha: chu la chu bzhag sgyu ma ji bzhin du: gnyis med brtan bzhugs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: badzra dzñā na sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: bzhi pa brda yi phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: rig stong gdod nas skye med chos sku'i dbyings: ye shes rang rtsal gzugs sku'i rnam par shar: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs la: mi phyed gus pas brda yi phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ ti pū ho: pra ti tstsha ho: lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis mngon sprul pa'i: phyi nang gsang ba rmad byung mchod pa'i sprin: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul: bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub char ltar phob: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru de ba dhā ki ni sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ= rū pa shapda gandhe rā sa sparshe pra titstsha swā hā:

ma hā su kha dzñā na pū dza ho: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: drug pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: ma bcos spros bral chos sku'i ngang nyid las: longs spyod yongs rdzogs sprul pa'i sprin phung 'phro: thugs rjes 'gro 'dul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: gus pas bstod do mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bdun pa bzlas pa bya ba la: dang po bsnyen pa'i dgongs pa ni: thugs kar pad nyi dregs pa'i gdan gyi steng : ye shes sems dpa' badzra rta gdong zhal: mthing nag rdo rje'i gri gug thod khrag 'chang : gar dgu'i gzi 'bar rang 'od yum dang sbyor: dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs zung dor stabs 'gying : de yi thugs dbus nyi zla kha sbyor sbubs: hūm̐ mthar sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis: 'phags pa mchod cing 'gro kun sgrib gnyis sbyangs: tshur 'dus rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi: byin rlabs dngos grub ye shes rang la thim: zhi ba'i phrin las lhun gyis grub par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru badzra thod phreng rtsal sarba siddhi hūm̐: 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas grub gnyis thob: de nas sgrub pa'i dgongs pa ni: slar yang thugs srog sgrub pa'i sngags kyi phreng : rang sgra sgrogs bzhin bskor las 'od zer 'phros: snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang lhar gyur cing : sgra grags sngags la dran rtog 'od gsal dbyings: snang srid gzhir bzhengs dag pa rab 'byams ngang : ye shes chen po'i nus stobs rdzogs par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru badzra thod phreng rtsal badzra sa ma ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ 'bum phrag bzlas pas dngos grub thob: tha mar las la sbyar ba ni: thugs srog sngags las 'od zer dkar po'i phreng : ston zla'i mdangs ldan phyi nang kun tu 'phros: mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba'i las 'grub cing : mchog tu mi 'gyur ye shes rtsal rdzogs bsam:

sgrub pa'i sngags kyis thog drangs nas: hūm̐ sarba shantiṃ ku ru swā hā: khri yis zhi ba'i las kun 'grub: gsum pa rjes kyi las rim la: tshogs mchod la sogs mthar dbyung ngo : sa ma ya: khyad par zhi ba'i las sbyor ni: rin chen bum pa rgyan ldan nang : rgyun 'babs chu dang so lngas bkang : stegs bu'i dbus bzhag mchod pas bskor: bdag bskyed bsnyen sgrub sngon 'gro bas: bum pa 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bsang : oṃ swa bhā wa bi shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā ba bi shuddho3haṃ: stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan gyi steng : bhrūm̐ yig yongs gyur rin chen bum pa bzang : bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus: zhi ba'i las mdzad rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa'i lha tshogs rnams: snang stong zung 'jug chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar: dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med par gsal: rang gi thugs nas sngags kyi 'od zer 'phros: bum pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam rgyud bskul bas: 'od zer dkar po mkha' khyab kun tu 'phros: 'phags pa mchod cing 'gro ba'i mi mthun sbyangs: tshur 'dus rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams dang : gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags byin rlabs bcud: 'od dkar bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs nas: bum pa'i lha yi thugs kar sa bon mthar: sngags kyi phreng bas mtshan la gnyis med thim: de las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rab tu babs: bum bcud la thim mthong tshor myang reg kun: mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba'i nus ldan bsam: hūm̐ sarba pā pam̐ kle sha sarba bha ya shantiṃ ku ru swā hā: khri phrag bzlas pas las kun 'grub: mthar ni lha nyid 'od du zhu: bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig bsam: rang dang bsgrub byar 'thor 'thung bkru: gnas khang sogs la gtor ba yis: sdig sgrib nad gdon 'jigs brgyad sogs: mi mthun phyogs kun zhi bar 'gyur: sa ma ya: de ltar bskyed bzlas zab mo'i don:

nyams su len pa'i snod ldan phyir: rim pa dbang gi cho ga ni: buddha thod phreng smin byed bzhin: lha sngags kha bsgyur tsam gyis 'grub: khyad par mtha' rten khrus kyi bum: spyi bor bzhag cing 'thor 'thung bya: bkra shis mtshan ldan rdo rje'i ka la sha: dag byed bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis rab tu gtams: skal ldan slob mar dbang bskur khrus bgyis pas: mi mthun 'gal rkyen mtha' dag zhi bar shog: sngags mthar oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐: grib sel sngags kyang ci rigs bzla: rjes su shis brjod khas blang sogs: gsang ba spy-i dang mthun par spyad: des ni lam gyi snod rung 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu hya: brda thim: gar dbang 'od gsal gling pas zab mo dgongs pa'i gter las phyung ba'o: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: rgyas pa'i las mdzad ratna thod phreng rtsal gyi sgos sgrub bzhugs: dhī/: rtsa gsum yongs 'dus lha la 'dud: tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes sogs: mthun rkyen legs tshogs rgyas 'dod na: ratna thod phreng bsgrub par bya: sa ma ya: de la sngon dngos rjes gsum las: sngon 'gro las bdun tshul bzhin bya: dngos gzhir dang po dam tshig pa'i: dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: de bzhin nyid dbyings dmigs med snying rje'i rtsal: zung 'jug rgyu yi sa bon oṃ dkar gsal: de las 'od 'phros snod bcud dngos 'dzin sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las 'byung rim ri rab rtser: rdo rje'i srung 'khor me phung 'bar ba'i klong : bhrūm̐ las rin chen gzhal med khang chen po: mtshan nyid kun rdzogs snang stong 'od 'bar dbus: sna tshogs padma 'dab bzhi'i lte ba ru: rta mchog gis btegs rin chen mdzes khri dang : thabs shes zung 'jug nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng : trām̐ yig yongs gyur ratna thod phreng rtsal: gser mdog brjid chags shin tu sgeg pa'i nyams: phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu thugs kar gtod:

g.yon pas nor bu'i yu ba byas pa yi: rigs kyi dril bu dkur brten yum la 'khyud: dar dang rin chen rgyan rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs: yum mchog rin chen dril bu bsnams pa 'khril: rig 'dzin bla ma bye ba'i sprin phung 'phro: 'dab bzhir dbang chen rta mchog rigs bzhi las: rab 'byams yi dam zhi khro'i phyag rgya shar: sgo bzhir rig 'dzin dpa' bo yab yum la: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor: kun kyang spy-i mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjes rgyas gdab cing : ye shes dbang bskur rigs kyi cod pan 'chang : thugs ka'i 'od kyis lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: gnyis pa ye shes spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang rig lhun mnyam mtha' dbus med pa'i dkyil: ye shes bzhi 'phro 'khor lo'i tshul 'chang ba: bsam yas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i skur ston pa: rtsal snang dbyings nas rol zhing gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru de ba dhā ki nī sarba dzñā na maṇḍa la badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang snang dam tshig sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor du: rig rtsal dbyings nas spyan drangs ye shes lha: chu la chu bzhag sgyu ma ji bzhin du: gnyis med brtan bzhugs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: badzra dzñā na sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: bzhi pa brda yi phyag 'tshal ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rig stong gdod nas skye med chos sku'i dbyings: ye shes rang rtsal gzugs sku'i rnam par shar: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs la: mi phyed gus pas brda yi phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ ti pū ho: pra ti tstsha hoḥ lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis mngon sprul pa'i: phyi nang gsang ba rmad byung mchod pa'i sprin: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul: bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub char ltar phob: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru de ba dhā ki ni sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ=

rū pa shapda gandhe rā sa sparshe pra titstsha swā hā: ma hā su kha dzñā na pū dza ho: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: drug pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral chos sku'i ngang nyid las: longs spyod yongs rdzogs sprul pa'i sprin phung 'phro: thugs rjes 'gro 'dul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: gus pas bstod do mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bdun pa bzlas pa bya ba la: dang po bsnyen pa'i dgongs pa ni: thugs kar pad nyi dregs pa'i gdan gyi steng : ye shes sems dpa' ratna rta gdong zhal: ser nag rin chen gri gug thod khrag 'chang : gar dgu'i gzi 'bar rang 'od yum dang sbyor: dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs zung dor stabs 'gying : de yi thugs dbus nyi zla kha sbyor sbubs: trām̐ mthar sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis: 'phags pa mchod cing 'gro kun sgrib gnyis sbyangs: tshur 'dus rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi: byin rlabs dngos grub ye shes rang la thim: tshe bsod dpal 'byor lung rtogs yon tan sogs: rgyas pa'i phrin las lhun gyis grub par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal sarba siddhi hūm̐: 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas grub gnyis thob: de nas sgrub pa'i dgongs pa ni: slar yang thugs srog sgrub pa'i sngags kyi phreng : rang sgra sgrogs bzhin bskor las 'od zer 'phros: snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang lhar gyur cing : sgra grags sngags la dran rtog 'od gsal dbyings: snang srid gzhir bzhengs dag pa rab 'byams ngang : ye shes chen po'i nus stobs rdzogs par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal badzra sa ma ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ ā: 'bum phrag bzlas pas dngos grub thob: tha mar las la sbyar ba ni: thugs srog sngags las 'od zer gser mdog phreng : 'char kha'i mdangs ldan phyi nang kun tu 'phros:

tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes yon tan sogs: mthun rkyen legs tshogs thams cad rgyas par bsam: sgrub pa'i sngags kyis thog drangs nas: trām̐ sarba puṣtiṃ ku ru oṃ: khri yis rgyas pa'i las kun 'grub: gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la: tshogs mchod la sogs mthar dbyung ngo : sa ma ya: khyad par rgyas pa'i las sbyor ni: mtshan rdzogs rin chen ka pā la: rten 'brel dge ba'i nang khongs su: dri yi rdzas dang sman gyis byug: tshe yi rdzas dang dpal can rdzas: myong grol mchog gi a mṛ ta: rin chen 'bru sman sogs gyis bkang : dar zab chen pos kha bcad la: stegs bu'i dbus bzhag mchod pas bskor: bdag bskyed bsnyen sgrub sngon 'gro bas: thod pa 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bsang : oṃ swa bhā ba bi shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa bi shuddho3haṃ: stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun gyi gzhir: yid 'phrog mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i bkod pa dang : srid zhi'i 'byor tshogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi dbus: nor bu'i gzhal med khang chen mtshan nyid rdzogs: lte bar 'dod 'byung ye shes kā pa la: yangs shing rgya che gnod sbyin gter 'chang che'i: bum pa bzang der 'dod dgu'i bcud kyis gtams: snang stong 'ja' zer thig le 'khrigs pa'i dbus: rgyas pa'i las mdzad ratna thod phreng rtsal: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa'i lha tshogs rnams: snang stong zung 'jug chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar: dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med par gsal: rang gi thugs nas sngags kyi 'od zer 'phros: thod pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam rgyud bskul bas: gser mdog 'od kyis 'khor 'das khams kun khyab: 'phags pa mchod cing 'gro kun legs tshogs spel: tshur 'dus rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams dang : 'khor 'das legs tshogs ye shes yon tan kun: gser mdog bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs nas: thod pa'i lha yi thugs kar sa bon mthar: sngags kyi phreng bas mtshan pa gnyis med thim:
'khor 'das dngos grub kun gyi dbyig tu

bsam: trām̐ sarba lo ka dzñā na ā yur puṇye puṣtiṃ ku ru oṃ: khri phrag bzlas pas gang 'dod 'grub: thun mtshams tshogs mchod rgya cher phul: mda' dar g.yab cing thugs dam bskul: trām̐: dgos 'byung rin chen gter gyi pho brang nas: rgyas pa'i las mdzad ratna thod phreng rtsal: rab 'byams rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kun: mos shing gdung bas thugs dam bskul lags na: ye shes yon tan gzi brjid tshad med pa'i: 'od zer pho nya srid zhi'i khams kun spros: snod kyi phywa dang bcud kyi dge mtshan g.yang : tshe bsod dpal 'byor 'dod rgu'i legs tshogs kun: 'dir sdus sgrub pa'i rdzas la byin chen phob: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa sogs: mthong thos dran reg gdul bya'i tshogs rnams kyi: 'dod rgu'i bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub mdzad gsol: las sbyor sngags kyi mthar: ratna ka pā la ba su siddhi sdus sdus ratna siddhi sa ma ya st+wam̐: ā yur puṇye dzñā na sarba siddhi pha la ho: zhes pa'i rig pa yang yang bzla: mthar ni lha nyid rten la bstim: brtan bzhugs shis brjod rgya cher bya: lus la 'chang ngam mdzod phugs gzhug: skabs su tshogs dang phud kyis mchod: tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes sogs: 'dod rgu'i 'byor pa rgyas par 'gyur: sa ma ya: de ltar bskyed bzlas zab mo'i don: nyams su len pa'i sdod ldan phyir: rim pa dbang gi cho ga ni: buddha thod phreng smin byed pa: lha sngags kha bsgyur tsam gyis 'grub: khyad par mtha' brten ka pā la: rdzas dang bcas pa lag tu gtad: trām̐: bkra shis mtshan ldan rdo rje ka pā la: tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes bcud kyis gtams: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la sbyin pa yis: mthun rkyen dngos grub legs tshogs rgyas par shog: trām̐ sarba lo ka dzñā na a yur puṇye puṣtiṃ ku ru oṃ: rjes su shis brjod khas blang sogs: gsang ba spy-i dang mthun par spyad: des ni lam gyi snod du 'gyur:

sa ma ya: gar dbang 'od gsal gling pas zab mo dgongs pa'i gter mdzod las phyung ba'o: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: dbang gi las mdzad padma thod phreng rtsal gyi sgos sgrub bzhugs: dhī/: rtsa gsum yongs 'dus lha la 'dud: srid dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs dang : yid mthun dbang du 'du 'dod na: padma thod phreng bsgrub par bya: sa ma ya: de la sngon dngos rjes gsum las: sngon 'gro'i las bdun tshul bzhin bya: dngos gzhir dang po dam tshig pa'i: kyil 'khor 'khor lo bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: de bzhin nyid dbyings dmigs med snying rje'i rtsal: zung 'jug rgyu yi sa bon hrīḥdamar gsal: de las 'od 'phros snod bcud dngos 'dzin sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las 'byung rim ri rab rtser: rdo rje'i srung 'khor me phung 'bar ba'i klong : bhrūm̐ las rin chen gzhal med khang chen po: mtshan nyid kun rdzogs snang stong 'od 'bar dbus: sna tshogs padma 'dab bzhi'i lte ba ru: rma byas btegs pa'i rin chen mdzes khri dang : thabs shes zung 'jug nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng : hrīḥyig yongs gyur padma thod phreng rtsal: dmar gsal sgeg cing shin tu chags pa'i nyams: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum gzi 'od 'bar: phyag g.yas padma dmar po thugs kar gtod: g.yon pas padma'i yu ba byas pa yi: rigs kyi dril bu dkur brten yum la 'khyud: rus pa'i phyag rgya drug gis rab tu spras: dar dang rin chen rgyan rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs: yum mchog padma dril bu bsnams pas 'khril: rig 'dzin bla ma bye ba'i sprin phung 'phro: 'dab bzhir dbang chen rta mchog rigs bzhi las: rab 'byams yi dam zhi khro'i phyag rgya shar: sgo bzhir rig 'dzin dpa' bo yab yum la: gnas gsum 'kha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor: kun kyang spy-i mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjes rgyas gdab cing : ye shes dbang bskur rigs kyi cod pan 'chang :

thugs ka'i 'od kyis lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: gnyis pa ye shes spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang rig lhun mnyam mtha' dbus med pa'i dkyil: ye shes bzhi 'phro 'khor lo'i tshul 'chang ba: bsam yas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i skur ston pa: rtsal snang dbyings nas rol zhing gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru de ba dhā ki nī sarba dzñā na maṇḍal badzra sa ma ya dza: gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang snang dam tshig sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor du: rig rtsal dbyings nas spyan drangs ye shes lha: chu la chu bzhag sgyu ma ji bzhin du: gnyis med brtan bzhugs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: badzra dzñā na sa ma sa tiṣṭha lhan: bzhi pa brda yi phyag 'tshal ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rig stong gdod nas skye med chos sku'i dbyings: ye shes rang rtsal gzugs sku'i rnam par shar: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs la: mi phyed 'dun pas brda yi phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra ti tstsha ho: lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis mngon sprul pa'i: phyi nang gsang ba rmad byung mchod pa'i sprin: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul: bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub char ltar phob: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru de ba dhā ki ni sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ= rū pa shapda gandhe rā sa sparshe pra titstsha swā hā: ma hā su kha dzñā na pū dza ho: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: drug pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral chos sku'i ngang nyid las: longs spyod yongs rdzogs sprul pa'i sprin phung 'phro: thugs rjes 'gro 'dul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: gus pas bstod do mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bdun pa bzlas pa bya ba la: dang po bsnyen pa'i dgongs pa ni: thugs kar pad nyi dregs pa'i gdan gyi steng : ye shes sems dpa' padma rta gdong zhal:

dmar nag padma'i gri gug thod khrag 'chang : gar dgu'i gzi 'bar rang 'od yum dang sbyor: dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs zung dor stabs 'gying : de yi thugs dbus nyi zla kha sbyor sbubs: hrīḥmathar sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis: 'phags pa mchod cing 'gro kun sgrib gnyis sbyangs: tshur 'dus rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi: byin rlabs dngos grub ye shes rang la thim: 'khor 'das snod bcud legs tshogs kun 'du ba'i: rab 'byams dbang gi phrin las lhun grub gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal sarba siddhi hūm̐: 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas grub gnyis thob: de nas sgrub pa'i dgongs pa ni: slar yang thugs srogs sgrub pa'i sngags kyi phreng : rang sgra sgrogs bzhin bskor las 'od zer 'phros: snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang lhar gyur cing : sgra grags sngags la dran rtog 'od gsal dbyings: snang srid gzhir bzhengs dag pa rab 'byams ngang : ye shes chen po'i nus stobs rdzogs par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa ma ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ 'bum phrag bzlas pas dngos grub thob: tha mar las la sbyar ba ni: thugs srog sngags las 'od zer rab dmar ba: rā ga'i mdangs can phyi nang kun tu 'phros: 'khor 'das snang srid rlung sems dbang du 'dus: rab 'byams dbang gi phrin las lhun grub bsam: sgrub pa'i sngags gyis thog drangs nas: hrī sarba wā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ khri yis dbang gis las kun 'grub: gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la: tshaugs mchod la sogs 'thar dbyung ngo : sa ma ya: khyad par dbang gi las sbyor ni: sa dmar stegs bu 'thas par bcag: dbang gi thab khung spy-i mthun bri: dmar skyur shing bu zla gam brtsegs: mar dang yam shing khyad par rdzas: lcags kyu can gyi me tog dmar: chang dang lan tshās sbags pa dang : nyer spyod sman rag gtor tshogs bsham: bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon 'gro bas:

thab khungs bsang zhing me sbar la: swa bhā'i sngags kyis stong par sbyang : stong pa'i ngang las dbang gi thab khung ni: zla gam 'od dmar rab tu 'khrugs pa'i nang : dbang gi me phung rjes chags snang ba 'bar: de dbus bhrūm̐ las padma'i gzhal yas khang : mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs ngo mtshar bkod pas mdzes: lte bar rma byas btegs pa'i rin chen khri: thabs shes zung 'jug nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng : hrīḥyig yongs gyur padma thod phreng rtsal: zhes sogs bstod pa'i bar du sbyar: dgang blugs kha sbyar byon skyems 'bul: hrīḥ dgangs blugs thabs shes zung 'jug mnyam sbyor ba: lha rnam zhal gyi ngo bor rnam dag las: zag med bdud rtsi'i char chen phab pa yis: padma thod phreng yab yum dkyil 'khor pa: dgyes tshim sku dang sbyor mtshams las byung ba'i: 'od zer dmar pos 'khor 'das khams kun khyab: rab 'byams dbang gi phrin las yongs rdzogs shing : rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par gyur: ces brjod dmigs pa gsal brtan pas: bsnyen sngags sham du las kyi sngags: sprel nas mar khu nyer gcig dang : dbang gi yam shing de ltar phul: khyad par rdzas la grangs bzung nas: brgya stong la sogs ci nus dang : skabs su gsol byang 'di yang gdags: khams gsum snod bcud rlung sems snang ba legs pa'i yon tan thams cad wā shaṃ ku ru ho: rjes su gtang rag mchod bstod dang : tshogs phud gshegs skyems ci rigs phul: nongs pa bshags shing ye shes pa: rang gi lte bar thim pa yis: gtum mo'i me dang dbyer med pas: srid zhi dbang phyug chen por bsam: thal ba 'bab chu chen po'am: nub phyogs ri rtser rlung la bskur: des ni rab 'byams dbang gi las: myur du 'grub cing mthar phyin 'gyur: sa ma ya: de ltar bskyed bzlas zab mo'i don: nyams su len pa'i snod ldan phyir: rim pa dbang gi cho ga ni: buddha thod phreng smin byed la: lha sngags kha bsgyur tsam gyis 'grub:

khyad par mtha' rten dgang blugs gtad: hrīḥ padma thod phreng yab yum ngo bo nyid: thabs shes zung 'jug dgang blugs 'di gtad pas: lha rnams zhal gyur sreg blugs las sbyor gyis: rab 'byams dbang gi phrin las yongs rdzogs shog: bsnyen dang las sngags rjod cing gtad: spro na me mchod 'bul du gzhug: rjes su gshis brjod khas blang sogs: gsang ba spyi dang mthun par spyad: des ni lam gyi snod du 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: guhya: brda thim: gar dbang 'od gsal gling pas zab mo dgongs pa'i gter mdzod las phyung ba'o/ dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: drag po'i las mdzad karma thod phreng rtsal gyi sgos sgrub bzhugs: dhī/: rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs lha la 'dud: nad gdon dgra bgegs byad phur sogs: tshar gcod drag po'i las byed na: karma thod phreng bsgrub par bya: sa ma ya: de la sngon dngos rjes gsum las: sngon 'gro'i las bdun tshul bzhin bya: dngos gzhir dang po dam tshig gi: dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: de bzhin nyid dbyings dmigs med snying rje'i rtsal: zung 'jug rgyu yi sa bon a ljang gsal: de las 'od 'phros snod bcud dngos 'dzin sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las 'byung rim ri rab rtser: rdo rje'i srung 'khor me phung 'bar ba'i klong : bhrūm̐ las rin chen gzhal med khang chen po: mtshan nyid kun rdzogs snang stong 'od 'bar dbus: sna tshogs padma 'dab bzhi'i lte ba ru: mkha' lding gis btegs rin chen mdzes khri dang : thabs shes zung 'jug nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng : āḥyig yongs gyur karma thod phreng rtsal: ljang nag khro zhing gtum pa'i nyams 'gyur can: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum sdang mig bsgrad: phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar gtod: g.yon pas de yis yu ba byas pa yi: rigs kyi dril bu dkur brten yum la 'khyud: rus pa'i phyag rgya drug gis rab tu spras:

dar dang rin chen rgyan rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs: yum mchog rgya gram dril bu bsnams pas 'khril: rig 'dzin bla ma bye ba'i sprin phung 'phro: 'dab bzhir dbang chen rta mchog rigs bzhi las: rab 'byams yi dam zhi khro'i phyag rgya shar: sgo bzhir rig 'dzin dpa' bo yab yum la: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor: kun kyang spy-i mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjes rgyas gdab cing : ye shes dbang bskur rigs kyi cod pan 'chang : thugs ka'i 'od kyis lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: gnyis pa ye shes spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang rig lhun mnyam mtha' dbus med pa'i dkyil: ye shes bzhi 'phro 'khor lo'i tshul 'chang ba: bsam yas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i skur ston pa: rtsal snang dbyings nas rol zhing gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru de ba dhā ki ni sarba dzñā na maṇḍal badzra sa ma ya dza: gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang snang dam tshig sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor du: rig rtsal dbyings nas spyan drangs ye shes lha: chu la chu bzhag sgyu ma ji bzhin du: gnyis med brtan bzhugs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: badzra dzñā na sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: bzhi pa brda yi phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rig stong gdod nas skye med chos sku'i dbyings: ye shes rang rtsal gzugs sku'i rnam par shar: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs la: mi phyed gus pas brda yi phyag 'tshal bstod: a ti pū ho: pra titstsha ho: lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: oṃ ā hūm̐: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis mngon sprul pa'i: phyi nang gsang ba rmad byung mchod pa'i sprin: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul: bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub char ltar phob: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru de ba dhā ki ni sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ= rū pa shapda gandhe rā sa sparshe pra titstsha swā hā:

ma hā su kha dzñā na pū dza ho: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: drug pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral chos sku'i ngang nyid las: longs spyod yongs rdzogs sprul pa'i sprin phung 'phro: thugs rjes 'gro 'dul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: gus pas bstod do mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bdun pa bzlas pa bya ba la: dang po bsnyen pa'i dgongs pa ni: thugs kar pad nyi dregs pa'i gdan gyi steng : ye shes sems dpa' karma rta gdong zhal: ljang nag rgya gram gri gug thod khrag 'chang : gar dgu'i gzi 'bar rang 'od yum dang sbyor: dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs zung dor stabs 'gying: de'i thugs dbus nyi zla kha sbyor sbubs: āḥmathar sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis: 'phags pa mchod cing 'gro kun sgrib gnyis sbyangs: tshur 'dus rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi: byin rlabs dngos grub ye shes rang la thim: mi mthun gdug pa'i tshogs rnams tshar gcod pas: rab 'byams drag po'i las kun lhun grub gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru karma thod phreng rtsal sarba siddhi hūm̐:

'bum phrag bzhi bzlas grub gnyis thob: de nas sgrub pa'i dgongs pa ni: slar yang thugs srog sgrub pa'i sngags kyi phreng : rang sgra sgrogs bzhin bskor bas 'od zer 'phros: snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang lhar gyur cing: sgra grags sngags la dran rtog 'od gsal dbyings: snang srid gzhir bzhengs dag pa rab 'byams ngang : ye shes chen po'i nus stobs rdzogs par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru karma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa ma ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ 'bum phrag bzlas pas dngos grub thob: tha mar las la sbyar ba ni: thugs srog sngags las 'od zer ljang nag phreng : tsha zhing rtsub pa phyi nang kun tu 'phros: mi mthun gdug pa'i tshogs rnams tshar bcad cing : rab 'byams drag po'i phrin las lhun grub bsam: sgrub pa'i sngags kyis thog drangs nas: āḥsarba mā ra ya phaṭa: khri yis drag po'i las kun 'grub: gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la: tshogs mchod la sogs mthar dbyung ngo : sa ma ya: khyad par drag po'i las sbyor ni: phung shul sa la stegs bu bya: las khung hom du liṅga bzhag: de steng zor gyi gtor chen dang : drag po'i nyer spyod sman gtor raka: thun gtor sha khrag dang bcas bsham: bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon 'gro bas: ma trām̐ ru dra a karṣāya dzaḥ mā ra ya pha¿ṭa: gtor snod ma trām̐ bsgral ba'i khog pa ru: dur khrod drag po'i bkod pas rab tu brjid: de dbus gtor ma mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang : gnam lcags 'bar ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus: pad nyi dreg pa bdud bzhi'i gdan steng du: drag po'i las mdzad karma thod phreng rtsal: ljang nag khro gtum bzod dka'i gzi brjid 'bar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dmar zlum 'khrugs: phyag g.yas ral gri me 'bar nam mkhar gdengs: g.yon pas thod pa khrag bkang thugs kar gtod: las kyi gsang gos phod ka stag sham gsol: rus pa'i rgyan ldan rang 'od yum dang 'khril: zhabs gnyis gyad kyi dor stabs bdud dpung mnan:

drag me dmar nag 'khrugs pa'i klong na rol: rig 'dzin drag po bye ba'i sprin phung 'phro: rtsibs bzhir dbang chen rta mchog rigs bzhi las: rab 'byams yi dam khro bo'i phyag rgya shar: de yi phyogs bzhir pad nyi bam ro'i steng : rig 'dzin drag po dpa' bo yab yum la: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro drag mo'i tshogs kyis bskor: kun kyang spy-i mgrin thugs kar oṃ āḥhūm̐: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjes rgyas gdab cing : ye shes dbang bskur rigs lnga'i cod pan 'chang : thugs ka'i 'od kyis lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: rkang gling bshug pa'i brdas bskul nas: ye shes drang bzhugs phyag mchod bstod: mdun bskyed thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng : rdo rje rtse dgu'i lte bar hūm̐ yig mthar: sngags kyi phreng bas bskor las 'od zer phreng : tsha zhing rtsub pa mtshon cha'i tshogs bcas 'phros: sa gsum gdug pa'i 'byung po zil gyis mnan: dam sri rgyal 'gong byad phur rbod gtong sogs: mi mthun phyogs kun thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag: phyogs las rnam rgyal phrin las 'grub par bsam: bsnyen pa'i sngags mthar spu gri gdags: sarba shā trūn bighnān bhū ta pre ta pi sha tsi na bhindha bhindha ha na ha na pa tsa pa tsa da ha da ha dī na me ke na mā ra ya pha¿ṭa: mchod bstod tshogs kyi mchod bshags rjes: liṅgar dgra bgegs dgug bstim dang : bsgral ba'i las sbyor sngona'agro bas: ling ro thun gtor sha khrag 'bul: zlog pa'i phrin las bcol ba ni: hūm̐: gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar rab 'bar ba'i: mngon spyod drag shul rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: rtsa gsum rgyal ba ma lus 'dus pa'i dngos: drag po'i las mdzad karma thod phreng rtsal: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa'i gtor ma bzhes: khros 'khrugs rngams pa 'bar ba'i shugs skyed la: rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi:

gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i gzhan dbang las byung ba'i: lus kyi bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kun zlog: sems kyi 'khrul snang dngos zhen sdug bsngal zlog: byad ka phur kha byol kha rbod gtong zlog: gzugs can dgra yi 'tshe ba thams cad zlog: gzugs med lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul bar chad zlog: sa chu me rlung 'byung bzhi dgrar langs zlog: 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug zlog: mtha' dmag dus 'khrugs bstan la 'tshe ba zlog: phyi nang rtsod 'dzings 'gro ba'i rkyen ngan zlog: glo bur keg sri bar chad thams cad zlog: bzlog go drag po zor gyi gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro mi mthun dgra bgegs steng du sgyur: bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: sarba sha trūn bighnān ma ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog bhyo zlog cig: thal mo dang ni dul mo brdab: zor dkyil la sogs thams cad kun: khros 'khrugs rngams pa'i gzi byin bskyed: 'od zer sprul pas stong gsum gang : mi mthun rdul du brlag par bsam: mthar ni zor gyi ye shes bteg: dam tshig nad mtshon phung por bsam: gser skyems sngon 'gros dgra phyogs 'phang : zor rdzas dug mtshon char bab pa'i: rjes su ye shes khro bo'i tshogs: dpung dang bcas pa rab tu chas: dgra dpung bdun brgyud rtsad nas bcad: bgegs dpung thal bar brlag par bsam: dgra thul bgegs chom mi mthun phyogs: tshar gcod mngon spyod mthar phyin 'gyur: sa ma ya: de ltar bskyed bzlas zab mo'i don: nyams su len pa'i snod ldan phyir: rim pa dbang gi cho ga ni: buddha thod phreng smin byed la: lha sngags kha bsgyur tsam gyis 'grub: khyad par mtha' brten lhar bskyed pa'i: zor gtor rdzas bcas lag tu gtad: hūm̐: gtor snod rab 'jigs drag po'i pho brang dbus: gtor ma karma thod phreng 'khor bcas gsal: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la gtad pa yis: zlog sgyur drag po'i phrin las yongs rdzogs shog:

drag sngags bzla zhing lag tu gtad: spro na 'phang ba'i las kyang bya: rjes su shis brjod khas blang sogs: gsang ba spyi dang mthun par spyad: des ni lam gyi snod du 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: guhya: brda thim: gar dbang 'od gsal gling pas zab mo dgongs pa'i gter mdzod las phyung ba'o: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: rdo rjai rnam par 'joms pa'i sgrub pa bzhugs so: dhī/: rtsa gsum kun 'dus padmar 'dud: ma 'ongs rnal 'byor spyod pa rnams: lhan cig skyes dang glo bur gyi: nyams grib mi gtsang sel ba'i thabs: gzungs sngags zab mo'i phrin las bstan: sa ya ya: dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i sar: bde ba'i stan la legs 'dug nas: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon song nas: dngos gzhir bskyed pa'i rim pa ni: hūm̐: snang srid 'khor 'das gdod nas rnam dag klong : phyi snod rdo rje'i gur khang rgya che bar: bhrūm̐ las rin chen gzhal yas mtshan nyid rdzogs: de dbus thabs shes pad nyi'i gdan gyi steng : sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan: 'od zer 'phro 'dus sras bcas rgyal kun gyi: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byin rlabs dpal yon kun: dbang du bsdus thim skad cig dran rdzogs su: bcom ldan gsang bdag rdo rje rnam par 'joms: sku mdog ljang sngon khro 'dzum mtshan dpe'i zhal: phyag g.yas rdo rje rgya gram thugs kar bsnams: g.yon pas dril bu dkur brten skyil krung bzhugs: sna tshogs dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: spyi bor rigs bdag bcom ldan rdo rje sems: sku mdog dkar gsal rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: slar yang ting nge 'dzin gyi rol mo yis: phyogs dus rgyal kun ye shes gcig bsdus nas: mi phyed rdo rje'i lus su byin rlabs shing : thugs srog sa bon hūm̐ gi sprin 'phros pas: phyogs bzhir sna tshogs rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dbus: shar du rdo rje gtum po sku mdog dkar:

lho ru rdo rje be con gser gyi mdangs: nub tu rdo rje tho ba sku mdog dmar: byang du rdo rje phur bu ma rgad mdog: thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril bsnams: dar sngon stod g.yogs stag lpags shams thabs dang : sbrul gyi rgyan spras pad nyi'i gdan la bzhengs: de yi phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs bcu'i klong : rang byung ye shes sprul pa'i khro rgyal bcu: mthing nag phyag gnyis rdo rje phur bu 'dril: khro bo'i chas rdzogs me dpung dbus na rol: sgo bzhir phyogs skyong rgyal chen sde bzhi dang : rdo rje'i pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi sogs: chos srung dam can rgya mtsho sprin ltar gtibs: gzhan yang rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams tshogs: snang stong zung 'jug chen por gsal ba yi: gnas gsum rdo rje gsum gyi yi ges mtshan: de las 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs gyur: hūm̐: dag pa rab 'byams chos sku'i pho brang nas: longs spyod yongs rdzogs rdo rje rnam par 'joms: sprul sku'i tshul gyis 'gro don sgrub slad du: thugs rje thugs dam dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs: oṃ badzra bi dā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho: dam tshig ye shes dbyer med brtan par bzhugs: 'du 'bral spangs pa'i brda yis phyag 'tshal lo: dngos su 'byor dang yid las byung ba yi: kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod: a ti pū ho: pra titstsha ho: oṃ badzra bi dā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shapda sarba pū dza ho: hūm̐: gdod nas gnyis med mnyam pa'i ye shes las: rnam kun mchog ldan mtshan dpe'i rol pa can: sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba 'dzin pa'i bdag: rdo rje rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi: nad gdon grib dang mi gtsang kun zhi zhing : tshe bsod dpal 'byor dbang bcu'i yon tan sogs: bcom ldan khyed dang mnyam par byin gyis rlobs:

bzlas pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor ni: thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng gis: bskor ba'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun mchod: byin rlabs dngos grub tshur 'dus bdag nyid la: thim pas grib dang mi gtsang sgrib gnyis sbyangs: na maḥtsaṇḍa badzra kro dhā ya: hu lu hu lu: tiṣṭha tiṣṭha: bhandha bhandha: ha na ha na: a mṛ te hūm̐ pha¿ṭa: thun mthar mchod bstod dngos grub blang : snang cha'i lha sku rim gyis bsdu: slar yang 'ja' tshon shar ba bzhin: sgo gsum lha yi phyag rgyar gsal: dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab: phrin las spy-i dang mthun par spyad: sa ma ya: byin rlabs dbang gi rim pa ni: dkyil 'khor zlum po bkod legs steng : sgrub pa'i yo byad legs par bsham: bdag mdun dbyer med bskyed bzlas bya: slob ma 'jug pa sngon song nas: dngos gzhir bum pa spyi bor bskur: hūm̐: bum pa zlum po spros bral chos sku'i klong : longs spyod yongs rdzogs sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'od zhu bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas: phung khams skye mched sgrib gnyis dag par shog: gzungs sngags dang : kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: sngags kyi phreng ba mgrin par bzhag: hūm̐: bcom ldan gsang ba'i bdag po'i ye shes las: yongs shar thabs shes zung 'jug ye ge'i sprin: nus pa sngags kyi phreng bas dbang bskur bas: 'gro 'ong rlung gi sgrib gnyis dag gyur cig: wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ phyag mtshan rdo rje snying gar bzhag: hūm̐: chos can snang ba'i dngos por ji snyed kun: chos nyid bde stong zung 'jug rdo rje'i dbyings: ye shes lha yi thugs kyi dbang bskur bas: gzung 'dzin rtog tshogs sgrib gnyis dag par shog: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: shel dang me long lag tu gtad: hūm̐: dpe yi thabs las byung ba'i nyams myong ni: don dam lhan skyes rdo rje rnam par 'joms: ka dag lhun grub dbyer med dbang bskur bas:

rtsa rlung thig le'i sgrib gnyis dag gyur cig: dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: mtha' brten gtor ma spyi bor bzhag: hūm̐: phyi snod dag pa rab 'byams rdo rje'i grong : nang bcud yi dam lha yi dkyil 'khor zhugs: deng 'dir skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par shog: shāntiṃ puṣtiṃ wā shaṃ mā ra ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: shis pa brjod cing me tog 'thor: rjes kyi rim pa spy-i ltar bya: sa ma ya: nyams grib khrus kyi sel ba ni: mtshan ldan rin chen bum pa ru: lnga tshan lnga yi rdzas kyi steng : shel dang rdo rje me tog sngo: shu dag gi wang ga bur rnams: rgyun 'bab chu dang sbyar la blugs: gtsang ma'i gos kyis rab dkri zhing : dag byed rten 'brel rdzas kyis brgyan: dkyil 'khor dbus su legs bkod de: bdag nyid lhar gsal bum pa'i dbus: rdo rje rnam 'jom lha tshogs bskyed: bzlas pas 'od zhu bdud rtsir bsam: rang gis 'thor 'thung nye reg bya: grib dang mi gtsang sgrib gnyis sel: gzhan phan phrin las rim pa ni: bsgrub bya mdun du 'khod pa la: thog mar bum pa'i chu yis bkru: hūm̐: rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa yi: bskyed pa sku yi bdud rtsi'i chus: deng 'dir khyod la khrus bgyis pas: lus kyi grib dang mi gtsang dang : nad gdon sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: gzungs sngags dang : kā ya bi sho dha na sarba shantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: nad thams cad shantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā:gdon thams cad shantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: bgegs thams cad shantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: grib thams cad shantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: mi gtsang ba thams cad shantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: sdig pa thams cad shantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: sgrib pa thams cad shantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: bar du gcod pa dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa yi: bzlas pa sngags kyi bdud rtsi'i chus:

deng 'dir khyod la khrus bgyis pas: ngag gi grib dang mi gtsang dang : nad gdon sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: wā ka bi sho dha na sarba shantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa yi: 'od gsal ye shes bdud rtsi'i chus: deng 'dir khyod la khrus bgyis pas: yid kyi grib dang mi gtsang dang : nad gdon sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: tsitta bi sho dha na sarba shantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa yi: gsang gsum dbyer med bdud rtsi'i chus: deng 'dir khyod la khrus bgyis pas: sgo gsum grib dang mi gtsang dang : nad gdon sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: kā ya wā ka tsitta bi sho dha na sarba shantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: so so'i mthar yang 'dod smon sbyar: spro na ye shes rnam lnga dang : phar phyin drug gi khrus kyang bya: de nas rten 'brel rdzas kyis byabs:

hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku: rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa yi: byin rlabs thugs rje'i bden stobs kyis: bsgrub bya'i lus kyi nad gdon bgegs: grib dang mi gtsang sdig sgrib kun: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: gzungs sngags mthar: kā ya bi sho dha na a pa nā ye swā hā: nad thams cad a pa nā ye swā hā: gdon thams cad a pa nā ye swā hā: bgegs thams cad a pa nā ye swā hā: grib thams cad a pa nā ye swā hā: mi gtsang ba thams cad a pa nā ye swā hā: sdig pa thams cad a pa nā ye swā hā: sgrib pa thams cad a pa nā ye swā hā: bar du gcod pa dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad a pa nā ye swā hā: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gsung : zhes sogs so sor brjod cing byabs: slar la rdo rje'i go chas bsrung : hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs: dbyer med gsang bdag dpa' bo che'i: lha sngags ye shes rol pa yis: sgo gsum mi mthun phyogs las srungs: gzungs sngags dang : kā ya wā ka tsitta sarba dzñā na badzra rakṣa rakṣa bhrūm̐: nad thams cad rakṣa rakṣa ye swā hā: gdon thams cad rakṣa rakṣa ye swā hā: bgegs thams cad rakṣa rakṣa ye swā hā: grib thams cad rakṣa rakṣa ye swā hā: mi gtsang ba thams cad rakṣa rakṣa ye swā hā: sdig pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa ye swā hā: sgrib pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa ye swā hā: bar du gcod pa dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad rakṣa rakṣa ye swā hā: zhes brjod rdo rjes gnas bdun reg: mi phyed srung ba'i gur du bsam: bden pa'i stobs dang shis brjod kyi: me tog sil ma char du bsnyil: sa ma ya: nad rigs byabs pas bsal ba ni: 'byung bzhi'i rdzas rnams 'du byas la: dag byed rtsa dang rma byas byabs: bden tshig brjod cing ting 'dzin bskyed: hūm̐: sa ni dug gi pha yin te: sa ni dug gi ma yang yin: sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs: gcig bsdus bcom ldan gsang ba'i bdag:

rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa yi: byin rlabs thugs rje'i nus stobs dang : lha sngags ye shes rol pa yis: bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas: khyod kyi bad kan las gyur nad: lci zhing 'thibs pa'i rigs rnam kun: 'byung ba sa yi klong du thim: nad dang sdug bsngal bral bar shog: gzungs sngags mthar: sarba ro ge bhya: laṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe ye swā hā: chu ni dug gi pha yin te: chu ni dug gi ma yang yin: sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs: gcig bsdus bcom ldan gsang ba'i bdag: rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa yi: byin rlabs thugs rje'i nus stobs dang : lha sngags ye shes rol pa yis: bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas: khyod kyi khrag dang chu ser nad: zhen cing khyab pa'i rigs rnams kun: 'byung ba chu yi klong du thim: nad dang sdug bsngal bral bar shog: sarba ro ge bhyaḥbaṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe ye swā hā: me ni dug gi pha yin te: me ni dug gi ma yang yin: sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs: gcig bsdus bcom ldan gsang ba'i bdag: rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa yi: byin rlabs thugs rje'i nus stobs dang : lha sngags ye shes rol pa yis: bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas: khyod kyi mkhris pa las gyur nad: tsha zhing bsregs pa'i rigs rnams kun: 'byung ba me yi klong du thim: nad dang sdug bsngal bral bar shog: sarba ro ge bhyaḥraṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe ye swā hā: rlung ni dug gi pha yin te: rlung ni dug gi ma yang yin: sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs: gcig bsdus bcom ldan gsang ba'i bdag: rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa yi: byin rlabs thugs rje'i nus stobs dang : lha sngags ye shes rol pa yi: bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas: khyod kyi rlung las gyur pa'i nad: yang shing g.yo ba'i rigs rnams kun: 'byung ba rlung gi klong du thim: nad dang sdug bsngal bral bar shog:

sarba ro ge bhyaḥyaṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe ye swā hā: de nas thun mong byabs pa ni: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum: 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste: bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga': sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo: bsgrub bya'i lus ngag yid gsum la: dug gsum rgyu las skyes pa yi: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams kun: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: gzungs sngags mthar: kā ya wā ka tsitta sarba ro ge bhyaḥ.a pa nā ye swā hā: rlung las gyur pa'i nad thams cad a pa na ye swā hā: mkhris pa las gyur pa'i nad thams cad a pa na ye swā hā: bad kan las gyur pa'i nad thams cad a pa na ye swā hā: ldan pa las gyur pa'i nad thams cad a pa na ye swā hā: 'dus pa las gyur pa'i nad thams cad a pa na ye swā hā: chos dang dge 'dun la yang sbyar: slar la bum pa'i chu yis bkru: hūm̐: rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa yi: ngo bo chos sku'i bdud rtsi'i chus: deng 'dir khyod la khrus bgyis pas: yongs grub tshe yi nad kyi rigs: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zhi gyur cig: kā ya wā ka tsitta sarba ro ge bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rlung las gyur pa'i nad thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: mkhris pa las gyur pa'i nad thams cad shantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: bad kan las gyur pa'i nad thams cad= ldan pa las gyur pa'i nad thams cad= 'dus pa las gyur pa'i nad thams cad shantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa yi: rang bzhin longs sku'i bdud rtsi'i chus: deng 'dir khyod la khrus bgyis pa: gzhan dbang sngon las las gyur nad: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zhi gyur cig: kā ya wā ka tsitta sarba ro ge bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa yi: thugs rje sprul sku'i bdud rtsi'i chus: deng 'dir khyod la khrus bgyis pas: kun brtags gdon las gyur pa'i nad: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zhi gyur cig:

kā ya wā ka tsitta sarba ro ge bhyaḥshantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa yi: sku gsung dbyer med bdud rtsi'i: deng 'dir khyod la khrus bgyis pas: ltar snang 'phral rkyen las gyur nad: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zhi gyur cig: kā ya wā ka tsitta sarba ro ge bhyaḥshantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes brjod rdo rje'i go chas bsrung : spro na sman dang dkar mngar zas: byin rlabs bden stobs brjod cing sbyin: nad kyi g.yul las rgyal bar bsam: sa ma ya: gdon bgegs gtor mas sbyang ba ni: 'byung bzhi'i glud gtor bsangs sbyangs la: byin rlabs 'dod dgu'i gter du bsam: bden pa'i stobs kyis mgron rnams bkug: hūm̐: nga ni bcom ldan gsang ba'i bdag: rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa ste: sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu stobs dang : byin rlabs thugs rje gcig bsdus nas: gdug pa 'dul bar dbang yang bskur: de phyir gdon bgegs 'byung po kun: nga yi bka' la 'da' ma byed: khro rgyal rdo rje'i bka' las ni: 'byung po gang zhig bda' byed pa'i: lus ngag yid gsum rdul du rlog: ming yang grags par mi 'gyur phyir: de bas dam la gnas par gyis: zhes brjod gzungs sngags lan gsum bzla: 'bru gsum sngon 'gro saṃ bhā ra: nyer gcig dag gis gtor ma bsngo: hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes de bzhin gshegs: rnam par snang mdzad ting 'dzin dang : sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs: mthu stobs byin rlabs gcig bsdus pa: gsang ba'i bdag po'i bka' 'byung gi: shar phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na: gnas pa'i lha srin sde brgyad dang : ma rig gti mug las byung ba'i: klu gdon sum brgya drug cu kun: 'byung ba sa yi dngas ma'i bcud: gcig bsdus 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i sprin: glud gtor bzang po 'di khyer la: bsgrub bya'i lus ngag yid gsum la: bzung ba thong la bcings pa khrol: bsdams pa klod la mnan pa theg:

phyin chad gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor spongs: gal te bka' las 'da' byed na: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku las sprul pa'i khro bo'i rgyal: gti mug rnam dag he ru ka: rdo rje gtum po thugs khros nas: 'bar ba'i mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis: lus ngag yid gsum rdul du brlag: de bas da lta phyir dengs shig: oṃ buddha ma hā kro dha ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: mnyam nyid ye shes 'dod dgu'i gter: rin chen 'byung ldan ting 'dzin dang : sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs: mthu stobs byin rlabs gcig bsdus pa: gsang ba'i bdag po'i bka' byung gi: lho phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na: gnas pa'i lha srin sde brgyad dang : ma rig nga rgyal las byung ba'i: pho gdon sum brgya drug cu kun: 'byung ba chu yi dwangs ma'i bcud: gcig bsdus 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i sprin: glud gtor bzang po 'di khyer la: bsgrub bya'i lus ngag yid gsum la: bzung ba thong la bcings pa khrol: bsdams pa klod la mnan pa theg: phyin chad gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyaur spongs: gal te bka' las 'da' byed na: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku las byung ba'i khro bo'i rgyal: nga rgyal rnam dag he ru ka: rdo rje be con thugs khros nas: 'bar ba'i mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis: lus ngag yid gsum rdul du brlag: de bas rang rang phyir dengs shig: oṃ ratna ma hā kro dha tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: sor rtog ye shes padma'i rigs: snang ba mtha' yas ting 'dzin dang : sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs: mthu stobs byin rlabs gcig bsdus pa: gsang ba'i bdag po'i bka' byung gi: nub phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na: gnas pa'i lha srin sde brgyad dang : ma rig 'dod chags las byung ba'i: mo gdon sum brgya drug cu kun: 'byung ba me yi dwangs ma'i bcud: gcis bsdus 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i sprin: glud gtor bzang po 'di khyer la:

bsgrub bya'i lus ngag yid gsum la: bzung ba thong la bcings pa khrol: bsdams pa klod la mnan pa theg: phyin chad gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor spongs: gal te bka' las 'da' byed na: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: gsung las sprul pa'i khro bo'i rgyal: 'dod chags rnam dag he ru ka: rdo rje tho ba thugs khros nas: 'bar ba'i mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis: lus ngag yid gsum rdul du brlag: de bas da lta phyir dengs shig: oṃ padma ma hā kro dha bhandha bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: bya grub ye shes las kyi rigs: don yod grub pa'i ting 'dzin dang : sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs: mthu stobs byin rlabs gcig bsdus pa: gsang ba'i bdag po'i bka' byung gi: byang phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na: gnas pa'i lha srin sde brgyad dang : ma rig phrag dog las byung ba'i: sna tshogs 'khrul pa'i gdon bgegs kun: 'byung ba rlung gi dwangs ma'i bcud: gcig bsdus 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i sprin: glud gtor bzang po 'di khyer la: bsgrub bya'i lus ngag yid gsum la: bzung ba thong la bcings pa khrol: bsdams pa klod la mnan pa theg: phyin chad gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor spongs: gal te bka' las 'da' byed na: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: phrin las sprul pa'i khro bo'i rgyal: phrag dog rnam dag he ru ka: rdo rje phur bu thugs khros nas: 'bar ba'i mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis: lus ngag yid gsum rdul du brlag: de bas da lta phyir dengs shig: oṃ karma ma hā kro dha hu lu hu lu hūm̐ pha¿ṭa: slar yang glud phran gtor ma dang : chang bu la sogs ci 'byor bsham: 'bru gsum byin rlabs saṃ bha ras: nam mkha' mdzod kyi sprin du bsngos: khyer cig khyer cig stobs ldan rnams: sred dang chags dang zhen pa rnams: dran dang bzung dang bsam dang reg: klod dang grol dang zhi bar mdzod: de mthar glud gtor phyi rol bskyal: gu gul bdug cing thun gyis brabs:
