hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyi mtshon chas gzir: phyi nang gsang ba'i 'khor los bcings: sa ma ya: 'gal rkyen 'khor los srung ba ni: gro ga'am ni shog bu la: rgya snag gi waṃ sbyar ba yis: sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba ru: tsakra mu khyud rim lngar bskor: dbus su hūm̐ mthar yang snying gsham: 'chang ba po la nad gdon sdig sgrib grib dang mi btsang ba sogs bar du gcod pa dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad rakṣa rakṣa: de phyi mu khyud dang po la: rtsibs bzhi shar nas g.yas bskor du: oṃ buddha ma hā kro dha ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: 'chang ba po'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing srung ba la bar du gcod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa: oṃ ratna ma hā kro dha tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūm̐ phaṭa: tshe dang bsod nams ye shes rgyas par byed pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa: oṃ padma ma hā kro dha bhandha bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa: khams gsum dbang du bya ba la bar du gcod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa: oṃ karma ma hā kro dha hu lu hu lu hūm̐ pha¿ṭa: dgra bgegs 'byung po tshar bcad pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa: zhes dang rtsibs mchan so so la: oṃ ā mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa: gzungs sngags kyi las sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa: mu khyud gnyis par rtsibs bzhi la: pra ha ra pra ha ra badzra pra bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭa: 'chang ba po'i nad gdon bar chad sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: trā sa ya trā sa ya badzra kī li kī la ya: tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes thams cad puṣtiṃ ku ru oṃ: ha ra ha ra badzra dhā ra ya: khams gsum snod bcud rlung sems thams cad wā shaṃ ku ru ho: tsu ru tsu ru tsaṇḍa kī li kī la ya gnod byed 'byung po dug lnga dug gsum thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa: rtsib mchan a mṛ te yi gsham: shāntiṃ puṣtiṃ wā shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: gsum par 'khor lo rtsibs bcu'i dbus: mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du:

oṃ ha ra ha ra badzra hūm̐ phaṭa: 'chang ba po la steng lha yi gdon gyi gnod pa dang drag po'i las sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa: oṃ ma tha ma tha badzra hūm̐ phaṭa: shar phyogs dri za'i gdon gyi gnod pa dang drag po'i las sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa: oṃ dhū na dhū na badzra hūm̐ phaṭa: shar lho me lha'i gdon gyi gnod pa dang dbang gi las sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa: oṃ da ha da ha badzra hūm̐ phaṭa: lho phyogs gshin rje'i gdon gyi gnod pa dang dbang gi las sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa: oṃ pa tsa pa tsa badzra hūm̐ phaṭa: lho nub srin po'i gdon gyi gnod pa dang drag po'i las sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa: oṃ dhā ra dhā ra badzra hūm̐ phaṭa: nub phyogs klu yi gdon gyi gnod pa dang zhi ba'i las sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa: oṃ dhā ra ya dhā ra ya badzra hūm̐ phaṭa: nub byang rlung lha'i gdon gyi gnod pa dang rgyas pa'i las sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa: oṃ dā ru ṇa dā ru ṇa badzra hūm̐ phaṭa: byang phyogs gnod sbyin gdon gyi gnod pa dang zhi ba'i las: oṃ tstshinda tstshinda badzra hūm̐ phaṭa: byang shar bgegs kyi gnod pa dang rig sngags bcad pa'i sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa: oṃ bhindha bhindha badzra hūm̐ phaṭa: 'og phyogs sa bdag gi gdon gyi gnod pa dang rig sngags mnan pa'i las sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa:

zhes dang rtsibs mchan dang por mthun: ma khyud bzhi par gzungs ring mthar: 'chang ba po la mi chod pa mi shigs pa sogs nas: rmugs par byed pa'i gsang sngags kyi mthu chen po de dag thogs pa med par rab tu 'grub par gyur cig swā hā: de phyi mu khyud lnga pa la: na maḥs manta buddhā ṇāṃ: na maḥs manta dharmā nāṃ: na ma sa manta saṃ ghā nāṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: oṃ ḍhriṣta raṣta ye swā hā: oṃ bai ru dhā kā ye swā hā: oṃ bai ru pākṣā ye swā hā: oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ye swā hā: oṃ sarba badzra kiṅka rī swā hā: zhes dang rten snying tshar gsum mthar: rnam bzhi'i las dang gzungs sngags kyi: phrin las 'grub pa'i spel tshig sbyar: phyi rol sna tshogs rdo rje yi: bar mtshams me ris mdzes par bya: spy-i ru lnga tshan lnga yi rdzas: khyab par byug cing bye brag tu: 'og nas 'byung ba'i so so'i rdzas: man ngag gnad dang ldan par byug: ma nyams shel dang rin po che: me tog sngon po gi'u wang: yungs kar shu dag rma bya'i sgro: pha bong long bu dar tshon lnga: sa sna chu sna tshogs tshad dang : khyad par zhi bar a ru ra: rgyas par dūrba dbang la ni: sindhu ra dang drag po la: rtsa ba gsum gyi phye mar bcas: dkyil 'khor dbus su lags par bkod: lhar bskyed bzlas pa'i me tog gis: rab tu gnas shing shis pa brjod: gtso 'khor 'od zhu 'khor lo bsam: dar sna lnga yis rgya chings gdab: spyi bo'i gtsug gam mgul du 'chang : mthong thos dran reg 'gro kun kyang : gnas skabs nad gdon 'jigs brgyad zhi: tshe bsod rgyas shing 'dod dgu 'grub: mi mthun phyogs rnams tshar gcod 'gyur: mthar thug rdo rje gtum po yi: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjer sbyor: phrin las gsang bdag nyid dang mtshungs: de phyir yid bzhin nor las lhag: gzhan yang rdzas kyis srung ba ni: shu dag a ru gi 'u wang :

li khri sindhū ra btsan dug bu tsaṇḍa: yungadakar/ spang spos ga bur sdong ros dang : ming can gla rtsi spru ba nag: gu gul nag po ru rta dang : yung ba spos dkar a gar nag: rdzas sna bcu bdun lha gnas bkod: mtha' skor bzang po drug la sogs: dri ldan sman sna gang 'byor dang : khyad par chig thub dpa' bo gnyis: dpa' bo dkar po dang rdo khab len/ ra mnye zi ra dkar nag dang : shing kun mkhan dmar lcags kyu ba: phur nag rdo rje gnyis bcas bkram: khrol bu'i steng du lha tshogs bskyed: bzlas pas sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun: dpag tu med pa babs pa yis: rdzas rnams mi gtsang nyes skyon sbyangs: nus pa mchog tu bskyed par bsam: thun rer gzungs sngags ci nus dang : rang sngags brgya rtsa la sogs bzla: mtshan ma thob kyi bar du bsgrubs: de nas lhan cig zhib par btags: lnga tshan lnga yi rdzas dang bcas: rigs bzang lo brgyad dri chu'am: ba gsar dmar zal chu dang sbyar: bum par tshul bzhin bsgrub cing bzla: mthar ni ril bur dril ba nyid: rin po che yi snod du blugs: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ngo bor bsgom: gzungs sngags snying po nye snying dang : skabs su ngar 'dogs spu gri'i sngags: oṃ thi ma tha ra ti sa dunte dzwa la raṃ pa ye swā hā: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa khroṃ ga ru ḍā sarba duṣtānta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa: nā ga du: tshandhe tshandhe: mi li mi li: bhandha bhandha: nā ga ni swā hā: zhes pa spel zhing drag tu bzla: grub nas ye shes lha tshogs gshegs: dam tshig 'od zhu ril bur bsam: rten 'brel snying po brgya rtsa yis: byin rlabs brtan cing nus ldan bya: ril bu bdun re lus la bcang : mi mthun phyogs rnams kun bsrungs nas: phrin las rnam bzhi gang brtsams 'grub: khong su btang dang byugs pa dang : du bas bdug pa tsam gyis kyang : gdon dang bgegs kyi tshogs rnams la: rdo rje gtum po'i snang ba 'byung :

bar chad phyogs su nye mi nus: nad rims me ltar 'bar ba dang : gdon bgegs chu ltar 'khrugs pa sogs: 'jigs pa'i cho 'phrul ci byung yang : ba spu'i rtse mo'ang g.yo mi nus: grib dang mi gtsang rang sar grol: mthar thug mkha' spyod nyid kyang 'grub: rdzas kyi sbyor ba mang bstan yang : 'di 'dra'i zab mo'i gdams pa ni: gzhan du nam yang bstan pa med: de phyir sny-ing las gces par zungs: sa ma ya: mthun rkyen me yis sgrub pa ni: thun mong shis pa'i stegs bu'i steng : sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba ru: mu khyud rim pa gsum gyi dbus: padma 'dab ma lnga pa dang : de rgyab 'khor lo rtsibs bcu ste: de rgyab sna tshogs padma dang : tha mar 'bar ba'i phreng bas bskor: dri bzang bud shing zur brgyad brtsegs: bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon 'gro bas: me sbar 'jig rten me lha mchod: de yi lto ba yangs pa'i klong : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gzhung bzhin la: 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro bar bskyed: spyan drangs mchod cing bstod pa'i rjes: hūm̐: thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug pa'i: rdo rje'i dgangs blugs las byung ba'i: ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod sprin gyis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gnyes pa las: thugs rje chen po'i 'od zer gyis: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas mchod: 'gro kun sgrib gnyis yongs su sbyangs: gang 'dul phrin las lhun grub gyur: zhes brjod nye ba'i snying po'i mthar: rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i dam tshig nyams chags zhi zhing mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol: zhes brjod rdzas rnams so sor 'bul: skabs su las bzhi'i spel tshig sbyar: bzlas pas thugs dam rgyud bskul zhing : ci 'dod dngos grub thob par bsam: mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba gdab: nongs pa bshags shing ye shes gshegs: dam tshig lha tshogs rang la bsdu: 'jig rten me lha mchod cing gshegs:

khyad par zhi ba'i phrin las la: dkar zhing 'jam pa'i stegs bu'i ngos: dkyil 'khor dkar shas che ba 'bri: dri bzang 'o ma dang bcas pa'i: bud shing zlum po'i tshul du brtsigs: shar du kha phyogs chas gos dkar: zhi zhing dwangs ba'i bsam pa yis: rdo rje'i 'dug stangs dag gis 'dug: bram ze'i khyim nas me blangs sbar: 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi: me lha chu shel mdog tu bskyed: gtso bor bsregs rdzas sngags sham du: 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug la sogs pa mi mthun mi mdod pa'i phyogs thams cad shantiṃ ku ru swā hā: zhes spel tshig brgya rtsa brgyad phul bas: thugs nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis: mdun gyi rdo rje gtum po bskul: de las 'od zer dkar po 'phros: mi mthun phyogs kun zhi bar bsam: hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes de bzhin rigs kyi lha: bcom ldan rdo rje gtum po 'khor bcas kyis: bsreg blugs bdud rtsi'i mchod sprin 'di bzhes la: zhi ba'i phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod: oṃ buddha ma hā kro dha ha na ha na hūm̐ pha¿ṭa: zhes dang skabs su spel tshig sbyar: rjes kyi rim pa spy-i dang mtshungs: de bzhin rgyas dang dbang drag gi: khyad par bsgyur la nyams su blang : zhi ba'i las la til nyid de: rgyas par zas mchog dbang la ni: me tog dmar po'i rigs rnams dang : drag po yungs kar gtso bor 'bul: lha sngags dmigs pa'i gnad ldan na: gnas skabs mthar thug 'dod pa'i don: phrin las rnam bzhi gang brtsam kun: 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med: sa ma ya: mthar thug mchog gi dngos grub ni: rim gnyis zab mo'i lam gyis bsgrub: rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i rjes 'gro bar: nyams su blangs pa'i dang po ni: skyabs song byang chub sems gnyis bskyed: snying ga'i 'od kyis ye shes pa: spyan drangs tshogs gnyis nye bar bsag: rang nyid yi dam lha ru bskyed: mdun bskyed rang bstims rang nyid kyi:

thugs las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis: snod bcud dkyil 'khor 'khor lor sbyangs: snang grags rigs gsum lha sngags dang : ye shes gcig tu mnyam par bzhag: de nas lha sku snang stong la: sems 'dzin zhi gnas 'grub pa dang : de la so sor dpyad pa yis: stong nyid rjes mthun lhag mthong bsgom: zung 'jug chu zla lta bu'i ngang : 'bru gsum rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang : srog stsol rlung sbyor bde drod spar: rang 'od phyag rgyar snyoms 'jug pas: dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes bskyed: lhan skyes phyag rgya chen po'i ngang : zung 'jug don gyi rdo rje yis: glo bur 'khrul pa rnam bcom pas: mi slob go 'phang mchog tu grub: sa ma ya: rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba che: rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa yi: gzung sngags zab mo'i phrin las 'di: ma 'ongs don du padmas bsdebs: chos dbyings bum sku'i sgrom bur rgya: nam zhig 'gro don dus babs rtags: gza' klu rgyal bsen rlung ltar 'tshubs: nad gdon smyo 'bogs chu ltar g.yo: khyad par dal yams btsan thabs 'bebs: phyi snod 'byung ba khol bur g.yo: nang bcud stod smad 'khrugs pa mang : de yi tshe na bdag nyid dang : 'jam dpal grub pa'i slob dpon gyi: byin brlabs sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa: 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje dang : 'phrad nas 'brel tshad don ldan shog: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: 'jam dpal 'chi bdag zil gnon bzhugs: dhī/: rtsa gsum yongs 'dus lha la 'dud: ma 'ongs rnal 'byor spyod pa rnams: 'chi bdag bdud dpung gzhom 'dod na: sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku: 'jam dpal khrag 'thung bsgrub par bya: sa ma ya: dben pa'i gnas su stegs bu'i khar: rang byung bhandha'i gzhal yas su: ya mānta ka'i phyag rgya bri: de mthar phyi nang mchod pas bskor: sngon 'gro'i rim pas rgyud sbyangs nas: dngos gzhir lha yi rnal 'byor ni:

hūm̐: chos kun mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang : rin chen khros pas nyon mongs gcod: gzung 'dzin 'byung po dbyings su bsgral: gnyis med ye shes gcig tu shar: oṃ ya mānta ka hūm̐ pha¿ṭa: de nyid ngang las skad cig gis: stong gsal rig pa'i cho 'phrul las: thod dbyug mthing nag yaḥyis mtshan: 'od 'phros don gnyis lhun gyis grub: tshur 'dus padma nyi ma dang : dregs pa chu glang gdan gyi steng : rang rig 'jam dpal he ru ka: dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas thod dbyug nam mkhar 'phyar: g.yon pas bhan dmar thugs kar bsnams: sbyor yum rdo rje bai tā li: rin chen thod khrag bsnams pas 'khril: dpal dang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: zhabs gnyis dor stabs gdan la rol: ye shes me phung 'bar ba'i klong : rab khros gar dgu'i nyams kyis brjid: gnas gsum de bzhin gshegs kun gyi: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i dngos: 'bru gsum phyag rgyas mtshan pa las: 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes las: rin chen rigs mchog bcom ldan 'das: 'jam dpal khro bo'i skur bzhengs nas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: oṃ shrī badzra ya mānta ka sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje'i dbang po dgyes pa'i yul: bde chen dam tshig mchog gi sprin: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po yis: 'jam dpal khrag 'thung mnyes gyur cig: oṃ shrī ya mānta ka sa pa ri wā ra rū pa shapda gandhe rā' sa sparshe dharma dha tu sarba pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi: ye shes lus can 'jam dpal dbyangs: gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i tshul: yab yum sprul par bcas la bstod: nus pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor ni: thugs kar nyi steng yaḥyig mthar: sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor ba las: 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun mchod: 'chi bdag bdud dpung bsreg cing sbyangs:

phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub: thams cad 'od gsal 'khor lor shar: oṃ hrīṣtī wīṣti ta na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: rtsa ba'i bsnyen sngags 'bru bcu bzhi: bsnyen sgrub las gsum chig chod de: bdun 'bum sa ya bye ba sogs: mtshan ma thob kyi bar du bzla: rnam bzhi'i phrin las gang la yang : 'jam dpal khrag 'thung nyid dang mtshungs: sa ma ya: slob ma rjes su bzung ba ni: bdag mdun dbyer med bskyed bzlas dang : sngon 'gro spy-i bzhin sbyar ba'i rjes: dngos gzhir bum pa sku yi dbang : hūm̐: rin chen bum pa'i gzhal yas na: 'jam dpal khro bo'i lha tshogs bzhugs: deng 'dir khyod la dbang bskur bas: bskyed pa sku yi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags dang : kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: dpal dang dur khrod chas dbang ni: hūm̐: dpal dang dur khrod rol pa'i chas: 'di ni 'jam dpal he ru ka'i: ye shes mchog gi phyag rgya ste: dpa' bo chen po khyod kyis longs: dzñā na mu dra sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bzlas pa'i sngags byang mgrin par bzhag: hūm̐: thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba las: zung 'jug yi ge bcu bzhi byung : deng 'dir khyod la dbang bskur bas: bzlas pa sngags kyi dbang thob shog: wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ rjes 'brel bzlas pa'i lung kyang 'bogs: thugs kyi phyag mtshan snying gar bzhag: hūm̐: rdo rje'i thod dbyug 'phyar ba yis: gzung 'dzin 'byung po dbyings su bsgral: deng 'dir khyod la dbang bskur bas: 'od gsal thugs kyi dbang thob shog: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: yon tan thod khrag lag g.yon gtad: hūm̐: yon tan mi zad 'dod dgu'i gter: bhandha raktas bkang ba yis: deng 'dir khyod la dbang bskur bas: gang 'dul 'gro ba sgrol bar shog: gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa swā: phrin las phur bu bsgril zhing byin: hūm̐: phrin las drag po kī la ya: 'jam dpal khro bo'i nus mthu rdzogs: deng 'dir khyod la dbang bskur bas:

'chi bdag bdud dpung tshar gcod shog: karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hā: spro na dgra bgegs bar chad kun: gzugs brnyan sbyor ba la bstims nas: gdab pa'i phrin las spyi ltar rjes: nang gi sbyin sreg tshul du rol: rjes su dam tshig khas blangs shing : tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i 'du bas mchod: 'dis ni bsnyen rdzogs rtags ldan pa'i: mtshan nyid tshang ba'i slob dpon gyis: dad brtson skal bar ldan pa yi: rdo rje'i slob ma rjes bzung na: gnas skabs tshe yi bar chad dang : 'jigs brgyad mi mthun phyogs kun zhi: phrin las gang brtsam yid bzhin 'grub: mthar thug 'jam dpal khro bo'i skur: mngon par byang chub mchog thob 'gyur: sa ma ya: gshin rje mthar byed sgrub pa'i thabs: kun las khyad 'phags snying po'i bcud: da lta mnga' bdag yab sras dang : ma 'ongs sprul pa'i skyes bu'i don: 'jam dpal chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis: rjes bzung rang byung rig pa 'dzin: bdag nyid chen po padma yis: dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro'i brda ru sbas: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: kha yaṃḥ guhya lo bdun gsang rgya byas nas phyis rten 'brel dus la babs pa'i skad cig la dag par phabs pa shin tu gsang ba'i snying tig go: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: 'chi med dbang chen 'dus pa bzhugs: dhī/: dbang chen 'dus pa'i lha la 'dud: chos rnams kun gyi de kho na: so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni: don dam rta mchog rol pa ste: 'gro kun snying la yang dag gnas: de nyid ma rtogs gdul bya'i don: bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug phrin las kyi: mchog thun dngos grub myur 'grub slad: dbang chen 'dus pa'i sgrub pa bstan: sa ma ya: dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas mchog tu: dkyil 'khor dmar zlum bkod legs steng : lha dang sngags kyi mtshan ma dgod: dbus su phur pa rta zhal can: g.yas g.yon thabs shes dngos grub rdzas: mdun du gtor ma tshogs mchod dang :

rgyab tu tshe yi mda' 'dar te: mtha' bskor phyi nang mchod pa'i sprin: bag dro lhun chags mdzes par bsham: sa ma ya: de nas bde ba'i stan la 'dug: skad cig rig pa stong gsal ngang : bcos min snying rje mngon bzhag nas: sngon 'gro'i dang po skyabs sems ni:

hrī: dbang chen rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la: bdag sogs byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun phan bde'i go 'phang la 'god phyir: smon 'jug don dam sems mchog bskyed par bgyi: lan gsum gnyis pa mtshams bcad ni: bar 'dir bgegs gtor dngos su bsham pa yod na: skyabs yul rnams rang la thim: rang nyid skad cig gis dbang chen he ru ka'i skur gyur: gtor ma ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa brlab: sarba bhū ta ā karṣa ya dzaḥ sa mgron dgug: sarba bighnān ba ling ta khā hi sa gtor ma bsngos la bka' bsgo ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ yongs grub spros pa bral ba'i ye shes las: kun brtags glo bur 'khrul pa'i gdon bgegs kun: gzhan dbang dag pa rab 'byams 'dod yon gter: 'di nyid longs la rgya mtsho'i pha mthar dengs: sgrub sngags mthar: sumbha brjod pas bskrad: hrīḥ phyi snod dbang chen rdo rje'i pho brang dbus: nang bcud ye shes lha yi phyag rgyar gsal: tha mal rtogs tshogs rang grol gnyug ma'i ngang : gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i gdon bgegs mtshams gcod do: badzra dzñā na rakṣa bhrūm̐: gsum pa ye shes byin 'bebs ni: hrī: sku gsum dag pa dbyings kyi gzhal yas nas: rig pa ye shes rta mchog he ru ka: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i 'khor bcas kyis: gnas 'dir byin phob mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ hrīḥpadmānta kṛ ta badzra krodha hya gri ba sa pa ri wā ra dzñā na badzra ā be sha ya a āḥ bzhi pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos su 'byor pa'i mchod pa ji snyed dang : yid sprul ting nge 'dzin gyis byin brlabs pas: snang srid gzhir bzhengs phyag rgya chen po'i dbyings: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes pa'i dpyid du shar: oṃ hrīḥsarba pū dza me gha sa ma ye ā: hūm̐: lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab: sa ma ya: dngos gzhir dang po bskyed rim ni: hrī:

chos sku skye med de bzhin nyid dbyings las: longs sku 'gags med kun snang snying rje'i sprin: sprul pa'i rnam rol hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros: 'phags mchod 'gro kun sgrib sbyangs tshur 'dus pas: phyi snod dag pa lha yi gzhal med khang : 'og min dbang chen rol pa'i pho brang dbus: padma nyi zla klu srin bsnol ba'i steng : rtsa gsum kun 'dus dbang chen he ru ka: sku mdog dmar po skal pa'i me ltar 'bar: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi 'dor stabs bgrad: g.yas ljang g.yon dkar dbus dmar khro bo'i gdong : zhal rer dmar zlum 'bar ba'i spyan gsum g.yo: ral pa khams nag gyen du 'khyil ba'i klong : rta zhal ljang gu rdo rje'i dbyangs su 'tsher: phyag drug g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭwām̐ gri: g.yon gsum bhandha mdung thung zhags pa bsnams: thod skam dbu rgyan thod rlon do shal dang : rigs bzhi'i klu gdon sbrul gyi rnam pas spras: zhing chen g.yang gzhi stag lpags sham thabs sogs: dpal dang dur khrod rol pa'i chas kyis brgyan: sbyor ba'i yum chen padma gzi ldan dmar: phyag g.yas gri gug yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: g.yon pas bdud rtsi'i thod pa yab la stob: spy-i gtsug phag zhal mthing nag ngur sgra sgrogs: ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus: sku gsung thugs mchog gar dgu'i nyams kyis rol: spy-i bor rigs bdag chos sku snang mtha' yas: 'chi med bde chen skur bzhengs tshe yi lha: dmar po mnyam bzhag bdud rtsi'i tshe bum bsnams: mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar rang 'od yum dang sbyor: sku yi gnas lngar thod phreng rigs lnga dang : ba spu'i bu ga rdo rje'i khro bos gtams: phyogs bzhir pad nyi bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i steng : shar du rdo rje dbang chen sku mdog dkar: lho ru ratna dbang chen sku mdog ser: nub tu padma dbang chen sku mdog dmar: byang du karma dbang chen sku mdog ljang : thams cad phyag g.yas rigs kyi phyag mtshan dang :

g.yon pas bdud rtsis gang ba'i bhandha bsnams: rang 'od yum 'khyud khro bo'i cha lugs rdzogs: sgo bzhir tshad med ye shes sgo ma bzhi: g.yas rnams lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril: g.yon pas 'chi med tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: dkar ser dmar ljang khro chags sgeg pa'i nyams: gzhan yang sprul dang yang sprul dkyil 'khor lha: rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i ngo bor sprin ltar gtibs: snang stong sgrib bral 'ja' tshon lta bu'i sku'i: gnas gsum rdo rje gsum gyis mtshan pa las: 'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas nas ye shes pa: ma lus spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur: gnyis pa ye shes spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐ hrī: 'og min gsang chen rdo rje'i pho brang nas: rtsa gsum kun 'dus dbang chen tshe yi lha: rab 'byams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'khor dang bcas: byin gyis brlab phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: oṃ hrīḥpadmānta kṛ ta badzra krodha hya gri ba sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dza dza: gsum pa bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni: hrīḥ dbyings nas spyan drangs ye shes lha yi tshogs: dam tshig phyag rgya'i ngang du ro gcig phyir: 'du 'bral med pa'i don dam rta mchog dpal: mngon sum rang ngor mjal ba'i phyag gis 'dud: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ na ma dhīḥ bzhi pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: phyi nang gsang ba bla med mchod pa'i sprin: rtsa gsum dbang chen kun 'dus lha la 'bul: bzhes nas mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ hrīḥpadmānta kṛ ta badzra krodha hya gri ba sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas spar she'i bar dang ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta sta na gha ṇa sarba pū dza hoḥ lnga pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hrīḥ sor rtogs ye shes phyag rgyar shar ba'i lha: grangs med zhi dang khro bo'i rnam rol can: byin rlabs mchog stsol dngos grub char 'bebs pa'i: dbang chen rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la bstod:

drug pa bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor ni: thugs kar ye shes 'od lnga'i klong : nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor dbus: thugs srog hrīḥyig dmar po'i mthar: sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor ba las: bde stong rol pa'i 'od zer gyis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gsal bar byas: snyoms 'jug dga' bzhi'i mchod pas mnyes: mchog thun dngos grub thob par gyur: oṃ hrīḥpadmānta kṛ ta badzra krodha hya gri ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: bdun pa sgrub pa'i ting 'dzin ni: slar yang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: 'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i tshe bsod bcud: 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkug: spy-i bo'i rigs bdag yab yum gyi: sku yi dbyibs brgyud sbyor mtshams nas: babs pas lus gang bde bas myos: 'khor lo rnam lngar khyab pa yis: 'chi med thod phreng yab yum mchod: rtsa rlung thig le nyams pa gsos: 'byung bzhi'i dwangs ma dbu mar smin: bde stong zung 'jug 'od gsal ngang : rdo rje'i srog la dbang thob bsam: oṃ hrīḥpadmānta kṛ ta badzra krodha hya gri ba dzñā na badzra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bhrūm̐ nṛ dza: sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: brgyad pa las la sbyar ba ni: thugs srog las byung 'od zer gyis: rnam bzhi'i phrin las lhun gyis grub: dregs pa sde brgyad brlag cing gzir: snod bcud 'od gsal 'khor lor sbyangs: gang shar snang cha lha yi sku: grags pa thams cad sngags kyi sgra: dran rtog rang grol rta mchog dpal: dbyings rig dbyer med ngang du rdzogs: oṃ hrīḥpadmānta kṛ ta badzra krodha hya gri ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badzra duu na bhyo: tig nan dza dza: sa ma ya stāṃ: sa ma ya dza: sa ma ya bzlog: sa ma ya bhyo: sa ma ya gtub: sa ma ya byer: sa ma ya rbad: sa ma ya rbad rbud pha¿ṭa ya: 'byung po mā ra ya dza dza: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes bzlas dgongs pa dbyings la gtad: dgu pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni: rdo rje'i bzlas pa sngon 'gro bas:

sbyor ba bzhi ldan bum can bzung : 'bar dang 'dzag pa'i rnal 'byor gyis: lugs 'byung lugs ldog dga' bzhi bskyed: las dang ye shes phyag rgya la: 'du shes gsum gyi snyoms par zhugs: zag pa med pa'i bde ba dang : lhan skyes phyag rgya chen por sbyor: 'tsher zhing brjid bag ldan pa yi: rta skad thengs gsum bsgrags pa'i rjes: rtse gcig nges shes skyes pa na: skye med don gyi ngang du bzhag: yid mig rlung gsum mi 'gul bar: dbyings gsum rta mchog rol pa'i lha: dus gsum dus med chen po ru: mnyam par bzhag pas rang zhal blta: sa ma ya: rjes kyi rim par dang po ni: tshe bcud 'gugs phyir thugs dam bskul: hrīḥ skye med 'od gsal rdo rje'i mkha' dbyings las: 'gags med dbang chen khro bo'i rol par shar: rab 'byams rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas: thugs dam bskul lo thugs rje'i ye shes bskyed: hrīḥ thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang tshe yi lhas: 'khor 'das dbyer med rdo rje'i tshe bcud khug: 'chi med dbang chen khro rgyal yab yum gyis: zung 'jug sku dang ye shes tshe bcud khug: sprul pa'i rnam rol rigs bzhi'i he ru kas: khams gsum skye 'gro yongs kyi tshe bcud khug: gang 'dul las mdzad phyogs skyong sgo ma bzhis: sa chu me rlung 'byung bzhi'i tshe bcud khug: rab 'byams rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs kyis: brtan g.yo snod bcud srid zhi'i tshe bcud khug: rtse gcig sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bdag cag gi: bla tshe chad nyams yar ba rang sor chud: bar chad 'byung po'i tshogs rnams dbyings su sgrol: 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ hrīḥpadmānta kṛ ta badzra krodha hya gri ba ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bhrūm̐ nṛ dza: sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: kā ya wā ka tsitta dharma dhā tu dzñā na badzra rakṣa bhrūm̐: gnyis pa mchod bstod dngos grub blang : hūm̐ hrīḥ 'chi med bde chen rdo rje'i pho brang nas:

rtsa gsum dbang chen tshe yi lha tshogs kyis: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus kun: deng 'dir skal ldan bdag la stsal du gsol: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya wā ka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la hoḥ gsum pa rtag chad mtha' bsal ba: āḥ snang char shar ba'i ye shes lha tshogs kun: skye med brjod bral chos kyi dbyings su thim: slar yang rig stong zung 'jug ye shes las: sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gsum gyi ngang du sbyor: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bzhi pa bsngo smon bya ba ni: hoḥ dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs ci mchis pa: blo 'das chos dbyings gzhon nu bum skur bsngo: 'gro kun 'chi med rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i zhal: rta mchog rol pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog: shis pa brjod cing me tog 'thor: mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor bsdu: dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs: gzhung gzhan dag dang mthun par spyad: sa ma ya: gnas skabs rnam bzhi'i phrin las dang : tshe dbang rig 'dzin mchog 'grub cing : mthar thug padma gsung gi dbyings: sbyor byed rdo rje'i nye lam 'di: rang byung padma bdag nyid kyi: tand+ra kun gyi bcud bsdus nas: 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje'i don: rig pa dbyings kyi sgrom bur sbas: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: dhī/: 'chi med dbang chen 'dus pa las: smin byed byin rlabs snang ba bzhugs: dhī/: dbang chen 'dus pa'i lha la 'dud: slob ma rjes su 'dzin 'dod na: dben pa'i gnas su stegs bu'i khar: dkyil 'khor bsham zhing sgrub rdzas bkram: bdag mdun dbyer med bskyed bzlas bya: snod ldan khrus byas gral la 'khod: bgegs phral srung ba'i 'khor los bcing : lo rgyus bshad cing maṇḍal 'bul: de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni: rigs rnams kun bdag che ba'i mchog: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: 'chi med rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor du: mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal: lan gsum skyabs sems sdoms pa 'bogs:

lhar bskyed ye shes dbab cing bstim: dngos gzhir bum pa spy-i bor bskur: hrī: 'chi med rta mchog he ru ka'i: sku yi dbang bskur khyod la sbyin: phung po lha yi skur smin nas: snang stong zung 'jug mngon gyur shog: bsnyen sngags dang : kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: rjes 'brel gtor ma spy-i bor bzhag: hrīḥ zab gsal gnyis med dkyil 'khor du: 'chi med rtsa gsum lha tshogs bzhugs: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub par shog: bsnyen sngags dang : sarba siddhi ba liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: rtsa ba'i sngags byang mgrin par gtad: hrīḥ 'chi med rta mchog he ru ka'i: gsung gi dbang bskur khyod la sbyin: srog stsol sngags su yongs smin nas: gsal stong zung 'jug mngon gyur shog: bsnyen sngags dang : wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ rjes 'brel sngags kyi bzlas lung dang : mtha' brten tshe yi bdud rtsi sbyin: hrīḥ rtsa gsum dbang chen 'dus pa yi: byin rlabs dngos grub kun gyi dbyig: 'chi med bdud rtsi 'di byin pas: rlung lnga dbu mar thim par shog: sgrub sngags dang : ma hā pañtsa a yurdzñā na a mṛ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ yab yum phyag mtshan snying gar bzhag: hrīḥ 'chi med rta mchog he ru ka'i: thugs kyi dbang bskur khyod la sbyin: rtog tshogs chos kyi skur smin nas: bde stong zung 'jug mngon gyur shog: bsnyen sngags: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: mtha' brten tshe yi ril bu byin: hrī: srid zhi'i dwangs ma 'dus pa'i bcud: rdo rje bdud rtsi'i ril bu 'di: skal ldan khyod la sbyin pa yis: dga' bzhi'i ye shes 'phel bar shog: sgrub sngags dang : ā yurdzñā na ma hā su kha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: shel dang me long dkyil 'khor bstan: hrīḥ 'chi med rta mchog he ru ka'i: ye shes dbang bskur khyod la sbyin: sgo gsum ngo bo nyid sku'i klong : rig stong zung 'jug mngon gyur shog:

bsnyen sngags dang : dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ rjes 'brel phur pa lag g.yas sbyin: hūm̐: dbang chen drag po kī la ya: rigs 'dus phur bu 'di gtad pas: byin rlabs phrin las yongs rdzogs nas: khams gsum 'gro kun sgrol bar shog: las sbyor gyi sngags dang : badzra kī li kī la ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ āḥ spro na gzugs brnyan sbyor ba las: tshe bdud bar chad yongs bkug nas: rdo rje phur bus bsgral ba'i mthar: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du sbyor: rjes la tshe 'gug rgya yis gdab: dbang chen rigs lnga'i phyag rgyas srung : dam tshig bsdus te 'dzin pa sogs: gsang ba spy-i dang mthun par spyad: sa ma ya: de ltar 'chi med rta mchog dpal: rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor lha'i: dbang bskur byin rlabs snang ba 'dis: bsnyen rdzogs rtags ldan rnal 'byor pas: rdo rje'i slob ma rjes bzung na: gnas skabs tshe yi bar chad zhi: phrin las rnam bzhi gang brtsams 'grub: mthar thug rtsa rlung thig le'i khams: sgrib bral dwangs ma'i lha skur smin: de phyir snying khrag yang zhun 'di: rig pa dbyings kyi sgrom bur rgya: dus babs gzhan don mthar phyin shog: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i dril sgrub bzhugs: dhī/: dpal chen he ru ka la 'dud: ma 'ongs mtsho skyes bdag nyid kyis: byi rlabs sbas pa'i rig 'dzin phyir: gsang ba'i thugs dam mthar thug pa: khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i dril sgrub bstan: sa ma ya: dben zhing byin rlabs zil ldan pa: dur khrod la sogs gnas mchog tu: thod sku mtshan nyid ldan pa'i mdun: snang gsal mar mer rten 'cha' zhing : phyi nang gsang mchod ci 'byor dkram: bsam gtan snod du rung ba na: sngon 'gro'i dang po skyabs sems ni:

hūm̐: gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na: thams cad bdag nyid rtag bzhugs pa'i: bla ma he ru ka dpal la: skyabs gsol byang chub sems gnyis bskyed: gnyis pa bgegs bskrad mtshams bcad ni: hūm̐: gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bgeg tshogs kun: rang bzhin med pa'i dbyings su dengs: 'od gsal chos skur mtshams bcad do: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: badzra dzñā na rakṣa bhrūm̐: gsum pa byin chen dbab pa ni: hūm̐: brdal khyab 'od gsal chen po'i dbyings: ye shes sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs pa: khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kyis: dbang bskur byin phob dngos grub stsol: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: badzra dzñā na a be sha ya a āḥ bzhi pa dam rdzas byin rlabs ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: snod bcud dur khrod rol pa'i zhing : snang srid dpal gyi dam tshig rdzas: phyi nang gsang ba rmad byung ba'i: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por gyur: oṃ sarba pū dza ma hā mu dra sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: sa ma ya: dngos gzhi'i dang po bskyed rim ni: hūm̐: yang dag grub pa gcig pu nyid: sangs rgyas bde chen kun 'dus pa: mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog: chos sku de bzhin nyid dbyings las: longs sku ye shes sgyu ma'i tshul: sprul sku rgyu yi sa bon hūm̐: 'bar ba chen po'i cho 'phrul gyis: gzung 'dzin dngos kun stong par sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las 'byung rim steng : srung 'khor dur khrod bkod pa dang : rin chen gzhal med khang chen dbus: pad nyi lha chen pho mo'i steng : hūm̐ yig yongs gyur skad cig gis: bdag nyid spy-i dpal he ru ka: mthing nag nam mkha' dwangs pa'i mdog: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing ba'i: ye shes rngams pa'i zhal dang ldan: phyag drug ye shes rtags kyi rgya: rdo rje kha ṭwām̐ rnge'u chung g.yas: dril bu bhan dmar rgyu zhags g.yon: dpal dang dur khrod chas kyis brjid:

sbyor yum kro dhī shwa ri ma: mthing skya rdo rje dung khrag 'dzin: dpal chen yab la dgyes pa skyed: rus pa'i phyag rgya gzig sham 'chang : yab yum gar dgu'i nyams ldan pas: ye shes me phung dbus na rol: thugs kar rin chen zur brgyad pa'i: lte bar pad nyi dregs pa'i steng : ye shes snying po kī la ya: mthing nag phur 'dril yum dang 'khyud: khro bo'i chas rdzogs me phung dbus: bde chen gzi byin mchog tu 'bar: zur brgyad ye shes 'od lnga'i klong : shar du gau rī nam mkha'i mdangs: lho ru tsau rī gser gdog 'tsher: nub tu pra mo rā ga'i 'od: byang du be tā ma rgad mdog: shar lhor pukka sku mdog ser: lho nub ghasma dmar ljang brjid: nub byang sme sha mthing nag rngams: byang shar tsaṇḍa ser skya bzhad: kun kyang ḍā ru thod chang bsnams: gru mo g.yas na kha ṭwām̐ 'khril: gar thabs zhi rkyang gdan la bzhengs: gzhan yang phung khams skye mched kun: khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i phyag rgyar gsal: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭa: gnas gsum rdo rje'i 'bru gsum gyis: sku gsung thugs su byin rlabs shing : bde ba chen po'i rlabs g.yos pas: ye shes lnga yi dbang rdzogs gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: pañtsa dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa ho: de ltar dkyil 'khor gsal btab nas: rtse gcig sems bzung ting 'dzin brtan: gsal snang rgyud la shar ba na: gnyis pa ye shes drang bstim ni: hūm̐: dga' ba'i lcags kyus rgyud bskul zhing : mchog dga'i zhags pas rten dang bsre: khyad par sgrog gis mi phyed bcings: lhan skyes dril bus dbyer med brten: rang snang dam tshig dkyil 'khor du: 'jug pa'i ye shes mnyam sbyor ba'i: dbang dang byin rlabs rmad po che'i: dngos grub rnam gnyis stsal du gsol: oṃ shrī he ru ka sarba maṇḍal hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho: sa ma ya stāṃ gsum pa brda yi phyag gis 'dud: hūm̐: sangs rgyas sems can mnyam sbyor ba'i:

khrag 'thung chen po rang rig ngang : gnyis med lta bas mjal ba'i phyir: blang dor med par bzhes su gsol: a ti pū ho: na ma dhī: bzhi pa mchod pa'i dam tshig ni: hūm̐: khrag 'thung rdo rje'i dbang po'i yul: bde chen ye shes mchod pa'i sprin: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig can: dgyes mnyam mchog gi rgyan du rol: oṃ shrī he ru ka maṇḍal sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pādyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai bidya shapda ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta sta na ga ṇa ma hā su kha pū dza ho: lnga pa dgyes bzhad glu yis bstod: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba che: rdo rje khrag 'thung chen por bzhengs: ye shes sgyu 'phrul mtha' yas pa'i: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kun la bstod: drug pa bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi: bzlas pas bskul zhing sgrub pa ni: rdo rje gzhon nu'i thugs ka ru: bde stong nyi zla kha sbyor sbubs: zung 'jug ting 'dzin hūm̐ mthing ga: sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer sprin: yab yum zhal dang gsang ba nas: 'gal me lta bur 'khor ba yis: bde ba chen pos rgyud gang ste: mchog thun dngos grub thob par gyur: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: de ni bsnyen pa'i dgongs pa'o: dpal chen badzra ku mā ra'i: thugs dam dzab kyis bskul ba ni: sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes dbyig: lha sngags phyag mtshan rnam par 'phros: rtsa gsum rgyal ba mchod pas brnyes: khams gsum nyon mongs dug chen sbyangs: sa gsum bdud bzhi tshar bcad nas: dngos grub mchog gi gter du gyur: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ pha¿ṭa: de ni sgrub pa'i dgongs pa'o: ma mo brgyad kyi thugs ka ru: nyi steng sa bon sngags kyis mtshan: dpal chen thugs srog 'od zer gyis: dam tshig rjes su bskul ba las: rang rang bde ba'i ye shes sku: sngags phreng phyag mtshan bcas pa 'phros: 'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i khams kun khyab:

mi mthun zhi zhing legs tshogs rgyas: snang sems dbang bsdus dgra bgegs btul: dbye bskrad rengs shing rmongs pa sogs: las kyi dngos grub bsgrub par gyur: oṃ āḥbadzra gam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā: oṃ āḥbadzra tsam̐ hūm̐ pha¿ṭa: bhrūm̐ puṣtiṃ ku ru oṃ: oṃ āḥbadzra bam̐ hūm̐ pha¿ṭa: hrīḥwa shaṃ ku ru ho: oṃ āḥbadzra bam̐ hūm̐ pha¿ṭa: hūm̐ mā ra ya pha¿ṭa: oṃ āḥbadzra bam̐ hūm̐ pha¿ṭa: pra be sha ya pha¿ṭa: oṃ āḥbadzra ghaṃ hūm̐ pha¿ṭa: utstsha ṭa ya pha¿ṭa: oṃ āḥbadzra shaṃ hūm̐ pha¿ṭa: stambha ya phaṭa: oṃ āḥbadzra tsam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: mo ha ya phaṭa: de ni las kyi dgongs pa'o: bsnyen pa 'bum phrag brgyad yin te: sgrub pa'i gsang sngags de yi phyed: las sbyor khri phrag re res 'grub: bskyed rim gsal bas lha zhal 'khul: bzlas brjod dag pas ya mtshan sgra: dgongs pa brtan pas ting 'dzin 'bar: drod thob dngos grub mchog brnyes 'gyur: sa ma ya: thun mtshams tshogs kyi mchod pa ni: mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bandha ru: ma da na dang ba la sogs: dam tshig rdzas bsham bsang chus bran: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: 'phrul bzhad yid bzhin rin chen ka pā la: stong gsum dang mnyam yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: rigs lnga yab yum mnyam sbyor bdud rtsi'i bcud: bde ba chen po'i 'dod yon gter du gyur: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ ga na tsakra pū dza āḥhūm̐: gsang ba'i rngai'u chung sgras bskul te: tshogs zhing spyan drangs mchod pa 'bul: nyams chags bshags shing bsgral bstab bya: hūm̐: dbyings nas sku bskyod rig 'dzin bla ma dang : khrag 'thung 'dus pa rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha: tshogs kyi longs spyod chen por spyan 'dren na: dam tshig thugs rje'i dbang gis gshegs su gsol: badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ hūm̐: yul dang dbang po dbyer med bde ba che: rdo rje'i dam rdzas tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chag kun: lha dang rtog pa dbyer med dbyings su bskang :

gzung 'dzin las byung gnyis snang dgra bgegs bsgral: sha khrag bde stong 'od gsal klong du bzhes: thun mong las dang ye shes rmad po che'i: dngos grub rnam gnyis dus 'dir stsal du gsol: oṃ shrī he ru ka maṇḍal la sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: sa ma ya shuddhe āḥ sarba shā trūm̐ bighnān mā ra ya kha kha khā hi khā hi: de nas dam tshig rdzas kyi mchog: nang gi mchod par mnyam rol zhing : gsang ba snyoms 'jug bde chen skyed: slar yang ma sring mkha' 'gro mchod: pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ ho: pheṃ pheṃ: dpal chen khrag 'thung spyan sngar dam bcas pa'i: lhag la dbang ba'i ma sring mkha' 'gro ging : khrag 'thung zhal chab tshogs kyi 'dod yon zhes: 'khor srung rkyen zlog rnam bzhi'i phrin las sgrubs: ma ma ḍā ka ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha ba liṃ ta khā hi: gsang chen rdo rje'i rigs gcig tu: smon lam gdab la mthar dbyung ngo : sa ma ya: rjes su mchod bstod dngos grub gsol: oṃ: dpal chen lha tshogs dang por rtse gcig bsnyen: bar du bsgrubs pas ye shes gzi byin bskyed: deng 'dir gsol zhing bskul ba'i dus lags na: las dang ye shes dngos grub stsal du gsol: sngags mthar: kā ya wā ka tsitta sidhi pha la hūm̐: zhes pas bskul zhing gsol btab nas: 'bar ba'i mar me lhar gsal ba: gnas gsum reg pas lha tshogs kyi: gsang gsum byin rlabs sku dang sngags: ye shes 'od kyi rnam par bstim: rdo rje'i dngos grub thob par bsam: nongs pa bshags shing ye shes pa: thod pa'i sku dang dbyer med bstim: dam tshig 'khor lo dbyings su bsdu: thig le nyag gcig ngang du bzhag: thun mtshams sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar ldang : dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab: shis brjod me tog phyogs bcur 'thor: sa ma ya: dpal chen khrag 'thung dgongs pa'i gding : rdo rje ru lu 'bru brgyad kyi: gzhi rgyud tshogs brgyad rnam dag pa: ye shes chen po'i ngo bor gnas:

lam dus bde chen mi mo brgyad: kun 'dus dpal chen phyag rgyar rdzogs: 'byung ba'i sgra kun sngags su sbyar: dran rtog rgyu dang 'bras bu yi: yul can dga' ba brgyad kyi sems: ye shes brgyad kyi srog ldan pas: nang gi sa la myur bgrod de: mthar thug 'bras bu'i he ru ka: rnam thar brgyad dang ldan pa'i bdag: tshe 'dir 'grub byed myur ba'i lam: mngon tu spyod pa'i skal ldan gyi: phyi nang bar chad ldog pa'i mtshon: rdo rje gzhon nu'i go char bcas: sngon chad gzhan du ma bstan pa: zab cing snying por dril ba 'di: skal ldan mchog gi dpal du shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: guhya: brda thim: sprul pa'i gter chen rig 'dzin grub thob rgya mtsho'i 'khor los sgyur ba 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje'i zhal snga nas gtan la phab rim bzhin: bka' slob blau gros mtha' yas kyi gus pa chen pos bris pa dge legs 'phel: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i dbang chog bzhugs: dhī/: dpal che he ru ka la 'dud: khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du: slob ma smin byed cho ga ni: dben pa'i gnas su stegs bu'i khar: mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus nyid du: rang byung snod mchog ka pā lar: mar me dgu nyid rten du bsham: rig 'dzin bla ma'i gtor ma dang : gdab pa'i phur pa dag kyang dgod: mchod tshogs bzang pos mtha' bskor la: bdag dang mdun rten dbyer med par: he ru ka yi phyag rgyar bsgom: bzlas pas bskul zhing tshogs mtshon bya: lha dang rang rig dbyer med pa'i: don gyi 'jug pas nus pa bskyed: snod ldan nges par khrus nas dbyung : bgegs la bka' bsgo srung mtshams bcad: maṇḍal 'bul zhing gsol gdab ni: ho: gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na: thams cad bdag nyid rtag bzhugs pa'i: he ru ka dpal slob dpon gyis: bdag cag yongs su smin mdzad gsol: lan gsum gsol btab rgyud sbyang zhing :

rnam pa gsum gyi dam bca' sbyin: slob ma yang dag he ru ka: lus dkyil dang bcas gsal gdab slad: gtor ma rig 'dzin bla mar gsal: spy-i bor bzhag cing byin chen dbab: hūm̐: yang dag grub pa'i rig 'dzin rnams: chos kyi dbyings nas gnas 'dir gshegs: bde ba chen po'i byin chen phob: tha mal snang zhen sbyang du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐ hūm̐: sa ma ya ā be sha ya st+waṃ: rig 'dzin bla ma'i lha tshogs kyi: sku gsung thugs las 'od zer 'phros: slob ma'i sgo gsum sgrib pa sbyangs: dpal chen khrag 'thung chen po'i sku: lus dkyil lha dang bcas par bsam: sgrub rten mar me spy-i bor 'god: oṃ: yang dag grub pa gcig pu ni: sangs rgyas bde chen kun 'dus pa: mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog gi: rdo rje'i sku yi dbang bskur ro: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: kā ya sa ma ya a be sha ya st+waṃ: lhag pa'i lha las gnyis pa thim: byang chub sems su zhu ba yis: ye shes chen por byin gyis brlabs: bde ba'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas: snang stong zung 'jug stogs pa bskyed: mar me mgrin pa'i gnas su bzhag: āḥ yang dag grub pa gcig pu ni: sangs rgyas bde chen kun 'dus pa: mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog gi: nus pa gsung gi dbang bskur ro: sngags mthar: wā ka sa ma ya ā be sha ya st+waṃ: dpal chen yab yum snyoms zhugs pa'i: byang sems mgrin pa'i lam nas brgyud: rtsa khams thams cad khyab pa las: gsal stong ye shes skyes par bsam: rjes 'brel bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi: dgongs pa dang bcas bzlas lung sbyin: mar me snying gar bzhag byas la: hūm̐: yang dag grub pa gcig pu nyid: sangs rgyas bde chen kun 'dus pa: mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog gi: 'od gsal thugs kyi dbang bskur ro: sngags mthar: tsitta sa ma ya ā be sha ya st+waṃ: dpal chen khrag 'thung sbyor yum las: gnyis pa spros te slob ma'i yum:

kro dhī shwa rir dbyer med pas: snyoms 'jug gsang ba'i sgyu rtsal gyis: dga' bzhi'i bde chen skyed par bsam: slar yang mar me snying gar bzung : hoḥ yang dag grub pa gcig pu nyid: sangs rgyas bde chen kun 'dus pa: mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog gi: 'od gsal ye shes dbang bskur ro: sngags mthar: dzñā na sa ma ya ā be sha ya st+waṃ: gnyug ma'i gnas lugs yang dag pa: rig stong gnyis su med pa ni: snang gsal mar me'i brdas mtshon te: don gyi ye shes skyes par bsam: mthar ni lha bstim gnyis med bzhag: dpal chen sku yi gsal snang dang : kha sbyor rlung bzung 'bar 'dzag gi: bde bas thabs byas stong nyid ngang : dbang bzhi'i rtogs pa brtan par

mos: las kyi phur pa lag tu gtad: hūm̐: srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha: ye shes khro bo'i gzi byin gyis: las kyi ma mo rgyud bskul nas: bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs tshar gcod shog: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: ma ma sarba sa ma yahūm̐ hūm̐: sarba bighnān sha trūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭa: phur pa phyogs bcur bsgril byas la: rdo rje gzhon nu'i thugs ka nas: 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa dang : go rī la sogs brgyad rnams las: rang rang mdog mtshungs me 'od 'phros: khams gsum thams cad yongs su gang : phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub: gsang ba'i dgra gsum dbyings su bsad: 'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi rang ngor bcom: bar gcod 'phrang gsum klong du gsal: dpal chen badzra he ru ka'i: brtul zhugs spyod pa mthar phyin bsam: shis pa brjod pa la sogs pa: rjes kyi rim pa spy-i ltar bya: sa ma ya: khrag 'thung galpo'i tant+ra yi: rdo rje'i gleng gzhi nges pa'i don: smin byed rgyud kyi snying po de: snying gi bu la gtad rgyas gdab: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: guhya: brda thim: gter ston grub thob yongs kyi rgyal po 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje'i zhal snga nas gtan la phab rim bzhin tu: gus slob blo gros mtha' yas kyis bris pa dge legs 'phel/ dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: bdud rtsi bde chen snying po bzhugs: dhī/: bdud rtsi gsang ba'i lha la 'dud: ma 'ongs padma'i brgyud 'dzin cing : brtul zhugs mchog gi skal ldan pa'i: rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs rnams kyis: zab mo'i lam 'di gces par zung : sa ma ya: snang zhing srid pa'i chos so cog: gdod nas rnam dag bdud rtsi lnga: ma bcos thig le'i snying por rdzogs: 'phel 'grib bral ba'i ye shes che: lam du byed pa'i rnal 'byor pas: rang byung dur khrod chen po sogs: byin rlabs bkra shis dben gnas su: sgron ma lnga yis chag chag gdab:

gsang ba'i sa la stegs bu bya: dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid ldan pa'am: rus chen me tog tshom bu'i dbus: gsang ba'i bum pa kha sbyar nas: sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam lnga nang : rtsa brgyad stong sbyar sman gyis bkang : mtha' bskor mchod gtor brjid ldan bsham: bgegs tshogs bskrad cing byin chen dbab: de ni sta gon rim pa'o: sa ma ya: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: phur pa 'dus pa'i dril sgrub bzhugs: dhī/: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nur 'dud: ma 'ongs padma bdag nyid kyis: byin gyis brlabs pa'i rig pa 'dzin: 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje'i don: phur pa 'dus pa'i dril sgrub bstan: sa ma ya: dben pa'i gnas su stegs bu'i khar: bsnyen pa'i dam tshig rten nyid du: mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa 'god: mtha' skor phyi nang mchod pas bskor: de nas nyams su blang ba la: sngon 'gro'i dang po skyabs sems ni: hūm̐: bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu la: mi phyed gus pas skyabs su mchi: srid pa phur bu'i dkyil 'khor du: khams gsum bsgral bar sems bskyed do: gnyis pa bgegs tshogs mtshams bcad ni: hūm̐: ngang nyid rdo rje'i chos dbyings las: phyi nang snod bcud khyab pa yi: 'bar ba'i khro bo mi zad pas: log 'dren 'byung po mtshams bcad gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gsum pa ye shes byin 'bebs ni: hūm̐: 'od gsal chos sku'i pho brang nas: longs spyod yongs rdzogs dpal chen pos: gang 'dul sprul pa'i rnam rol gyis: gnas 'dir byin phob dbang mchog bskur: oṃ badzra kī li kī li ya hūm̐: sarba sa ma ya a be sha ya ā ā: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bzhi pa mchod gtor byin rlabs ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas: 'phros pa'i 'od kyi mchod rdzas kun: gzung 'dzin mtshan ma las 'das pa'i: ye shes bdud rtsi'i rol par spel: oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas shapda 'i bar dang rū pa shapda gandhe rā sa sparshe ma hā a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta sarba pū dza ā hūm̐:

sa ma ya: dngos gzhir dam tshig bskyed pa yis: srid pa phur bur bsgrub pa ni: hūm̐: sems kyi rdo rje de bzhin nyid: kun snang snying rje'i mtshon char 'bar: rgyu yi ting 'dzin hūm̐ mthing ka: de las 'od 'phros snod bcud sbyangs: klong lnga yum gyi bha ga ru: dur khrod drag po'i gzhal yas khang : phyi nang mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs dbus: dregs pa nyi zla padma'i steng : dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa: rang rig badzra ku mā ra: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: bzhad gshe rngams pa'i nyams dang ldan: phyag drug g.yas kyi dang po gnyis: rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga dang : g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭwām̐ 'dzin: tha ma ri rab phur bu bsgril: khams gsum sku yi dbyings su rdzogs: dpal dang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: zhabs bzhi gyad kyi 'dor stabs bgrad: sbyor yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sngo: dril bu thod khrag bsnams pas 'khril: ye shes me dpung klong dkyil na: gar dgu'i rol pas rnam par bgyings: snying gar ratna zur brgyad klong : rdor sems yab yum thugs dbus su: rin chen gzhal yas sgo gcig par: rta mchog rol pa'i phyag rgyas bsrungs: lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng : rdo rje rtse lnga hūm̐ gis mtshan: 'od kyis yab yum snyoms par zhugs: byang sems hūm̐ yig sprin 'phro bas: 'khor lo rnam lngar sras mchog dang : tshigs mtshams khro bo stangs dpyal bcu: khra thabs nyi shu'i 'khor bcas shar: sgo bzhir tshad med sgo ma bzhi: bar mtshams ma mo bcu gnyis sogs: bka' nyan dam can sprin ltar gtibs: kun kyang snang stong zung 'jug ngang : rdo rje gsum gyis rgyas gdab cing : sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i skur: dbang bskur dga' bzhi'i rol mo yis: ye shes khro bo spyan drangs gyur: gnyis pa ye shes spyan 'dren shing : phyag rgya rnam bzhis brtan par bya: hūm̐: srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang : dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir:

ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol: khro rgyal 'khor bcas gshegs nas kyang : rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang : ki la ya yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya e hye hi sarba sa ma ya dza dza: dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gsum pa brda phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: srid pa rdo rje phur bu'i lha: rang rig byang chub sems su rdzogs: 'khor 'das ro mnyam chos sku'i ngang : rang zhal mjal ba'i phyag gis 'dud: badzra dzñā na sa ma ya ho: bzhi pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: snod bcud 'dod yon rol pa'i sprin: sman gtor rakta gsang ba'i rdzas: sbyor sgrol zung 'jug chos dbyings che: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por bzhes: oṃ shrī badzra ku mā ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas sparshe 'i bar dang ma hā a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta sta na gha na sarba pū dza ho: lnga pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: rdo rje khros pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: bar chad bdud dpung 'dul mdzad pa: he ru ka dpal khrag 'thung lha: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas la bstod: drug pa bsnyen cing sgrub pa ni: bdag nyid thugs srog hūm̐ yig mthar: sngags phreng g.yas 'khor 'od zer gyis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gsal bar byas: mchod bzhes dam bskangs dngos grub thob: slar yang 'phro 'dus don gnyis sgrub: snod bcud rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhing : sgrar grags sngags kyi rang sgrar 'ur: dran rtog dbyings rig dbyer med pa: thugs rje chen po'i phur pa yis: 'khor 'das kun la rgyas gdab pas: bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyis: rnam bzhi'i phrin las dbang 'byor bsam: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: thog mtha' oṃ dang pha¿ṭa bzhag nas: bar na bcu gnyis grong mdzes pa: phrin las 'dus pa'i snying po ste: bsnyen sgrub las gsum chig chod yin: skabs su rno srung spu gri'i sngags: dmigs pa'i gnad dang sbyar la bzla: gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs la dmigs nas: drag po'i hūm̐ gi snang glu len:

gzung 'dzin zhen pa kun sbyangs par: sus snang sprul pa'i sku ru 'gyur: thun mthar mchod bstod dngos grub blang : nongs pa bshags cing ye shes bsdu: 'od gsal rang las sgyu ma'i skus: snod bcud dkyil 'khor gsum du sbyangs: khyad par nang ltar rlung sbyor dang : 'bar 'dzag byang sems phur bu nyid: rdo rje btsun mo'i mkhar thebs pas: srog stsol longs spyod rdzogs skur smin: gsang ba bskyed pa'i lha dang sngags: rig la byang sems phur par bsdu: chos dbyings su btab pa yis: rtogs tshogs don dam chos skur shar: sa ma ya: de ltar brtson pas gnas skabs su: gang brtsams phrin las thogs pa med: mthar thug rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhir: brten nas zung 'jug go 'phang 'grub: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: phur pa 'dus pa'i dbang chog bzhugs: dhī/: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nur 'dud: phur pa 'dus pa'i dbang bskur ni: dben pa'i gnas su dkyil 'khor dbus: sgrub pa'i phur pa mtshan ldan dang : rig 'dzin bla ma'i gtor ma bsham: mdun tu las kyi phur bu bkod: phyi nang mchod pas mtha' bskor nas: bdag mdun dbyer med bskyed bzlas bya: rig pa'i me tog dor bas 'jug: de nas slob ma khrus nas dbyung : bgegs bskrad mtshams bcad maṇḍal phul: me tog dang bcas gsol gdab ni: hūm̐: thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du: byams dang snying rjai gang 'dul ba: sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa: dbang dang byin rlabs bdag la stsol: lan gsum gsol zhing rgyud sbyangs la: gtor ma spy-i bo'i gtsug tu bzhag: rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs dam bskul: hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams: srid pa rdo rjer grub mdzod cig: srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha: ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod: oṃ āḥbadzra ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐ phaṭa: sa ma ya ā be sha ya stāṃ: brgyud gsum bla ma char ltar babs:

slob ma'i lus la thim pa yis: phyi nang gzhan gsum dbyer med pa'i: rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gyur bsam: sgrub pa'i phur pa spy-i bor bzhag: oṃ: sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku: ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las: 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa: sku yi dbyig tu dbang bskur ro: sngags mthar: kā la sa ma ya ā be sha ya st+waṃ: lhag pa'i lha nyid spy-i bor thim: snang stong zung 'jug chen po'i ngang : rigs kyi bdag pos dbur brgyan cing : bum dbang ye shes skyes par bsam: sgrub pa'i phur pa mgrin par bzhag: ā: sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gsung : ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las: 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa: gsung gi dbyig tu dbang bskur ro: sngags mthar: wā ka sa ma ya ā be sha ya st+waṃ: phur pa'i lha tshogs snyoms zhugs pa'i: byang sems mgrin pa'i lam nas brgyud: lus gang dus gsum rtog pa 'gags: gsang ba'i ye shes skyes par bsam: rjes 'brel bzlas pa'i lung yang sbyin: sgrub pa'i phur pa snying gar bzhag: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes thugs: ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las: 'bar ba'i khro bo mi zad pa: thugs kyi dbyig tu dbang bskur ro: sngags mthar: tsitta sa ma ya ā be sha ya st+waṃ: phur pa'i lha yi sbyor yum las: gnyis pa spros te yum la bstim: 'du shes gsum gyis snyoms zhugs pas: gsum pa'i ye shes skyes par bsam: slar yang sgrub phur snying gar gzung : hrīḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes dbyings: ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las: 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa: ye shes dbyig tu dbang bskur ro: sngags mthar: dzñā na sa ma ya ā ba she ya st+waṃ: phur ni thabs kyi rgyal po ste: pa ni shes rab dbyings kyi ngang : zung 'jug chen por mnyam bzhag pas: bzhi pa'i ye shes skyes par bsam: dbang don dgongs pa brtan pa'i phyir: slar yang sgrub phur spy-i bor bkod: hūm̐: srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang :

dbang dang dngos grub stsol ba'i phyir: ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol: ye shes khro bo gshegs nas kyang : rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang : kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol: sngags mthar: kā ya wā ka tsitta gu ṇa karma sa ma ya ā be sha ya st+waṃ: lha tshogs bstim nas gnyis med bsam: khrag 'thung chen po'i nga rgyal bskyed: mtha' brten gda' phur lag tu gtad: hūm̐: bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: sngon chad tshul bzhin dam bcas pa'i: mngon spyod phrin las 'grub par mdzod: drag sngags brjod cing lta gding bskyed: phur pa phyogs bcur bsgril ba yis: khams gsum bdud tshogs tshar bcad cing : srung zlog bsad mnan gzir bskrad sogs: rab 'byams las kun 'grub par bsam: thugs kyi phur gcig la brten nas: teng nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba: rgyud kyi khong snying phyungs pa ste: snod ldan bu la gtad do rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: guhya: brda thim: gter ston grub thob yongs kyi rgyal po 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje'i zhal snga nas gtan la phab rim bzhin tu/ gus slob blo gros mtha' yas kyis bris pa dge legs 'phel/ dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: phur pa 'dus pa'i dril sgrub bzhugs: dhī/: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nur 'dud: ma 'ongs padma bdag nyid kyis: byin gyis brlabs pa'i rig pa 'dzin: 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje'i don: phur pa 'dus pa'i dril sgrub bstan: sa ma ya: dben pa'i gnas su stegs bu'i khar: bsnyen pa'i dam tshig rten nyid du: lcags sam drag po'i shing dag las: mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa ni: dar nag cod pan dang bcas dgod: mtha' skor phyi nang mchod pa bsham: de nas nyams su blang ba la: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las: sngon 'gro'i dang po skyabs sems ni: na mo: bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu la: mi phyed gus pas skyabs su mchi: srid pa phur bu'i dkyil 'khor du:

khams gsum bsgral bar sems bskyed do: gnyis pa bgegs bskrad srung mtshams ni: hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang logs 'dren rnams: nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed: rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' lung las: sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed pa: stobs chen khro bo chen po bcus: klad pa tshal pa brgya ru khos: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: song zhig lha min lha yang rung : nga la bar chad byed pa rnams: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par mdzod: drag sngags brjodacing thun gyis gzir: hūm̐: ngang nyid rdo rje'i chos dbyings las: phyi nang snod bcud khyab pa yi: 'bar ba'i khro bo mi zad pas: log 'dren 'byung po mtshams bcad gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra dzñā na rakṣa bhūm̐:

gsum pa ye shes byin 'bebs ni: hūm̐: 'od gsal chos sku'i ngang nyid las: longs spyod yongs rdzogs dpal chen pos: gang 'dul sprul pa'i rnam rol gyis: gnas 'dir byin phob dbang mchog skur: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐: sarba sa ma ya dzñā na a be sha ya a āḥ bzhi pa mchod gtor byin rlabs ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas: 'phros pa'i 'od kyis mchod rdzas kun: gzung 'dzin mtshan ma las 'das pa'i: ye shes 'dod rgu'i sprin du spel: oṃ badzra arghaṃ pādyaṃ puṣpe dhu pe ā lo ke gandhe nai widya shabda sarba pū dza ma hā a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta ā hūm̐: sa ma ya: dngos gzhir tha mal snang zhen gyi: srid pa phur bur bsgrub pa'i phyir: dang po dam tshig bskyed pa ni: ting 'dzin gsum gyis khog phub la: rten gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus: bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dpal chen pos: rgyu 'bras las bzhengs sgong skyes sbyong : mtshan ma rdzas dang dbyer med pa'i: sras mchog rigs lnga ye shes mthus: skad cig rdzus skyes tshul du shar: snyoms 'jug mngal 'byin sbyor ba yis: phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bskyed: sgo skyong bka' nyan sngags kyi sgras: drod gsher skyes kyi bag chags sbyong : hūm̐: sems kyi rdo rje de bzhin nyid: snying rje khros par kun tu snang : mtshon chen rdo rje hūm̐ yig bcas: 'bar ba'i 'od kyi snod bcud sbyangs: klong lnga 'byung ba yum gyi mkhar: dur khrod drag po'i gzhal yas khang : 'bar ba'i mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs dbus: padma zla nyi bdud bzhi'i steng : rdo rje hūm̐ yig yongs gyur las: bdag nyid dpal ldan rdo rje sems: dkar gsal rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: rang 'dra'i yum 'khyud mtshan dper 'bar: longs spyod yongs rdzogs rigs brgya'i bdag: zab gsal gnyis med sku ru bzhengs: oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐: yab yum snyoms zhugs bde ba che'i: rang gzugs 'od kyi thig ler 'khyil:

de las 'bras bu'i he ru ka: dpal chen badzra ku mā ra: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: gzhad gshe rngams pa'i nyams dang ldan: mthing nag sku la dpal chas dang : dur khrod drag po'i chas kyis brjid: phyag drug g.yas kyi dang po gnyis: gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu lnga: g.yon gnyis me phung kha ṭwām̐ 'khrol: tha mas ri rab phur bu 'dril: khams gsum rdo rje gsum du rdzogs: zhabs bzhi gyad kyi dor stabs kyis: pad zla nyi ma bdud bzhi'i steng : ye shes 'bar 'khrugs me klong 'gying : sbyor yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sngo: gzig sham rin chen rus rgyan can: dril bu dung khrag bsnams pas 'khril: gar dgu'i nyams ldan dpal chen po: yab yum mnyam sbyor bde ba ches: ye shes lnga yi rig rtsal 'bar: de las 'khor lo'i gnas lnga ru: sras mchog kī la rigs kyi mdog: phyag gnyis phur 'dril yum dang 'khyud: sku smad gnam lcags phur bu'i dbal: pad nyi dregs pa'i gdan la rol: slar yang snyoms zhugs mkha' gsang nas: byang sems hūm̐ gi sprin spros pas: phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs bcu'i dbus: phyogs bcu'i khro bo chen po bcu: sku mdog dus kyi mun ltar gnag: zhal gcig phyag gnyis yum dang 'khril: phur bu 'dril zhing bgegs tshogs gzir: pad nyi phyogs skyong dregs pa'i steng : drag me dmar nag dbus na bzhengs: g.yas g.yon za gsod phra men ma: khra thabs nyi shu'i sprul pa 'gyed: sras mchog rigs lnga khro rgyal tshogs: rdo rje'i gshog brgyangs dur khrod chas: rab 'jigs khro gtum 'jigs pa'i nyams: ye shes me phung klong na gsal: gtso mchog yab yum rol pa'i sgra: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥm bhyo las: sgo bzhir gdong can sgo ma bzhi: bar khyams ma mo bcu gnyis dang : phyi 'khor dbang phyug nyer brgyad sogs: bka' nyan dam can sprin ltar gtibs: kun kyang snang stong zung 'jug sku: chu zla 'ja' tshon bzhin du gsal:

srid gsum tha mal snang zhen kun: rdo rje khros pa'i 'khor lor rdzogs: oṃ shrī badzra kī lā ya sarba maṇḍal āḥhūm̐: rjes 'brel byin rlabs dbang bskur ni: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum du: zla ba padma nyi ma'i steng : 'bru gsum phyag mtshan yongs gyur las: rdo rje gsum gyi phyag rgyas mtshan: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs su byin brlab bo: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsitta admā ko3haṃ: gtso bo'i thugs mchog rin po che: zur brgyad mchong gur lta bu yi: gzhal med khang pa gnam sgo can: rta mchog dpal gyis sgo srung mdzad: dbus su zhi ba rdo rje sems: 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs he ru ka: rdo rje dung khrag yum dang sbyor: ind+ra nī la'i mdangs 'od 'tsher: rol pa'i 'od kyis dbang gi lha: spyan drangs byang chub sems kyi chus: dbang bskur rigs lngas dbur brgyan gyur: hūm̐ āoṃ trām̐ hrī āḥ he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa sa ma ya st+waṃ: slar yang hūm̐ gi sgra bsgrags pas: khams gsum nyon mongs dug chen sbyangs: kun bzang rdor sems skur gyur nas: ye shes khrag 'thung phyag rgyar thim: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa dzaḥshrī he ru ka a haṃ: gnyis pa ye shes spyan drangs shing ཿ phyag rgyas bstim nas bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang : dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir: ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol: khro rgyal 'khor bcas gshegs nas kyang : rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang : kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba sa ma ya e hye hi hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya st+waṃ: hūm̐: snying rje'i lcags kyus gnas nas dgug: byams pa'i zhags pas rten la gzhug: dga' ba'i sgrog gis dbyer med bcing : btang snyoms dril bus rab dgyes pa'i: srid pa rdo rje phur bu'i lha: dam tshig ye shes dbyer med pa: 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs nas kyang :

mchod bzhes dam bskang dngos grub stsol: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: gsum pa phyag 'tshal mchod bstod ni: hūm̐: yang dag don du rab zhi yang : 'dul ba'i dbang gis cir yang snang : 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: gus pa'i brda yis phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra tītstsha ho: hūm̐: snod bcud nyer spyod 'dod yon sprin: sman gtor rakta gsang ba'i rdzas: sbyor sgrol zung 'jug 'od gsal dbyings: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por bzhes: oṃ shrī badzra ku mā ra arghaṃ padyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe ni bidya shapda pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta sta na ga ṇa dharma dhā tu pū dza ho: hūm̐: skra can bhandha'i snod yangs su: gdug can bsgral ba'i dmar chen po: khams gsum khrag gi rgya mtshor bskyil: dam can pho nya'i tshogs rnams la: mngon spyod phrin las mdzad phyir 'bul: sngon chad ji ltar dam bcas bzhin: gdug pa'i bgegs dang bar chad kun: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par mdzod: ma hā rakta kha kha khā' hi khā hi: hūm̐: rdo rje khros pa'i ye shes kyis: bar chad bdud dpung 'dul mdzad pa: phrin las 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas la bstod: bzhi pa 'phro lus: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: tshe sgrub 'chi med drwa ba bzhugs: dhī/: tshe dbang rig 'dzin padmar 'dud: bdag gzhan 'chi med sgrub 'dod na: bkra shis yid 'ong dben gnas su: maṇḍal tshom bu lnga pa'i steng : dbus su bcud ldan tshe bum dang : g.yas g.yon thabs shes dngos grub rjes: mdun rgyab gtor ma tshe mda' bsham: de mthar phyi nang mchod pas bskor: sngon 'gro rtsa ba'i gzhung ltar la: dngos gzhi'i khyad par bskyed rim ni: hrī: skye med de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes las: 'gags med so sor rtogs pa'i rig mdangs rtsal: zung 'jug sprul pa'i rgyu mchog hrīḥdamar po: de las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod:

'gro kun sgrib sbyangs srid zhi'i tshe bcud bkug: tshur 'dus phyi snod padmo bkod pa'i zhing : ngo mtshar yon tan du mas brgyan pa'i dbus: rin chen sna tshogs las grub gzhal med khang : mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs ye shes 'od lnga'i klong : pad nyi zla steng rdo rje hrīḥyis mtshan: de nyid yongs gyur skad cig dran rdzogs su: rang rig rtsa gsum kun 'dus tshe yi lha: 'chi med bde chen skur bzhengs padma 'byung : dkar dmar mdangs ldan mtshan dpe'i 'od phung 'bar: zhi 'dzum bcu drug dga' ba'i lang tshos mdzes: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas thod bum bsnams: nye rgyu'i bde ster yum mchog mandā ra: dmar gsal chags nyams nu 'bur bha ga rgyas: g.yas pas mda' dar yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: g.yon pas zag med bdud rtsis dgyes pa bskyed: gnyis ka lha rdzas dar gyi na bza' dang : utpal rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: zhabs gnyis rdo rje padma'i skyil krung gis: snang stong 'ja' zer thig le'i klong na rol: de ltar gsal ba'i rdo rje lus kyi dkyil: rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan gzhal yas dbus: sprul pa'i rnam rol 'chi med thod phreng lnga: mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar ye shes lnga yi mdangs: g.yas rnams so so'i rigs kyi phyag mtshan dang : g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams: rang 'od yum 'khyud rin chen rus pas brgyan: rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i klong na rol: spy-i bor longs spyod yongs rdzogs tshe dpag med: dbang mdog zhal gcig phyag gnyis tshe bum 'dzin: sbyor ba'i yum chen lha mo tsaṇḍa lī: g.yas g.yon mda' dar bum 'dzin yab la 'khril: de yi spyi bor chos sku snang mtha' yas: dmar gsal dri med padma rā ga'i mdangs: thabs shes phyag gnyis mnyam par bzhag pa'i steng : zung 'jug 'chi med bdud rtsis lhung bzed bsnams: phyogs bzhir pad nyi bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i dbus: dbang chen rigs bzhi phyag g.yas gri gug dang :

g.yon pas bdud rtsis gang ba'i bhandha 'dzin: rang 'od yum 'khyud khro bo'i cha lugs rdzogs: sgo bzhir sprul pa'i lha mo mgyogs ma bzhi: g.yas g.yon mda' dar tshe yi bum pa bsnams: chags bral padma thabs shes nyi zla'i steng : dkar ser dmar ljang rdo rje'i gar gyis rol: gzhan yang rtsa gsum tshe lha rab 'byams kun: dpag yas til gong kha phye ji bzhin du: snang la ma grub 'ja' tshon lta bur shar: rang byung gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs kyis: sku bzhi dbyer med ngo bor dbang bskur shing : gnas gsum 'bru gsum phyag rgyas mtshan pa las: 'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas nas ye shes pa: ma lus spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur: hūm̐ hrī: sngon tshe o rgyan dha na ko ṣa'i gling : ngo mtshar padma'i snying po'i ze'u 'bru las: 'chi med so sor rtogs pa'i rig mdangs rtsal: rnam kun mchog ldan mtshan dpe'i phung por shar: bkra shis brag phug ma rā ti ka ru: shes rab phyag rgya mandā ra bar bcas: dga' ba bzhi sbyor ye shes sgrub pa'i tshe: yab yum gnyis med tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes: skye shi med pa'i 'ja' lus rdo rjer gyur: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyis dbugs dbyungs shing : 'gro la 'chi med stsol ba'i thugs dam can: bde gshegs yongs 'dus padma thod phreng rtsal: rab 'byams rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas: mos shing gdung bas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na: 'gags med mkha' la char sprin gtibs pa bzhin: tshe dbang dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs su gsol: gang shar snang grags rig pa'i rtog tshogs kun: lha sngags chos sku'i ngo bor byin phob la: lus ngag yid la dga' bzhi'i ye shes skyed: 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma dzñā na ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dza dza: bzhugs gsol la sogs gzhung bzhin la: bstod cing smon lam gdab pa ni: hūm̐ hrī:

chos dbyings so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes las: bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rnam rol ni: gang 'dul sprul pa'i rang gzugs padma 'byung : sku gsum tshe yi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: rig 'dzin bla ma 'chi med thod phreng rtsal: yi dam yongs 'dus dbang chen he ru ka: phrin las lhun grub ḍā ki sde bzhi sogs: rtsa gsum tshe yi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: phung khams sgrib bral kun khyab rdo rje'i sku: rlung sngags zung 'jug bde chen nā da'i gsung : rtog tshogs rang grol 'od gsal gnyug ma'i ngang : 'chi med sku gsum go 'phang 'grub gyur cig: bzlas pa gsung gi rnal 'byor ni: thugs kar rdo rje thod phreng gi: snying dbus ye shes sems dpa' ni: padma drwa ba tshe dpag med: dmar gsal padma tshe bum 'dzin: gsang ba ye shes yum dang sbyor: thugs dbus nyi zla kha sbyor dbus: hrīḥmathar sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor: de las 'od 'phros dkyil 'khor gyi: lha tshogs bde stong mchod pas mnyes: snyoms par zhugs pa'i mkha' gsang nas: sngags kyi rang sgra sgrogs par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī hrīḥbadzra gu ru padma siddhi puṇye dzñā na ā yur siddhi dzaḥ slar yang 'od zer snang ba yis: phyogs dus rgyal ba sras bcas mchod: 'gro kun dus min 'chi ba bsal: rang dang bsgrub bya'i tshogs rnams kyi: bla tshe chad nyams yar ba dang : 'byung ba bzhi yi dwangs ma'i bcud: 'khor 'das tshe bsod ye shes kun: 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkug: rigs kyi bdag po yab yum gyi: sku yi dbyibs brgyud sbyor mtshams nas: byang chub sems kyi ngo bor zhu: spy-i bo nas zhugs gnas lnga yi: 'chi med thod phreng rigs lngar thim: rtsa khams thams cad bde bas khyab: dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub thob: thun mong 'byung lnga'i tshe bcud dang : khyad par ye shes rnam lnga yis: 'chi med rdo rje'i srog 'grub bsam: skabs su 'jug gnas ldang ba'i rlung :

'bru gsum sngags dang sbyar la bzla: srog gi lcags kyus tshe bcud bkug: kha sbyor rlung bsdam bum can bzung : 'bar 'dzag snyoms 'jug 'od zer gyis: thun mong mchog gi dwangs ma bsdu: bde stong zung 'jug thig le'i ngang : lhan skyes phyag chen don la blta: skye med nam mkha'i bcud len bya: de ltar bdun phrag gsum la sogs: mtshan ma thob kyi bar du bzla: dus min 'chi ba nges bcom nas: tshe dbang rig 'dzin mchog thob 'gyur: sa ma ya: khyad par rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ni: dbyings rig zung 'jug 'od gsal ngang : thod phreng rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas: 'od zer hṝḥyi rnam par 'phros: brtan g.yo'i tha mal snang zhes sbyangs: phyi snod padmo bkod pa'i zhing : nang bcud sku gsum tshe yi lha: sgrar grags rdo rje'i sngags kyi dbyangs: rtog tshogs blo 'das brjod bral ngang : 'chi med gnyug ma'i srog 'grub gyur: hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ

dus gsum dus med gcig tu bzla: gnas skabs sgo gsum sgrib gnyis dag: mthar thug dwangs ma'i srog 'grub nas: 'chi med go 'phang mngon du 'gyur: sa ma ya: thun mtshams tshe 'gugs bskul ba ni: hrīḥ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: nang gsal gzhon nu bum pa'i sku: snang mtha' yab yum thugs dam bskul: ka dag gzhi yi tshe bcud khug: hriḥ 'gro 'dul rdo rje'i pho brang nas: bde stong dbyer med thig le'i sku: padma drwa ba'i thugs dam bskul: lhun grub lam gyi tshe bcud khug: hrīḥ padma 'od kyi pho brang nas: 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku: mtsho skyes yab yum thugs dam bskul: zung 'jug 'bras bu'i tshe bcud khug: hrīḥ bde chen 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor nas: snang stong dbyer med rdo rje'i sku: buddha thod phreng thugs dam bskul: chos dbyings ye shes tshe bcud khug: hrīḥ longs spyod 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor nas: grags stong dbyer med rdo rje'i gsung : padma thod phreng thugs dam bskul: sor rtog ye shes tshe bcud khug: hrīḥ chos kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor nas: rig stong dbyer med rdo rje'i thugs: badzra thod phreng thugs dam bskul: me long ye shes tshe bcud khug: hrī: sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor nas: yon tan lhun rdzogs ngo bo nyid: ratna thod phreng thugs dam bskul: mnyam nyid ye shes tshe bcud khug: hrī: bde skyong 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor nas: gang 'dul phrin las rnam bzhi'i gang : karma thod phreng thugs dam bskul: bya grub ye shes tshe bcud khug: hrī: rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: zhi ba'i phrin las sgrub mdzad pa: badzra dbang chen thugs dam bskul: dga' ba'i ye shes tshe bcud khug: hrī: rin chen rigs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: rgyas pa'i phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i: ratna dbang chen thugs dam bskul: mchog dga'i ye shes tshe bcud khug: hrī:

padma'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: dbang gi phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i: padma dbang chen thugs dam bskul: dga' bral ye shes tshe bcud khug: hrī: las kyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: drag po'i phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i: karma dbang chen thugs dam bskul: lhan skyes ye shes tshe bcud khug: hrī: byams pa tshad med dkyil 'khor nas: sha yi tshe bdag sangs rgyas spyan: dkar mo mgyogs ma'i thugs dam bskul: sa yi khams nas tshe bcud khug: hrī: snying rje tshad med dkyil 'khor nas: khrag gi tshe bdag ma ma kī: ser mo mgyogs ma'i thugs dam bskul: chu yi khams nas tshe bcud khug: hrīḥ dga' ba tshad med dkyil 'khor nas: drod kyi tshe bdag gos dkar mo: dmar mo mgyogs ma'i thugs dam bskul: me yi khams nas tshe bcud khug: hrī: btang snyoms tshad med dkyil 'khor nas: dbugs kyi tshe bdag dam tshig sgrol: ljang mo mgyogs ma'i thugs dam bskul: rlung gi khams nas tshe bcud khug: hrīḥ snang srid 'khor 'das tshe bsod bcud: rnal 'byor bdag gi sgo gsum dang : dbyer med sgrub pa'i rdzas la stims: 'chi med rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī hrīḥ badzra gu ru padma siddhi puṇye dzñā na ā yur siddhi dzaḥ āḥ srid zhi kun khyab rdo rje'i tshe: thig le nyag gcig klong du thim: snang grags rig gsum lha dang sngags: ye shes rol pas rgyas gdab bo: kā ya wā ka tsitta a yurdzñā na dharma dhā tu badzra rakṣa bhrūm̐: mchod cing bstod la dngos grub blang : hūm̐ hrī: snang srid 'chi med tshe lha'i zhing du gsal: bsnyen cing sgrub pas thugs dam gnad nas bskul: mos shing gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na: dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba'i dus la babs: phung khams rnam dag 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku: mi 'gyur tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol: rlung sngags zung 'jug bde chen nā da'i gsung : 'gags med tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol:

rtog tshogs rang grol 'chi med gnyug ma'i thugs: 'od gsal tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol: thams cad ro mnyam gzhon nu bum sku'i dbyings: ye shes tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya wā ka tsitta ā yurdzñā na sarba siddhi pha la ho: zhes bskul sgrub rdzas gnas gsum gtugs: 'chi med bdud rtsir bsams la myong : gzhan la tshe yi dngos grub sbyin: rjes chog rtsa ba'i gzhung ltar bya: sa ma ya: 'di ni bsnyen sgrub las gsum po: gcig dril bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug ste: 'chi med sgrub pa'i man ngag mchog: 'bum phrag kun gyi yang snying yin: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: dhī/: tshe sgrub 'chi med drwa ba las: dbang bzhi ye shes snying po bzhugs: dhī/: tshe dbang rig 'dzin padmar 'dud: 'chi med rdo rje'i grong khyer du: 'jug sgo smin byed dbang bzhi'i rim: dad brtson brtul zhugs ldan pa yi: skal bzang rnams kyi spyod yul lo: sa ma ya: bkra shis yid 'ong dben gnas su: mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus kyi tshe: stegs bu dmar zlum gru gang ngos: sindhū ra yis bskyang nul bya: de steng dkyil 'khor mtshan ma dgod: phyi nang gsang pa'i sgrub rdzas dang : tshogs dang mchod pa'i yo byad bsham: ye shes mthong ba'i slob dpon gyis: bdag mdun dbyer med bsnyen cing bsgrub: byin 'bebs ting 'dzin nan du bskyed: rig pa'i me tog dor ba'am: ji ltar 'os pa'i tshul gyis 'jug: snod ldan slob ma khrus nas phyung : sngon 'gro'i 'jug pa spy-i ltar rjes: dngos gzhi'i thog mar bum dbang ni: hrī: gzhi dbyings gzhon nu bum sku'i dkyil 'khor du: gzhi snang rig pa ye shes lha tshogs shar: zung 'jug thugs rje bdud rtsis dbang bskur bas: 'chi med rdo rje'i sku ru 'grub par shog: rtsa sngags dang : kā la sha kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: spro na rig pa'i dbang lnga sogs: ye shes thig le ji bzhin la:

gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs lha dbang bskur: mtha' brten tshe bcud 'gugs shing bstim: gsang rdzas byang sems mgrin par bzhag: hrī: bde ba chen po padma thod phreng dang : stong nyid shes rab mandā ra ba yum: gnyis med mnyam sbyor byang sems 'di byin pas: las rlung ye shes khams su gnas 'gyur shog: rtsa sngags dang : bo dhi tsitta wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: rjes 'brel sngags kyi bzlas lung dang : mtha' brten tshe yi bdud rtsi sbyin: hrī: thabs mchog 'od zer rnam lnga'i rig mdangs kyis: 'khor 'das tshe dang ye shes bsdus pa'i bcud: shes rab myong grol bdud rtsi 'di byin pas: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub pa'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags dang : wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ mtshan ldan gzungs ma byin brlabs gtad: hrī: lhan skyes ye shes 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu: yid 'ong sna tshogs gzugs can 'di gtad pas: bde stong rnam kun mchog ldan 'od gsal ngang : zung 'jug gnyug ma'i gnas lugs mngon gyur shog: rtsa sngags dang : pra dzñā dzñā na tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: mtha' brten tshe yi ril bu sbyin: hrī: srid dang zhi ba'i dwangs bcud 'dus pa'i dngos: 'chi med bdud rtsi'i ril bu 'di byin pas: rtsa rlung thig le'i sgrib gnyis kun zhi nas: dga' bzhi'i ye shes rtag tu rgyas par shog: rtsa sngags dang : tsittā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: shel dang me long rtags kyi brdas: ka dag lhun grub don ngo sprad: hrīḥ ka dag spros pa bral ba'i ye shes las: lhun grub snang ba rnam bzhi'i dkyil 'khor shar: dbyings rig dbyer med chen por dbang bskur bas: chos zad blo 'das go 'phang mngon gyur shog: rtsa sngags dang : dzñā na dha tu kā ya wā ka tsittā a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: spro na dbang bzhi so so'i mthar: rang rang lam gyis srid dang zhi'i: tshe bcud bsdu ba'i dmigs pa sbyin: mtha' brten gtor ma spy-i bor bzhag: hrī: ngo bo 'od gsal chos sku snang mtha' yas:

rang bzhin bde stong longs sku tshe dpag med: thugs rje 'chi med padma thod phreng sogs: rab 'byams rtsa gsum tshe yi lha tshogs kyis: deng 'dir skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: bla tshe chad nyams yar ba rang sor chud: srid dang zhi ba'i tshe bcud dbu mar thim: sgo gsum 'chi med gnyug ma'i srog 'grub shog: rtsa sngags dang : kā ya wā ka tsittā gu ṇa karma ba liṃ ta sarba siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ āḥ rjes su tshe bcud rgyas gdab cing : sgrib gnyis g.yul las rgyal ba'i slad: shis pa'i rdzas kyis mnga' yang gsol: me tog char 'bebs rol mo 'khrol: dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs: rtsa ba'i gzhung dang mthun par spyad: gzhan du thun mong rigs can la: bum dbang rjes 'brel bcas pa dang : gong ma rnams kyi mtha' brten sbyar: sa ma ya: de ltar rtsa gsum kun 'dus pa: 'chi med drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor du: smin byed dbang bzhi'i rim pa 'dis: mthar thug ye shes snying por sbyor: gnas skabs dus min 'chi ba dang : rtsa rlung thig le'i gegs kun zhi: rdo rje'i tshe la dbang thob pa'i: rig pa 'dzin pa'i gzugs su 'gyur: de phyir 'chi med sgrub pa'i thabs: bye ba phrag brgya'i yang snying 'di: 'das dus mā ra tī ka ru: rig 'dzin ḍā ki rnams la bstan: ma 'ongs lnga brgya'i tha ma la: bdag gis byin rlabs rnal 'byor pa: 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje'i don: rig pa dbyings kyi sgrom bur sbas: nam zhig rten 'brel dus babs tshe: sngon gyi smon lam lhan cig pa'i: chos bdag skyes bu'i tshogs la sogs: 'brel tshad don dang ldan par shog: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: dhī/: tshe sgrub 'chi med drwa ba las: byin 'bebs ye shes mchog stsol bzhugs: hrī: byin chen ngo mtshar 'og min mchog gi zhing : spros bral chos dbyings rdo rje'i pho brang nas: thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang tshe yi lhas: gnas 'dir byin phob 'chi med dngos grub stsol:

hrī: byin chen ngo mtshar bde stong mchog gi zhing : nges pa lnga ldan longs sku'i pho brang nas: tshe bdag bcom ldan rgyal ba rigs mchog lngas: gnas 'dir byin phob 'chi med dngos grub stsol: hrī: byin chen ngo mtshar 'gro 'dul mchog gi zhing : lho nub zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang nas: rtsa gsum kun 'dus padma thod phreng gis: gnas 'dir byin phob 'chi med dngos grub stsol: hrī: byin chen ngo mtshar dur khrod mchog gi zhing : dbang dang drag shul rol pa'i pho brang nas: yi dam yongs 'dus dbang chen he ru kas: gnas 'dir byin phob 'chi med dngos grub stsol: hrī: byin chen ngo mtshar 'od gsal mchog gi zhing : dag pa rab 'byams sku gsum pho brang nas: rtsa gsum chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis: gnas 'dir byin phobs 'chi med dngos grub stsol: hrī: byin chen ngo mtshar phrin las mchog gi zhing : tshad med rnam bzhi rol pa'i pho brang nas: sprul pa'i las mdzad lha mo mgyogs ma bzhis: gnas 'dir byin phobs 'chi med dngos grub stsol: hrī: phyi snod dag pa rdo rje'i 'og min che: 'chi med padma drā bar byin phob cig: nang bcud 'gro kun gdod nas lha yi sku: rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i ngo bor byin phob cig: sgrar grags gzhom med rdo rje'i sngags kyi sgra: grags stong nā da'i dbyangs su byin phob cig: rtog tshogs rang grol ka dag gnyug ma'i gshis: gdod nas 'pho 'gyur bral bar byin phob cig: dbyings rig zung 'jug lhun grub snang bzhi'i ngang : 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku ru byin phob cig: thams cad ro mnyam gzhon nu bum sku'i klong : 'khor 'das dbyer med chen por byin phob cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadzra gu ru padma siddhi puṇye dzñā na ā yur siddhi dza: sarba sa ma ya a be sha ya a ā: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: phag mo dkar mo'i sgrub thabs ye shes snang ba bzhugs:
