dhī/: rtsa gsum yongs 'dus lha la 'dud: bcom ldan badzra bā ra hi'i: zab mo'i rnal 'byor la brten nas: ye shes snang ba rgyas 'dod pas: dben pa'i gnas su 'di ltar bsgom: sa ma ya: hrī: stong pa nyid dang snying rje che: zung 'jug bam̐ yig dkar po las: 'od 'phros snod bcud dbyings su sbyangs: tshur 'dus skad cig dran rdzogs su: rang rig bcom ldan wā ra hī: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar: phyag g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug 'phyar: g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar bsnams: mchan khung kha ṭwām̐ rtse gsum mtshan: spy-i gtsug phag zhal ngur sgra sgrogs: dar dang rin chen rus pa'i brgyan: khro 'dzum chags nyams mtshan dper 'bar: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar stabs kyis: pad nyi bam ro'i snying gar rol: dam tshig ye shes dbyer med pa: snang stong zung 'jug chen po'i ngang : thugs kar nyi zla kha sbyor dbus: hrī mthar sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor: 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun mchod: khams gsum 'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis bsal: srid zhi'i shes rab ye shes bcud: bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs nas: lus ngag yid la thim pa yis: spobs pa'i gter mdzod grol bar bsam: oṃ bam̐ badzra wā ra hī pa dzñā dzñā na sarba siddhi hrīṃ dza: bdun phrag gsum du bzlas pa yis: dngos nyams rmi lam sna tshogs su: nyi zla shar dang bdud rtsi 'thung : me tog char 'bebs rol mo sgrogs: khrus byas gos dkar gyon pa sogs: dge zhing shis pa'i rtags mtshan 'byung : de tshe dngos grub blang bar bya: sa ma ya: khyad par rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni: khams gsum snod bcud rim gyis bsdu: 'od gsal ye shes chen por 'jug: de las slar yang gnyug ma'i lha: 'ja' tshon shar ba lta bur ldang : sku dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma: sbom phra mda' smyug tsam pa la: g.yas g.yon ro rkyang gnyis dang bcas: 'khor lo rnam bzhi rab tu gsal: snying gar dwangs ma'i thig le'i dbus:

ye shes lnga ldan bam̐ yig bsgom: me rlung sbyor bas bde drod bskyed: bdud rtsi'i bcud kun bam̐ la bstim: rlung yid rig pa gcig dril nas: lhan skyes bde stong ngang du bzhag: 'di nyid bsgoms pa tsam gyis kyang : mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'dir 'grub: sa ma ya: slob ma rjes su gzung ba ni: bdag mdun dbyer med bskyed cing bzlas: sngon 'gro'i 'jug pas rgyud sbyangs nas: dngos gzhir bum pa spy-i bor bskur: hrī: stong nyid bum pa'i dkyil 'khor du: bde chen ye shes ḍā ki shar: zung 'jug bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur bas: rdo rje'i gzugs sku mngon 'gyur thog:

rtsa sngags dang : kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: snyoms 'jug byang sems bdud rtsi sbyin: hrī: e dbyings bde mchog he ru ka: wam̐ yig rdo rje btsun mor sbyar: srid pa dag byed bdud rtsi'i chu: 'thungs shig 'thungs shig dpa' bo che: rtsa sngags dang : guhya a mṛ ta ma hā su kha ho: sindhū ra ni snying gar byugs: hrīḥ rtags kyi thig le 'di btab pas: don dam rdo rje'i pho nya mo: kun rdzob sna tshogs gzugs can gyi: bde mchog bde ba'i rol par spyod: rtsa sngags dang : dzñā na karma mu dra ho: de las skyes pa'i ye shes la: rig stong gnyug mar ngo sprod gdab: hrī: ltos shig skal ldan snying gi bu: bltas pas mthong med bde ba che: rang rig badzra wā ra hī: ka dag lhun grub zung du 'jug: rtsa sngags mthar: dzñā na badzra dharma dhā tu a a a: zhes brjod dgongs pa dbyings la gtad: sa ma ya: ji lta ji snyed ye shes kyi: snang ba rtag tu rgyas 'dod na: mthar thug don gyi sgrub pa 'di: snying gi dbus su gces par zungs: rgya rgya rgya: dha thim: dhī/: /rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: phag mo dkar mo'i tshe sgrub bzhugs: dhī/: 'chi med rtsa gsum lha la 'dud: bde chen dkar mo la brten nas: tshe dang ye shes sgrub 'dod na: 'chi med tshe yi rdzas dang ni: gtor ma mchod tshogs ci 'byor bsham: bdag nyid lhar snang gsal brtan ngang : thugs kar 'chi med tshe dpag med: dkar gsal mnyam bzhag tshe bum rgyas: rang 'od yum 'khyud longs sku'i chas: mtshan dpe'i gzi brjid dpal du 'bar: de'i thugs dbus thabs shes rab: nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor dbus: zung 'jug hrīḥyig kar po'i mthar: sngags kyis 'khor las 'od zer 'phros: rang gi bla tshe chad nyams dang : 'khor 'das dwang bcud 'chi med kyi: bdud rtsi'i rnam par bam̐ la thim: rdo rje'i ye shes srog 'grub gyur: oṃ bam̐ badzra wā ra hī pra dzñā dzñā na sarba siddhi hrīṃ dzaḥ

badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā: 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas 'chi med 'grub: thun mtshams tshe 'gugs brgyud bskul ni: mda' dar g.yab cing gdung shugs bskyed: oṃ: me long lta bu'i ye shes las: phyag rgya'i gzugs su rang shar ba: bde chen dkar mo tshe yi lha: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i 'khor dang bcas: rtse gcig gus pas bsgrub lags na: thugs rje thugs dam rtsal chen phyungs: pho nya sprul pa mkha' khyab spros: bdag gzhan bla tshe chad yar dang : 'khor 'das srog gi dwangs ma'i bcud: 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rnam par bsdus: bdag dang sgrub pa'i rdzas la bstims: bla srog chad nyams rang sor chud: 'gyur ba med pa rdo rje'i sku: gzhom du med pa gnyug ma'i srog: mi phyed rgyun gyis rtag pa yi: ye shes chen po'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ bam̐ badzra wā ra hī pra dzñā dzñā na sarba siddhi hrīṃ dzaḥ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā: bskul ba'i mthar: āḥ srid zhi'i dwang bcud snying dbus kyi: mi shig thugs srog lha la thim: rdo rje'i go chas rgyas gdab pas: 'pho med gnyug ma'i srog 'grub shog: dzñā na badzra rakṣa rakṣa bhrūm̐: rang nyid dngos grub blang ba'am: gzhan la tshe yi dbang bskur na: khrus byas bgegs phral srung 'khor bsgom: maṇḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab: hoḥ bde chen ye shes snang ba can: khyab bdag rdo rje btsun mo dang : dbyer med dpal ldan bla ma yis: tshe dang ye shes dbang mchog stsol: rgyud sbyangs lhar bskyed byin chen dbab: tshe 'gugs bskul zhing dngos grub gsol: de nas 'brang rgyas spyi bor bzhag: oṃ: mi 'gyur rtag pa'i ye shes sku: bde gshegs tshe yi dbang bskur bas: lus kyi sgrib pa kun dag nas: 'pho med rdo rje'i sku 'grub shog: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: tshe yi bdud rtsi mgrin par sbyin: āḥ 'gags med nā da'i ye shes gsung : padma tshe yi dbang bskur bas: ngag gi sgrib pa kun dag nas: mi phyed rdo rje'i gsung 'grub shog:

wā ka a bhiñtsi āḥ ril bu snying gar gtugs shing sbyin: hūm̐: 'od gsal gnyug ma'i ye shes thugs: rdo rje tshe yi dbang bskur bas: yid kyi sgrib pa kun dag nas: mkha' khyab rdo rje'i thugs 'grub shog: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar dbang dang dngos grub blangs: bdud rtsis lus kyi nang gang bas: tshe dang ye shes mchog 'grub cing : dwangs ma snying dbus hrīḥl thim: mi phyed rdo rje'i srog thob bsam: bden pa'i tshig bcas rgyas gdab cing : shis pa brjod cing me tog 'thor: des ni dus min 'chi ba zhi: tshe bsod ye shes 'phel bar 'gyur: sa ma ya: shin tu yang zab gsang ba'i bcud: rdo rje gsum du bsgrub pa'i thabs: 'dis kyang skal bar ldan pa rnams: 'chi med ye shes 'grub par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: guhya: dha thim: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: bka' srung mchod gsol rdo rje'i drwa ba bzhugs: dhī/: dpal chen he ru ka la 'dud: ma 'ongs 'od gsal gsang ba'i lam: mngon du spyod pa'i skal ldan rnams: rgyud gsum dregs pa'i gsol mchod 'di: snying gi thig ler gces par zungs: sa ma ya: de yang shin tu dben pa'i gnas: dur khrod drag po'i gzhal yas su: phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rdzas mdun: bhandhar bshos bu zur gsum pa: gtso 'khor so so'i grangs mnyam dang : mtha' mar theb kyu sha khrag snying : dgra bo'i rū pa bcas pas bskor: gzhan yang mthun pa'i dam tshig rdzas: gtsang zhing mdzes pas mdun bdar te: rang nyid skad cig dpal chen po'i: gsal snang rdzogs pa'i nga rgyal ngang : mchod gtor ye shes bdud rtsir brlab: de nas dam tshig bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: rang mdun khrag mtsho rba rlabs 'khrugs pa'i klong : keng rus thod mkhar 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus: padma nyi steng hūm̐ yig mthing nag las: 'od 'phros rgyud gsum dregs pa'i srog snying 'phrog: tshur 'dus yongs gyur skad cig dran rdzogs su:

dpal ldan ye shes mgon po ma ning nag: char sprin mdog can srin po khros pa'i nyams: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pas ru mtshon phyar: g.yon pas dam nyams snying dang zhags pa bsnams: 'khor 'das snang srid sku'i dbyings su rdzogs: spyan gsum me 'bar ral pa sbrul du g.yo: thod skam dbu rgyan thod rlon do shal 'chang : dar nag ber gsol ber chen sked par btsugs: zhabs gnyis g.yon brkyang log 'dren snying gar brdzis: 'khor du dpal ldan mgon po sde lngar bcas: srid dang zhi ba'i che btsan gcig tu bzhengs: g.yas su tri las gza' mchog rā hu la: dud ka'i mdog 'chang dbu dgu bya rog gdong : rab 'jigs phyag bzhi 'bar ba'i spyan stong g.yo: dang pos chu srin rgya mtshan sbrul zhags dang : lhag ma rnam gnyis rwa yi mda' gzhu 'gengs: sku smad sbrul 'jug rgya mtsho'i klong du 'khyil: 'khor du gza' gdong rgyu skar tshogs kyis bskor: g.yon du trag las sngags srung ral gcig ma: mthing nag zhal gcig spyan gcig mche ba gcig: brang na nu gcig bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gtams: phyag g.yas dam nyams tsitta zhal du gsol: g.yon pas lcags spyang mgo dgu khra thabs 'gyed: zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs bam̐ ro'i snying gar rol: 'khor du snang srid ma mo'i tshogs kyis bskor: gzhan yang sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag dpung tshogs: khro gtum 'bar 'khrugs log 'dren 'byung po'i gshed: de ltar gsal ba'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi: gnas gsum dam tshig phyag rgyas mtshan pa las: 'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas nas ye shes pa: ma lus spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur: gnyis pa ye shes spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐ bhyo: rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur sprul pa: gnyis med ye shes mgon po ma ning nag: bde chen sgyu ma'i rnam rol rā hu la: shes rab dbyings kyi phyag rgya sngags srung ma: snang srid dregs pa'i dmag dpung 'khor dang bcas:

sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srung ba'i phyir: dur khrod drag po'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ke ta ke ta rā hu la ma ma trag raksha aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥnaḥsarba sa ma ya dza dza: gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: dam tshig nyams pa'i srog gi mdangs 'phrog cing : dam ldan rnal 'byor phrin las bsgrub slad du: rab 'jigs 'od zer 'khrugs pa'i gzhal yas 'dir: dpal mgon lcam dral 'khor bcas dgyes par bzhugs: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: bzhi pa brda phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: dran pa tsam gyis dgra dang bgegs kyi tshogs: ma lus 'dul mdzad dpal 'bar he ru ka: lcam dral bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa la: sgo gsum gus pa'i tshul gyis phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra tītstsha ho: lnga pa mchod gtor 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ bhyo: yul dang dbang por 'brel ba'i rtog tshogs kun: 'od gsal dbu ma'i dbyings su bsgral ba las: phyi nang gsang ba rmad byung mchod pa'i sprin: dpag med nam mkha' khyab pas mnyes gyur cig: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shapda'i bar dang ru pa shapda gandhe rā sa spar she ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ga ṇa tsakra sarba pū dza hoḥ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ke ta ke ta rā hu la ma ma trag raksha aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥn sarba sa ma ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: drug pa gnad nas bskul ba ni: mdun bskyed thugs kar nyi ma'i steng : rang srog sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: bdag nyid dpal chen he ru ka'i: phyag rgya gnyen po'i 'od zer gyis: rig pas dam tshig rgyud bskul te: sprul dang yang sprul bka' nyan bcas: srid gsum khyab pa'i tshogs spros nas: phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub par bsam: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ke ta ke ta rā hu la ma ma trag raksha sarba sa ma ya hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: mtshan ma'i rtags dang sbyar la bzla: bdun pa skong shing bshags pa ni: hūm̐ bhyo:

dur khrod khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa'i gzhal yas 'dir: dpal mgon 'khor bcas dgyes pa skyed pa'i rdzas: dngos yid las byung sna tshogs mchod sprin che: nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag gi mchod yon dang : dbang po'i me tog sha gsur bdug pa'i sprin: zhun chen mar me mkhris pa'i dri chab mtsho: rkang gling thod pa'i rnga sgras thugs dam bskang : phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rdzas bla rdo dang : gang bzhed de ngor 'char ba'i 'dod yon lnga: snang srid gzhir bzhengs phyag rgya'i dam tshig gis: gang shar bde ba chen por thugs dam bskang : rtsa khams dbu mar sbyar ba'i a mṛ ta: bdag 'dzin dbyings su bsgral ba'i dmar chen po: snod bcud sha khrag rus pa'i gtor ma'i tshogs: bla med gsang ba'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang : snang grags dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rol pa shar: sgo gsum thig le chen po'i klong du rdzogs: cir snang ye shes mchog gi grong khyer du: blang dor 'khrul pa zad pas thugs dang bskang : don dam bde gshegs snying po'i gnas lugs la: bshags dang bshags bya'i spros mtshan las 'das kyang : kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam rol gyis: dam tshig nyams chag thams cad mthol zhing bshags: gnas skabs gang 'dul phrin las sna tshogs kyis: bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde rgyas pa dang : mthar thug zab gsang snying po'i nye lam nas: sku bzhi'i go 'phang 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: yi ge brgya pa brjod: brgyad pa bstod cing bskul ba ni: hūm̐ bhyo: skye ba med las skye ba'i cho 'phrul ni: nam mkha'i mdog can srin po khros pa'i gzugs: phyag gnyis thabs shes ru mtshon snying zhags bsnams: he ru kaḥdapal 'bar ba khyod la bstod: spyan gsum dmar zlum me dang mnyam sbyor bas: log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs kun sreg mdzad cing : yid bzhin 'dod pa 'jo ba'i beng chen las: rnal 'byor dngos grub stsol mdzad khyod la bstod:

thabs kyi phyag rgya gtum drag 'bar ba'i sku: pho rgyud dregs pa'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur zhing : srid gsum zil gnon nyams pa'i srog gi gshed: drang srong chen po sgra gcan 'dzin la bstod: shes rab rdo rje btsun mo'i sgyu ma ni: snang srid ma mo'i rje mor yongs shar ba: snying tig gnyan po'i bka' srung rgya mtsho'i gtso: dpal 'bar e ka dza ṭī khyod la bstod: don dam chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : rnam pa khro chags sgeg pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis: bstan dgra tshar gcod rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong : dpal mgon lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la bstod: hūm̐ bhyo: sngon tshe 'og min chos dbyings pho brang du: che ba'i che mchog kun bzang he ru kas: bka' bsgos dam bzhag bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs: spros bral bde ba chen po'i klong nas bzhengs: dug gsum dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: ji ltar khas blangs g.yar dam bcas pa bzhin: rnal 'byor bdag gi bcol ba'i phrin las sgrubs: gnas skabs nad gdon nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang : tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan pa'i grags pa spel: mi dang mi min tshogs rnams dbang du sdus: dgra bgegs 'byung po rtsad nas brlag par mdzod: khyad par 'gro la phan bde 'byung ba'i gzhi: bshad sgrub bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang : 'od gsal snying po'i lam la zhugs pa rnams: zag bcas 'od skur 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: phyi ru snang srid klong lnga sprul pa'i zhing : nang ltar mi shigs lhan skyes bde ba che: gzhan du bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug chen po'i dbyings: he ru ka:dpal go 'phang myur 'grub mdzod: mdor na yid la smon pa'i don rnams kun: bum pa bzang dang dpag bsam nor bu ltar: dbang drag zhi bar rol pa'i phrin las kyis: thogs med myur ba nyid du 'grub par mdzod: ces brjod phud gtor gtsang sar phul: ye shes gshegs shing dam tshig bsdu:

spros bral thig le chen po'i klong : mnyam par bzhag pas las kun 'grub: sa ma ya: ye shes las grub chos srung kun: rgyud gsum dregs pa'i tshogs su 'du: de yang rig stong zung 'jug dbyings: 'du 'bral med par gdod nas rdzogs: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: PAGE PAGE 77 FILENAME A-1.doc
